title: Group Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
**Group Supply Chain Analyst**
**Mumbai, India**
**Permanent position**
**The Role**
The Supply Chain Analyst is the process owner and subject matter expert for the James Fisher and Sons Approved Vendor List (AVL) platform, supplier onboarding process and Group Supply Chain data systems.
  
  
The role exists to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of supplier data across the group, to drive continuous improvement of the AVL system and associated processes, and to provide data-driven insight through business intelligence reporting that supports group-wide procurement decision-making.
  
  
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
**Supply Chain data integrity**
:
  
  
Own and maintain the completeness and accuracy of the JFS Approved Vendor List, ensuring all supplier records meet defined data quality standards and that processes are in place to sustain that quality over time.
  
  
**Supplier onboarding**
: Serve as the subject matter expert for the supplier onboarding process, managing the end-to-end workflow from initial registration through qualification, compliance checks, and activation on the AVL platform.
  
  
**System improvement**
: Work with Synergi (the AVL platform provider) and internal IT stakeholders to identify, specify, and drive continuous improvement of the Dynamics 365 and Power Pages AVL platform, acting as the primary interface between supply chain and technology on system matters.
  
  
**Business intelligence**
: Design, build, improve and maintain procurement BI dashboards and reporting across the group, ensuring stakeholders have timely and accurate visibility of supplier data, spend analytics, and compliance status.
  
  
**Process development**
: Develop, document, and embed the processes, controls, and working practices that govern how supply chain data is created, maintained, and validated across the group, including duplicate detection, re-evaluation workflows, and data governance standards.
  
  
**Compliance support**
: Support the group's compliance obligations by ensuring the AVL operates as an effective control vehicle for sanctions screening, financial health monitoring, and Code of Conduct compliance, aligned to the requirements of the group entity level controls framework.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
A key challenge for this role is operating as a sole contributor in a newly established group function, requiring the ability to build credibility and working relationships across multiple divisions and geographies without direct authority.
  
  
This role is a dedicated resource for Group Supply Chain systems and data across the James Fisher group. The postholder must be capable of operating with a high degree of autonomy and self-direction.
  
  
The AVL platform (Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Pages) was built by an external systems integrator (Synergi). The postholder will manage the ongoing working relationship with Synergi on technical and process matters and must be comfortable engaging with third-party technology partners.
  
  
The Group BI platform is in an early stage of development, having been initiated by an external contractor.
  
  
There is significant work to do to get full visibility of spend data and operational procurement metrics.
  
  
The post holder will work with the external contractor to understand the data lake structure and begin to take ownership for the maintenance and improvement of the platform.
  
  
Responsible for the integrity of the data contained in the AVL database of supplier records, developing and maintaining supply operational dashboards based on ERP purchase order data, inventory data, logistics data and datalake.
  
  
**Key Skills, Knowledge And Experience**

* A Graduate in a relevant discipline such as computer science, information systems, data science, supply chain management, or a related field from a recognised university.
* The postholder will have strong analytical capability and demonstrable proficiency across the Microsoft data and analytics stack, including Dynamics 365, Power Pages, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Automate, and Excel.
* Practical experience working with AI tools to enhance data analysis and process efficiency is expected.
* An understanding of supply chain processes and procurement principles is advantageous, though deep technical supply chain expertise is not a prerequisite for the role.
* Strong written and spoken English is essential, given the global nature of the role and the requirement to communicate effectively with stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.
* Candidates who are early in their career and can demonstrate the required technical aptitude are equally considered alongside those with experience in a data, systems, or supply chain environment.
* The role requires occasional international travel, including to the United Kingdom offices, to engage with divisional supply chain teams and key stakeholders.

Why join us?

Opportunities for career growth and visibility across the organisation.
  
  
A supportive, inclusive culture that values your ideas and contributions.
  
  
Work that truly makes a difference in safety, innovation, and global capability.

title: Senior Consultant - Resource Geology
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking a Senior Consultant - Resource Geology to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, delivering resource geology services to our global mining business. Reporting to the Mining Team Leader, the successful candidate will lead and deliver geological interpretation, three-dimensional geological modelling, mineral resource estimation, and technical reporting for open-pit and underground mining projects worldwide.
  
  
This is a senior technical role that combines hands-on delivery with technical leadership. The Senior Consultant will take ownership of assigned resource geology scopes, provide guidance and review for junior geologists, engage directly with WSP global mining leaders and clients, and ensure that geological models and mineral resource estimates are technically defensible, well documented, and consistent with recognised reporting standards such as JORC, NI 43-101, and S-K 1300.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Geological Data Management and Validation**

* Lead the compilation, validation, and management of exploration and resource datasets, including collar, survey, lithology, alteration, mineralisation, density, geotechnical, and assay information.
* Review sampling, QA/QC, and laboratory data, assess data quality and fitness for use in mineral resource estimation, and document findings and corrective actions.
* Oversee database preparation, data import, coding, compositing, and reconciliation activities in accordance with project and WSP procedures.
* Maintain rigorous data lineage, assumptions registers, and version control for geological models and estimation inputs.

**Geological Interpretation and 3D Modelling**

* Lead the interpretation of orebody geometry, lithology, stratigraphy, weathering, alteration, mineralisation, and structural controls using drilling, mapping, geophysical, and other datasets.
* Develop, update, and review three-dimensional geological, domain, and mineralisation models for open-pit and underground deposits.
* Produce and review geological sections, plans, wireframes, surfaces, solids, and supporting visualisations for technical review and client communication.
* Work with geotechnical, hydrogeological, mine planning, and engineering disciplines to ensure geological interpretations support wider project objectives.

**Mineral Resource Estimation**

* Lead exploratory data analysis, domaining, compositing, top-cut assessment, declustering, variography, density assignment, and selection of estimation parameters.
* Build, review, and validate block models using appropriate estimation techniques, and support Competent or Qualified Persons in resource sign-off.
* Undertake model validation using visual, statistical, and spatial comparison methods, and clearly document results and limitations.
* Lead mineral resource classification, reporting, reconciliation, risk, and sensitivity assessments in line with applicable project and reporting requirements.

**Technical Reporting and Compliance**

* Author and review technical reports, memoranda, presentations, model documentation, data-room reviews, and due-diligence deliverables.
* Deliver work aligned with recognised mineral resource reporting frameworks, including JORC, NI 43-101, and S-K 1300, as applicable to the assignment.
* Prepare clear descriptions of data, methods, assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations for internal, client, and public-reporting audiences.
* Ensure calculations, figures, tables, and model outputs are technically consistent, traceable, and suitable for independent review or audit.
* Apply and uphold WSP quality-management, checking, review, document-control, health, safety, and environmental requirements.

**Exploration and Field Support**

* Plan, review, and provide technical oversight of exploration, drilling, logging, sampling, QA/QC, density, mapping, and field data-collection programmes.

**programme management.**

title: Agentic AI Specialist
description:

343680BR

Mumbai
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking talented professionals to join our Agentic Automation Team at UBS Bank USA (BUSA), helping us modernize the day‑to‑day work of our service delivery teams across Banking US.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
Leverage your curiosity, technical aptitude, and engineering insight to help design, build, and integrate AI agents that change how our business works every day.
  
  
Embed, learn, and design

Build and integrate
  
  

* Design, build, and integrate agentic workflows, primarily using Microsoft Copilot Studio, that remove friction and create efficiencies in day‑to‑day business aligned processing.
* Embed agents directly into the day‑to‑day tools and routines of service delivery staff so adoption is natural and sustained

* Contribute to the team’s shared library of design patterns, prompts, and reusable components

Onboarding & training
  
  
Upon hiring, new joiners will go through structured side‑by‑side training with a senior leader to learn:
  
  

* The tools we use to develop agents (primarily Microsoft Copilot Studio)
* UBS guardrails, design principles, and compliance requirements for deploying AI safely
* How to scope, design, validate, and hand off agent use cases

**The team**
Your Team
  
  
The Agentic Automation Team is a dedicated group of approximately 10 builders focused on creating intelligent agents that streamline the day‑to‑day work of our business aligned functions. You will partner directly with Banking US staff to identify automation opportunities and embed agentic solutions where they have the greatest impact. As part of this buildout, we are looking to establish a follow‑the‑sun operating model.

Your Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or equivalent work experience
* 2–10 years of experience in technology, automation, process engineering, operations, or a related field

* Comfort with structured problem decomposition and translating business workflows into automatable steps
* Working knowledge of data handling, basic integration patterns (APIs, connectors), and process modeling
* Awareness of AI safety, responsible AI principles, or financial‑services compliance considerations is a plus
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; Excel comfort for analysis
* Very strong English communication skills, with clear written documentation and concise verbal updates across time zones

You Are
  
  

* Willing to work EMEA hours and be onsite in Mumbai
* A curious learner who thrives on embedding with new business areas and absorbing how the work really gets done
* An empathetic builder who designs for the end user, not just the use case
* Pragmatic and outcomes‑driven, with a bias toward shipping useful, controlled solutions
* Highly attentive to detail and accuracy, with disciplined documentation and follow‑through
* A collaborative partner across business, technology, and risk stakeholders who communicates crisply and escalates effectively
* Comfortable operating in an emerging space where playbooks are still being written
* You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use.

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

title: AI Specialist II
description:
**About Coursera + Udemy**
Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.
  
  
**Why join us now?**
AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.
  
  
**Shape What Comes Next**
By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
Coursera is seeking an AI Specialist to design and build AI systems that transform ambiguous business problems into working prototypes and measurable solutions. You'll work across the full lifecycle of applied AI—from data exploration and experimentation through deployment—selecting the right combination of techniques, models, and architectures for each challenge. This is a hands-on role where you'll architect retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks while collaborating closely with Product Managers, Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and the business teams who use what you build. You'll be deeply technical with modern LLM and GenAI systems, equally comfortable training custom models, designing RAG pipelines, and pushing the boundary of what AI can do for education.
  
  
**About Your Skills**
Data Science - Core discipline for extracting insights from structured and unstructured data using scientific methods and algorithms.
  
  
Data Pipelines - Essential for designing and managing series of AI processing steps from data ingestion through model inference.
  
  
AI Fluency - Understanding capabilities and limitations of LLMs, embeddings, and AI tools to apply them appropriately to problems.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and design AI systems by selecting the right combination of data, retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows with tool use, and structured extraction from unstructured sources.
* Architect and implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases such as Pinecone or Weaviate for grounded, context-aware AI applications.
* Build and maintain agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as Langgraph, Mastra, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen, including multi-step tool use, planning, and autonomous execution loops.
* Design and run evaluation for every AI system you ship, covering accuracy, hallucination and grounding checks, regression suites, and human review loops.
* Work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets on cloud-native databases and storage such as S3, Postgres, GCS, BigQuery, and Databricks, with strong SQL and data modeling skills.
* Build rapid AI prototypes and experiment with different models, retrieval strategies, prompts, and approaches to find what works best.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied AI, or Machine Learning, with experience building data-driven or AI-powered solutions.
* Demonstrated history of taking an AI use case from data exploration and experimentation through a validated working prototype.
* Hands-on experience with machine learning and modern Generative AI techniques such as LLMs, embeddings, RAG, semantic search, NLP, recommendation systems, or agentic systems.
* At least 2 production deployments involving LLM-based systems including fine-tuning, RAG, agentic workflows, or prompt-engineered solutions.
* Experience with AI experimentation and evaluation, including comparing approaches, defining quality metrics, analyzing errors, and iterating based on results.
* Working knowledge of identity and access management, encryption and key management, and secure network patterns such as VPC peering, PrivateLink, and mTLS for customer-embedded or regulated environments.
* Experience using Python and SQL to work with data, build analysis workflows, develop AI algorithms, experiment with models, and build AI and ML solutions.

We are looking for AI Solutions Engineer to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role would report to the Business Intelligence Manager and based in Bengaluru / Mumbai, India.
  
  
The AI Solutions Engineer will support the Services Business Intelligence team to develop AI/ML solutions and automation into our service strategy. This will include building and deploying machine learning algorithms (for applications to support predictive maintenance and process optimization) and developing AI solutions (agents), process automations and enhanced analytics.
  
  
**Requirements:**

* 2-4 years of hands-on experience building AI/ML solutions in a production or near-production environment
* Strong proficiency in Python – you write clean, production-grade code, not just notebooks
* Working experience with LLMs and generative AI: prompt engineering, RAG architecture, agentic workflows, or conversational AI systems
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and data warehouses
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS strongly preferred – Bedrock, Lambda, S3, Redshift, ECS/EKS)
* Familiarity with at least one orchestration/agentic framework: LangChain, LanGraph, CrewAI, AuguGen, or similar
* Understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and working with messy, imperfect enterprise data
* Strong communication skills – ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

**Strong Plus:**

* Experience with vector databases and knowledge graphs
* Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock
* Experience building multi-system integrations across enterprise platforms
* Exposure to AI governance: audit logging, RBAC, confidence scoring, human-in-the-loop workflows, hallucination prevention
* Experience with MCP or similar tool-use protocols

**Responsibilities:**
**Agentic AI Development**

* Design, build, and iterate on agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LanGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration tools
* Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that ground LLM responses in approved enterprise data sources with source citation, confidence scoring, and traceability
* Build and maintain multi-agent systems that decomposes complex operational questions into sub-tasks, query structured/unstructured data, and synthesize actionable outputs
* Implement prompt engineering, prompt libraries, and evaluation harnesses to ensure response quality, accuracy, and governance compliance
* Integrate with enterprise LLMs (e.g. AWS Bedrock / Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) and manage model abstraction layers for flexibility

**Enterprise Data Integration & Engineering**

* Build connectors and data pipelines to ingest and query data across different operational systems
* Develop and maintain semantic layers, knowledge graphs, and vector databases for contextual retrieval
* Implement data quality checks, trusted-source hierarchies, and conflict resolution logic when multiple systems provide contradictory data
* Support MCP or equivalent server integrations for live system connectivity

**ML/AI Solutions & Analytics**

* Build and deploy ML models for predictive maintenance, performance optimization, anomaly detection, and operational forecasting
* Develop automated reporting, dashboards, and self-service analytics tools
* Apply statistical methods to identify patterns, root causes, and actionable insights from fleet and service data

description:
**About Us**
**WHY Linedata?**
Linedata is an award-winning software solutions company. We believe finance matters to our society as much as energy to life and fueling financial transformation is vital for development and leadership.

We are transforming the financial services community which is in constant evolution.
  
  
With our agility, we make technology simple & accessible for our users. Let’s work together to achieve the best solutions for our clients.

We recognize, celebrate, and seek to increase diversity across our organization. Diversity is an asset to organizations and is linked to better performance. It is an integral part of how we do business and imperative to our success. As an international Group, we also believe that our people need to reflect our clients and local communities.
  
  
Linedata is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities, and all other employment laws and regulations.
  
  
It is our intent to maintain a work environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation based on an individual's race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, age, sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status, protected medical leaves, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will join a team that directly caters to the front office of Global Asset Managers/Hedge Funds. As a senior Analyst in Linedata’s Risk team, you will work closely with Portfolio Managers and Senior Risk Professionals/CROs. You will be responsible for providing portfolio risk solutions to a buy-side client. The role spans across different aspects of investment risk – generating risk and performance attribution reports, analysing complex scenarios and understanding the drivers of important risk statistics across each aggregation in a portfolio. You are also expected to proactively engage with different stakeholders to ensure well informed and timely investment decision making by the client. You are required to take complete ownership of the deliverables and demonstrate high-quality standards with utmost integrity.
  
  
Job Requirement

* Collaborate with multiple stakeholders and take complete ownership of delivering Investor, Regulatory, and customized risk solutions

* Prioritize and execute multiple assignments including adhoc assignment within tight deadlines
* Ensure adherence to high-quality standards and industry best practices established at Linedata

**Skills Required**

* 2-5 years of relevant work experience in Financial Risk Management (Markets and Credit Risk)
* Strong foundation in Mathematics and Statistics used in Financial Modelling
* Good understanding of Fixed Income asset classes including CLO, CMBS and RMBS
* Should be able to demonstrate high level of quantitative and analytical skills
* Excellent communication skills to communicate the risk analysis outcomes in simple language to clients/portfolio-managers located in New York, HK and London
* Ability to work individually and with other financial engineers in a collaborative manner

**Advantageous Skills**

* Knowledge of third-party databases such as Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters, etc.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, VBA macros, MS PowerPoint

Academic Requirements
  
  

* MBA from a Tier-1 college with BE/Statistics or equivalent education
* Any level of CFA or FRM will have preference

**Job Title: Assistant Manager - Software Development**

: Global Markets IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The Global Markets business of BNP Paribas enables corporate and institutional clients to access capital‑markets products (FX, equity derivatives, etc.) for financing, risk‑management and investment. IT systems – ranging from standard automation tools to bespoke market‑leading applications – are a core part of the value proposition. The function covers Technical & Application Production Support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance, and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions partners with teams in Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore and Hong Kong to share workload, execute global strategy and own global applications offshore.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
**BROKK**
is a platform that centralizes fee‑rate cards, stores invoices and their associated check‑lists, performs invoice reconciliation, and generates fee accruals and provisions for the GMO Fees & Commissions Management team. With the platform now expanding to the U.S. market, the role will:
  
  

* Integrate and normalize data from disparate sources.
* Design and build a new functional module.
* Create intuitive UI/UX using low‑code tools (Oracle APEX).
* Elevate the team’s overall skill set to meet emerging challenges.

**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Requirement Capture: Coordinate with Business Analysts to capture and refine requirements for new and existing modules.
* Oracle Development: Design and implement PL/SQL packages, procedures, and data‑quality rules to support reconciliation, accrual calculations and workflow automation.
* Python Development: Build scalable data‑processing pipelines, ETL workflows and analytics solutions using Python, Apache Airflow and PySpark.
* Low‑Code UI/UX: Develop Oracle APEX screens and forms for fee‑rate cards, invoices and approval/workflow pages (fee‑rate approval, invoice reconciliation, provision generation).
* Performance & Reliability: Create Airflow DAGs, profile data jobs, optimize Oracle queries and embed automated data‑validation checks.
* Source‑Code Management: Maintain all code in Git, perform pull‑request reviews and keep documentation up‑to‑date.
* Agile Delivery: Participate in sprint planning, release coordination and retrospectives to meet delivery goals.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Knowledge Sharing: Mentor and share expertise with other developers on the team.

**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

**Location: Mumbai or Pune**
**Role Description:**
The Xtrackers Products team is responsible for defining and implementing the Xtrackers product strategy, structuring and maintaining ETF and other passive investment solutions, and acting as product specialists for our clients and client coverage colleagues. ETFs and other passive investment solutions involve data-intensive and highly controlled processes; your role is therefore important to the successful implementation of Xtrackers’ growth strategy and the continued improvement of the Xtrackers product setup. title: Senior Quant Trader
description:
Senior Quantitative Trader – HFT / UHFT

**Locations:**
India & Global Markets

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional
**Senior Quantitative Trader**
with proven experience in High-Frequency Trading (HFT) and Ultra-High-Frequency Trading (UHFT) to join our expanding quantitative trading business.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of developing, deploying, and managing fully automated systematic trading strategies, with a focus on alpha generation, market making, and short-horizon trading across multiple asset classes and global markets.

This is an opportunity to work with advanced trading infrastructure, substantial capital allocation, and a performance-driven environment where trading expertise and profitability are highly rewarded.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and manage fully automated systematic trading strategies with short holding periods and high trading turnover.
* Research and deploy alpha-generating strategies, market-making models, and other high-frequency trading strategies.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting, simulation, and performance analysis using in-house research infrastructure.
* Identify market inefficiencies and develop quantitative models to generate consistent risk-adjusted returns.
* Monitor live trading performance, optimize execution, and continuously enhance strategy profitability.
* Analyse high-frequency tick-level market data to identify trading opportunities and improve strategy performance.
* Collaborate with quantitative researchers, developers, and infrastructure teams to enhance trading systems and execution efficiency.
* Manage trading risk, capital allocation, and strategy performance while maintaining strong risk-adjusted returns.

Candidate Requirements

* Extensive experience in High-Frequency Trading (HFT) or Ultra-High-Frequency Trading (UHFT).
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on live HFT trading experience with a demonstrable P&L track record.
* Strong understanding of alpha generation, market making, statistical arbitrage, and systematic trading strategies.
* Proven ability to generate consistent profitability with strong Sharpe ratios and controlled drawdowns.
* Strong programming skills in C or C++.
* Proficiency in Python, R, or MATLAB for statistical modelling, quantitative research, and tick-data analysis.
* Experience working with large-scale market data, backtesting frameworks, and automated execution systems.
* Strong mathematical, statistical, and analytical capabilities.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, or another highly quantitative discipline.

What We Offer :

We offer a highly competitive and performance-driven compensation structure designed to attract and retain exceptional trading talent.

* **Exceptional Compensation:**
  Industry-leading fixed compensation packages, tailored to experience and performance.
* **Performance-Based Payouts:**
  Attractive P&L-sharing arrangements with a significant percentage of strategy-generated profits.
* **Flexible P&L Participation:**
  Opportunity to negotiate performance-linked incentives based on individual contribution, strategy profitability, and capital allocation.
* **Global Opportunities:**
  Opportunities to work across India and international trading locations.
* **Capital Allocation:**
  Access to substantial trading capital for proven strategies, subject to internal risk and allocation parameters.
* **Advanced Infrastructure:**
  Access to sophisticated, low-latency trading systems, execution technology, and in-house research infrastructure.
* **Research Autonomy:**
  Freedom to research, develop, test, and deploy innovative trading strategies.
* **Collaborative Environment:**
  Work alongside experienced quantitative traders, researchers, developers, and technology professionals.
* **Career Growth:**
  Opportunity to take ownership of trading strategies and grow into senior trading leadership roles.
* **Performance Recognition:**
  Compensation and incentives directly aligned with measurable trading performance.
* **Relocation Support:**
  Relocation assistance and visa support for eligible international opportunities.
* **Additional Benefits:**
  Competitive benefits package, subject to location and employment structure.

Compensation Structure

The compensation package will be customised based on the candidate's experience, live trading track record, strategy performance, and capital requirements.

It may include:

* Competitive fixed salary.
* Performance-linked annual bonuses.
* Attractive P&L-sharing percentage.
* Strategy-specific profit participation.
* Additional incentives for consistent profitability and long-term performance.

**We are particularly interested in traders with proven live strategies, independently verifiable P&L records, strong Sharpe ratios, and the ability to scale profitable trading strategies.**

Interested Candidates

If you are an experienced HFT/UHFT trader looking to scale your strategies, access advanced trading infrastructure, and participate in an attractive performance-linked compensation structure, we would love to connect.

**Let's build the next generation of systematic trading strategies together.**

title: Right Shore, Revenue Planning Analyst
description:
**Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst**
Full Time | Hybrid
  
  
Location: Airoli, Navi Mumbai, India | Pune, Maharashtra, India
  
  
Team: Right Shore Sales Operations
  
  
Reports to: Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader
  
  
Dotted line to: Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy
  
  
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst, you are the dedicated data owner for Teradata’s revenue planning process. You sit within the Right Shore Sales Operations team and work day to day with the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy to run the data engine behind the annual planning cycle and the year-round change process that keeps the plan accurate.
  
  
This is a data management and processing role. You build and manage the planning templates, consolidate and reconcile submissions from across the business units, keep account and assignment data clean, and take real ownership of the final business build files that hand off into Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. You are the last set of eyes before planning data leaves the process — accuracy is the job.
  
  
The planning calendar moves, priorities shift, and questions arrive without warning. This role suits someone who adapts quickly, can go deep into the detail of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and takes personal pride in a clean file.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the final business build files: Assemble, validate and own the definitive build files for territory, account assignment, headcount and quota that feed Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. Run the pre-handoff checks, resolve exceptions, and sign off on what goes out.
* Build and manage planning templates: Develop, version, distribute and support the planning templates used by business unit teams; track submissions, chase gaps, and consolidate returns into a single reconciled dataset.
* Maintain account data quality: Keep account data accurate and audit-ready — account hierarchy, duplicate records, ARR category changes, ownership and assignment accuracy — through scheduled audits, exception reports and remediation.
* Process territory and assignment changes: Process and validate territory, account and people assignments in Salesforce, including Enterprise Territory Management and hierarchy changes, ensuring every change is traceable and correctly reflected.
* Support the annual revenue planning cycle: Work to the calendar and cadence set by the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — preparing datasets, running the consolidation, and turning around iterations at pace during planning crunch.
* Maintain headcount, coverage and quota datasets: Keep the planning datasets current and reconciled across planning, Salesforce and Finance views, and maintain the change history behind them.
* Process in-year change requests: Handle mid-year changes to territories, account assignments and quotas — validating the request, applying the change, and keeping the audit trail intact.
* Produce planning status and exception reporting: Deliver recurring completeness, status and data-quality reporting so the Manager and business unit teams always know where the cycle stands and what needs attention.
* Go deep when required: Trace a number back to source, unpick a discrepancy across systems, or rebuild a broken file under time pressure — and explain clearly what went wrong and what you changed.
* Document the work: Maintain data definitions, file specifications, run instructions and change logs so the process is repeatable and does not depend on one person’s memory.

**Who You'll Work With**

* Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — your day-to-day business partner and dotted-line manager
* Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader — your direct manager
* UNIT Sales Operations Managers (SOMs) and business unit teams
* Revenue Operations, IT and Salesforce delivery teams
* FP&A and People/HR planning partners

**Minimum Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales planning, or a data management role supporting a sales organization.
* Advanced Excel is essential — complex interconnected workbooks, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, nested formulas, template design, data consolidation and validation across large datasets.
* Proficiency in Salesforce. com, including territory and account hierarchy management, assignment processing, data quality management, and running and interrogating reports.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to check your own work and the instinct to notice when a number looks wrong.
* Demonstrated ownership of a data deliverable end to end — not just producing it, but being accountable for its accuracy downstream.
* Ability to work to a fixed planning calendar and absorb shifting priorities without losing the thread.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the confidence to flag a problem early and ask the question that unblocks the work.
* Comfort collaborating across time zones with US and EMEA stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field (finance, statistics, analytics, reporting).

**What You'll Bring**

* Ownership of the Build File: You treat the final build file as yours. You know what depends on it, you check it before anyone else has to, and you do not hand over work you are not confident in.
* Adaptability: Planning priorities change quickly. You re-sequence, absorb new requirements, and keep moving without needing the plan re-explained.
* Depth on Demand: You can drop into the mechanics of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and follow the data until you find the cause.
* Data Quality Instinct: A low tolerance for dirty data, and the habits — reconciliation, validation, exception reporting — that keep it clean rather than fixing it after the fact.
* Process Discipline: You follow the standard, document what you do, and leave the process better than you found it.
* Practical AI fluency: Comfort using a leading AI assistant (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini also relevant) to speed up data preparation, reconciliation, documentation and repetitive processing work — with the judgement to verify the output.
* Power BI experience or certification would be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with sales planning or incentive compensation platforms (Anaplan, Lative, Xactly, Varicent or equivalent) would be an added advantage.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Analyst- Materials Management
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
As an Analyst – Materials Management, you will use supply-chain knowledge, data management, and analytical skills to improve inbound raw-material flow, availability, and network effectiveness across the assigned Operating Unit (OU). You will work as an individual contributor with Consultants, Assistant Managers, Plant Associate Managers, plant planners, and cross-functional stakeholders. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm shift.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Support OU-level performance improvement across OTD, DOS, VN, NPW, utilization, MDRs, lead-time compliance, and related supply-chain metrics.
* Prepare and maintain OU-level analysis, and issue summaries for review with Consultants and Assistant Managers.
* Coordinate with Plant Associate Managers, plant planners, sourcing, transportation, suppliers, buyers, and other stakeholders to validate issues, document root causes, and track action closure.
* Support disruption recovery and escalation management by expediting materials, coordinating alternate sources of supply and transportation, reviewing purchase order commitments, and tracking recovery actions through closure. Identify recurring MDR issues, recommend practical corrective actions, and support sustainable solutions to improve supply continuity and reduce repeat disruptions.
* Support TLC and related supply-chain analyses, including freight cost, safety stock, min–max levels, load efficiency, and less-than-truckload (LTL) optimization, to identify cost and service improvement opportunities.
* Assist with escalation tracking, process-improvement initiatives, and the application of AI-enabled tools and insights to improve decision-making, generate cost improvement opportunities, and deliver measurable cost avoidance.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Full-time graduation from an accredited university is required.
* Minimum 2 years of related experience in supply chain, materials management, planning, procurement, logistics, or a closely related field.
* Working knowledge of supply-chain concepts, material planning, inventory concepts, and inbound-material processes.
* Ability to gather, manage, analyze, and translate data into actionable information.
* Basic to intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and charts or graphs.
* Experience working with SAP Materials Management or a comparable enterprise resource-planning system.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, meet deadlines, manage commitments, and work effectively in a collaborative environment.
* Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Full-time master’s degree from an accredited university, preferably in supply chain, operations, logistics, business, engineering, or a related discipline.
* Two or more years of relevant experience in supply chain, materials management, planning, procurement, logistics, or analytics.
* Experience supporting manufacturing plants or global supply-chain teams.
* Experience with supply-chain analytics, inventory recommendations, material-disruption recovery, or continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder-management, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work through ambiguity.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Analyze macroeconomic variables and understand the impact to financial projections

* Drive efficiencies and process improvements and support technology initiatives

* Help build reusable tooling and reference implementations that accelerate development by application and vertical engineering teams.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

title: D&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Digital and Technology team of General Mills India Centre is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual to contribute to the Global Digital Transformation initiative at General Mills in capacity of a D&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship. This role will report into Sr. D&T Manager - Data Stewardship, GDGS team in India and functionally collaborate with stakeholders across the Enterprise teams. It is an Individual contributor role. We are seeking a detail-oriented and forward-thinking Data Steward to support the development and governance of data powering
**agentic AI systems**
—AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making and task execution. This role ensures data quality, integrity, compliance, and usability across the lifecycle of intelligent agents. This role will work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, product teams, and governance stakeholders to maintain trustworthy, well-structured, and ethically managed datasets that drive reliable agent behaviour.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Define and implement data quality rules (schema validation, referential integrity, distribution checks, drift detection) using Data Quality tools.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to define and monitor data quality metrics (accuracy, completeness, consistency) essential for high-performing, unbiased AI agents and their tools.
* Monitor dataset health metrics (null ratios, entropy, cardinality, outliers) and set up alerting mechanisms.
* Implement end-to-end data lineage across ingestion → transformation → feature stores → model inputs → agent outputs.
* Use observability tools (Monte Carlo, etc) to trace data dependencies impacting agent decisions
* Support root cause analysis of agent failures linked to upstream data issues.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Legal/Compliance, and Business Process Owners regarding all data-related aspects of Agentic AI solutions.
* Maintain data catalogs and semantic layers (Collibra, Alation, etc)
* Ensure interoperability across structured data and unstructured data.
* Ensure all data practices related to Agentic AI comply with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA), paying close attention to the unique compliance risks of autonomous data use
* Establish and enforce data governance policies, standards, and procedures uniquely tailored for AI agents, including data collection, usage, sharing, and retention protocols specific to autonomous and multi-agent systems.
* Enforce data access controls, masking, and PII handling in accordance with regulations.
* Maintain audit trails for data used in agent decisions (critical for explainability and compliance).
* Develop and execute procedures for Annual Attestation for Unstructured Data Management Plans (DMP) and Agentic AI Data Management Plans (ADMPs)
* Support DMP/ADMP automation initiatives across BQ, Agentic AI, and other applicable areas of data governance
* Establish audit compliance methodology and communication processes (e.g., all data sources/agents have DMP/ADMP, cataloguing of all AI agents, attestation completion)

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of total experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python for data processing
* Experience with Data Modeling, schema design and data validation frameworks.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Data Governance strategies and processes
* Experience with Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Data Observability, Data versioning, End to End Process mindset, Lineage.
* Exposure to Database Technologies (GCP, Cloud, etc)
* Exposure to Agile Methodologies (ADO, etc)
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change within their domain
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience and competence in leading, influencing, coaching and mentoring others
* Attention to detail with the ability to identify patterns and inconsistencies

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Lead components of delivery, under guidance from managers, providing input to the subscription analysis reports produced by Argus Media Analytics.

* Intellectually curious and able to demonstrate structured problem solving and analytical skills.

title: Agentic AI Builder
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today, our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We are optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide from offices in many countries. Our AI and Data teams combine data science, generative AI, and engineering to take solutions from proof of concept to large-scale deployment.

Our Mumbai office launched in 2024. We are building the team with people who want to shape something from the ground up, combining the agility of a start-up with the backing and reach of a global brand. The AI Factory in Mumbai builds and delivers production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across North America, Europe and the Middle East.

**Job Description**

Generative AI is moving from assistants that answer questions to agents that do work. The Agentic AI Builder designs, builds and industrialises AI agents and multi-agent workflows for Sia's enterprise clients, and helps users adopt them. You will turn real business processes into agents that perform reliably in production.
  
  
This is agent engineering, not prompt writing or chatbot configuration. You will work with Forward Deployed Engineers, architects, consultants, and client teams, and you are expected to reason about orchestration, state, tools, evaluation, security, and cost, and to show with tests and measurements that an agent works.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with consultants and business teams to identify agent use cases and translate business processes into clear agent requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Design agent architectures for business workflows, deciding when a single agent, a multi-agent pattern or a deterministic workflow with LLM steps is the right choice.
* Implement orchestration, tool calling and control flow in Python using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, the Claude Agent SDK or OpenAI SDK, or custom code where that is the better choice.
* Build tools and connectors to enterprise APIs and data sources, including MCP servers, with clear schemas, error handling and permissioning.
* Engineer context deliberately: retrieval over enterprise data, prompt and context design, and state and memory management across steps and sessions.
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approvals, escalation and exception handling.
* Create evaluation suites covering task success, tool-use correctness, regressions and adversarial cases, and use them to guide each release.
* Add observability, including traces, token and cost tracking and failure analytics, and optimise for reliability, latency and cost.
* Implement guardrails such as input and output validation, scoped credentials, prompt-injection defenses, and data-access controls.
* Work in agile, iterative cycles: estimate effort, flag risks and dependencies early, run solution demonstrations, and document agent behaviour and limits.
* Prepare agents for production with the FDE and architecture team, including deployment, monitoring, and operational handover.

**Internal Contributions**
  
As part of the AI Factory, you will also:

* Package reusable tools, connectors, and agent patterns that speed up later projects.
* Contribute to internal accelerators, demonstrations, and proposals.
* Share knowledge on agent design, evaluation, and guardrails with the wider engineering team.

**Qualifications**

**Education and experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 to 6 years of software or AI engineering experience.
* At least one agent or LLM workflow delivered beyond proof of concept, with evidence of how it was tested and measured.
* Professional English, written and spoken.

**Technical skills (required)**

* Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, packaging, typing and asynchronous programming.
* Hands-on experience building agents with tool calling and orchestration using at least one agent framework or SDK (LangGraph, LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI SDK or equivalent). Experience with every named framework is not expected.
* Understanding of agent state, memory and control flow, including retries, timeouts and failure recovery.
* Practical experience with RAG and vector search, and with context and prompt engineering as part of a larger system.
* Experience evaluating LLM and agent behaviour with test sets, automated checks or LLM-as-judge methods.
* Familiarity with LLM observability and tracing, and with tracking cost and latency.
* Experience integrating agents with enterprise APIs, databases or SaaS applications.
* Awareness of agent-specific risks, including prompt injection, excessive tool permissions and data leakage, and how guardrails address them.
* Cloud deployment fundamentals: containers, environment configuration and CI/CD.

**Consulting and collaboration**

* Ability to explain technical decisions and limits clearly to engineers, architects, and non-technical colleagues. Comfort running solution demonstrations and gathering feedback from business users.
* Ownership of the components you build and the ability to work with geographically distributed teams.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or hosting an MCP server.
* Experience with multi-agent patterns such as planner and executor, supervisor, or handoff designs.
* Experience with automation platforms such as n8n or Microsoft Copilot Studio alongside code-first approaches.
* Exposure to model routing, fine-tuning, or model selection trade-offs.
* FastAPI or other backend service experience; Kubernetes and infrastructure as code basics.Experience in a regulated sector or collaboration with international teams and clients.

**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on production AI for global enterprise clients, as part of a growing AI engineering capability.
* The chance to learn through real client implementations and to build reusable agent assets for the AI Factory.
* Access to Sia's leadership and training programmes as you grow.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working across varied projects and industries.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)
  
  
  
  
Equal Opportunity**
  
Sia is an equal opportunity employer. Decisions on hiring, promotion, remuneration and discipline are made solely on performance, competence, conduct and business needs.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

The Scientist 1 will lead research and development initiatives focused on developing, optimising, and validating NGS-based molecular diagnostic assays for pathogen detection and antimicrobial resistance profiling. The role will involve both wet-lab research and dry-lab bioinformatics, including metagenomics, microbial genomics, and human genomics data analysis. The incumbent will drive scientific innovation, independently manage research projects, guide technical teams, and ensure the development of reliable, clinically relevant genomic diagnostic solutions. The role will also involve scientific communication, technical training, and staying abreast of advancements in sequencing technologies and molecular diagnostics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and optimisation of NGS-based molecular assays for pathogen detection and antimicrobial resistance profiling using long-read sequencing platforms.
* Develop and optimise nucleic acid extraction protocols from microbial cultures, clinical samples, and sterile body fluids.
* Design and execute in-vitro experiments, assay development, and analytical validation studies.
* Oversee sample preparation, library preparation, sequencing, and operation of advanced laboratory instruments.
* Develop and optimise bioinformatics pipelines for NGS data analysis, covering metagenomics, microbial genomics, and human genomics.
* Perform genomic data analysis, including pathogen identification, antimicrobial resistance profiling, variant calling, annotation, and interpretation.
* Integrate wet-lab and dry-lab workflows to improve genomic analysis and diagnostic assay performance.
* Lead R&D projects, define research objectives, monitor progress, and drive scientific innovation.
* Manage, mentor, and train research scientists and technical personnel in molecular biology, NGS, and bioinformatics.
* Maintain experimental records, validation protocols, quality control documents, and technical reports.
* Communicate research findings through scientific presentations, publications, and reports.
* Conduct NGS training workshops for technical staff, clients, and students.
* Monitor advancements in sequencing technologies, molecular diagnostics, and bioinformatics.
* Manage research budgets, laboratory inventory, procurement, and utilisation of resources.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Genomics, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related discipline.
* 0-2 years of relevant experience in molecular diagnostics, NGS-based research, genomics, or R&D.
* Strong hands-on experience in molecular biology techniques, assay development, and sequencing technologies.
* Experience with long-read sequencing platforms such as Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) or PacBio. Experience with short-read sequencing technologies like Illumina or MGI platforms is an added advantage.
* Expertise in metagenomics, microbial genomics, and antimicrobial resistance analysis.
* Desirable to have knowledge of human genomics, including variant analysis, annotation, and interpretation.
* Experience in developing and optimising bioinformatics pipelines for NGS data analysis.
* Proficiency in Python, R, and/or Bash, along with Linux-based computational environments.
* Knowledge of bioinformatics tools, genomic databases, sequence alignment, genome assembly, and variant calling.
* Experience in research project leadership, team management, scientific documentation, and technical presentations.

title: Research Development Lead
description:
**Shudh Shodh: Research Lead**

**Location: Mumbai, India (Hybrid / Field-based)**

**Position Type: Full-Time**

**Reports To: Co-Founder & CEO, Brain Bristle**

**About Brain Bristle & Shudh Shodh**

Today, 1 in every 68 children under the age of 10 is diagnosed on the autism spectrum

(~3 million children) and there’s more than 8 million children and adolescents diagnosed

with an intellectual disability. In low-income schools across India, specialist support for

autistic or Intellectually Disabled (ID) students is almost nonexistent. Brain Bristle works

to bridge this gap, because every child belongs in the classroom.

We drive impact toward intervention through three core programmes:

1. The Social Work Fellowship: Selecting and training graduates from psychology,

counseling, teaching and social work, placing them in low-income Mumbai

schools for a full year of embedded education and inclusion work through

remedial pull outs, classroom interventions, teacher partnerships, and parent

engagement.

2. Modules of Learning for Inclusion: A 2-year hybrid of digital and in-person

training and inclusion advisory program reaching low income schools across

Mumbai and Jaipur. Delivering bi-monthly e-modules covering autism,

DSM-5-TR, ABA applications, curriculum adaptations, specialist teacher training

alongside institutional advisory to build sustainable inclusive systems.

3. Advocacy and Awareness: Running free, open community webinars, public

talks, lectures, workshops and short films to make knowledge accessible,

challenge stigma at scale, and bring the realities of autistic and ID children

across communities to wider attention.

**Shudh Shodh**
is Brain Bristle’s new work stream, a dedicated research and

knowledge-building vertical. It addresses the systemic research gap in inclusion and

education of autism and ID in India through field evaluations, white papers, policy briefs,

and evidence-based frameworks, translating ground-level data from our programmes

into scalable prototypes and systemic levers of change.

**Role Overview**

As the Research Lead, you will head Shudh Shodh, leading the design, execution, and

synthesis of research initiatives across our partner schools and programmes. You will

bridge high-rigor academic methodology with compassionate, participatory field

practice, transforming ground-level data and classroom insights into white papers,

evidence-backed advocacy tools, films, campaigns and policy-level briefs focused on

the inclusion and education of children with autism and ID.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Strategic Research & Portfolio Management (Shudh Shodh)

● Research Agenda: Lead and execute the research strategy for Shudh Shodh,

mapping field evidence from inclusive classrooms in Mumbai into actionable

publications.

● White Papers & Advocacy: Author high-quality white papers, impact studies,

and policy briefs focused on autism and ID, early identification, inclusive

pedagogy, and system-level inclusion in low-income schools.

● Prototypes & Toolkits: Translate research findings into replicable prototypes,

films, campaigns, training toolkits, and support for our Modules of Learning for

educators, schools, and non-profit partners.

2. Field Data Architecture & Impact Evaluation

● Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E): Collaborate with the Social Work Fellowship

team to build data tools tracking Individualized Educational Plans (IEPs),

behavioral shifts, curriculum progress, and academic/social integration

outcomes.

● Mixed-Methods Research: Design qualitative and quantitative methodologies

(surveys, interviews, classroom observations, action research) that respect

individuals and uphold participant dignity.

● Ethical Standards: Maintain strict protocols for data collection, informed

consent, confidentiality, and child safeguarding across all partner school sites.

3. Academic Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

● Academic Collaborations: Build research partnerships with university

departments (Special Education, Psychology, Social Work, Public Health) in India

and globally.

● Dissemination: Represent Brain Bristle at research symposia, conferences,

seminars, screenings, and policy discussions to drive public awareness and

institutional change.

● Funder & Board Reporting: Synthesize research data into impact metrics for

institutional donors, board decks, and annual reports.

Qualifications & Key Requirements

● Educational Background: Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Special Education,

Applied Psychology, Development Studies, Social Work, Education Policy, or a

related discipline.

● Experience: 4–7+ years of research experience, with a track record in field

research, mixed-methods evaluation, and publishing white papers or

peer-reviewed literature in education, autism, or intellectual disabilities.

● Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD),

Intellectual Disabilities (ID), inclusive educational methodologies, DSM-5-TR, and

the grassroots education ecosystem in India.

● Data & Tooling Competency: Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative analysis

tools (e.g., SPSS, R, NVivo, or Atlas.ti) as well as field data collection platforms.

● Ethical Commitment: Commitment to dignity-affirming practices, participatory

action research (PAR), and child safeguarding standards.

● Communication: Exceptional written and oral communication skills in English

and working knowledge of Hindi or Marathi for field engagement.

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

● Publication and Production: Publishing 1–2 flagship white papers, support with

production of an awareness film and a campaign under Shudh Shodh on

inclusion and educational outcomes for autism and ID in low-income school

environments.

● Data Integration: Establishing a streamlined data collection loop connecting

ground Social Work Fellow observations (IEP progress, curriculum level jumps)

directly to research metrics.

● Framework Development: Producing 1–2 evidence-backed toolkits or modules

for wider distribution across educational institutions and partner networks.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can send their CV, a cover letter expressing their interest in the

research & writing for the autism, ID, and inclusion space, and 1–2 relevant writing

samples or published research papers or other research backed work to

hr@brainbristle.org

**Compensation:**
Between ₹9-10 Lakhs Per Annum (based on experience)

Brain Bristle is committed to salary transparency. Remuneration is fixed, fair, and reviewed annually based on foundation milestones.

title: Lead Growth
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About the Role**
The Digital Growth team at IDFC FIRST Bank shapes how the Bank engages with its existing customers through digital channels. The team’s work spans all businesses across the Bank. The Growth Lead will define and deliver the growth strategy across these businesses and will be accountable for the outcomes.
  
  
The role is suited to a digital-first professional who can bring structure to ambiguous problems and align senior stakeholders around a common plan.
  
  
The Growth Lead will also help shape how HPE adopts AI and emerging technologies in the way it plans, executes, and measures its work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Strategy and Business Outcomes
  
  

* Define the growth strategy and annual plan for HPE initiatives across the Bank’s businesses, aligned with the Bank’s overall objectives.
* Take ownership of business outcomes, measured through controlled experiments rather than channel metrics such as opens and clicks.
* Prioritise initiatives based on expected impact and review performance regularly, redirecting effort and budget where results fall short.

Customer Engagement
  
  

* Design customer journeys across WhatsApp, email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging that respond to customer behaviour at each stage of the relationship.
* Partner with Analytics and Data Science teams to define customer segments and determine the most relevant engagement strategy for each.
* Set and uphold standards for communication frequency and relevance, ensuring that customer experience is never compromised for short-term results.

Experimentation and Insights
  
  

* Own the experimentation agenda for HPE, ensuring every test starts with a clear hypothesis and concludes with a clear decision.
* Translate learnings into practical recommendations and ensure they inform future planning.

AI and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Identify opportunities to apply AI across the growth process, including predictive targeting, next-best-action models, content generation, and performance analysis.
* Lead pilots with Technology and Data teams and scale use cases that demonstrate value, with appropriate governance for accuracy, compliance, and brand consistency.
* Stay abreast of developments in marketing technology and bring an informed point of view to leadership discussions.

Stakeholder and Programme Management
  
  

* Build strong working relationships with Product, Analytics, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Business teams, bringing them together around shared priorities.
* Plan and manage cross-functional initiatives end to end, including scope, timelines, dependencies, and ownership.
* Present performance, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and candour, including learnings from initiatives that did not deliver the expected outcomes.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Education**

* Graduation: Any discipline
* Post-graduation: MBA or equivalent preferred

**Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in growth, lifecycle/CRM marketing, digital marketing, or product roles.
* A proven track record of delivering growth outcomes for a digital, consumer-facing business at scale. Experience in banking, fintech, telecom, e-commerce, or consumer internet businesses is relevant.
* Hands-on experience with customer engagement platforms and experimentation frameworks.

**Skills And Attributes**
We are looking for a professional who combines sound judgement with the ability to bring people together. How the candidate thinks and works matters more than familiarity with any specific tool.
  
  

* Digital-first thinking: Approaches growth through the lens of customer behaviour and data, treating every customer journey as something to be measured and improved.
* Strategic judgement: Connects growth initiatives to business outcomes and makes sound decisions on where to invest time and budget.
* Critical thinking: Identifies the real drivers behind performance, whether the issue lies in targeting or the journey itself, and tests conclusions before acting on them.
* Experimentation discipline: Designs controlled tests with clear hypotheses and can distinguish genuine results from noise.
* AI fluency: Uses AI tools in day-to-day work and has an informed view on where AI adds value to growth and where it introduces risk.
* Stakeholder management: Builds trust across functions and gains alignment from teams outside their reporting line, escalating appropriately when required.
* Customer focus: Balances business goals with customer trust and represents the customer’s interests in decision-making.

title: Performance & Growth Manager
description:

At The Network, you won't be optimizing someone else's playbook. You'll help write it. You'll work closely with leadership, have real ownership over strategy and budget, and help build a new kind of community for India's professionals and business leaders.

In office at Andheri West, Mumbai, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 7 PM, with Saturdays working from home, 11 AM to 5 PM (6-day week).

Conduct primary and secondary research to support assignment-based and ad-hoc research queries. **Requirements:**
**Being Analytical**
You will be working with large datasets, creating new research pieces by using various research tools and working on existing databases and looking to create new ones. title: TM-Loan Originations - Underwriting
description:
US Mortgage Loan Originations Underwriting
  
  
**Job Summary**
This role focuses on managing and optimizing loan origination processes in a night shift work from office model while applying strong expertise in MS Excel to analyze data track pipeline metrics and improve operational efficiency across pre underwriting and underwriting activities in order to deliver accurate and timely credit decisions for a global financial services environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage end to end loan origination workflows to ensure accurate intake data validation and timely progression of applications across all internal checkpoints in a structured and compliant manner.
* Analyze large volumes of loan application data in MS Excel to identify patterns detect anomalies and generate insights that support higher quality credit evaluation and operational decision making.

* Use knowledge of pre underwriting practices to assess initial applicant information verify basic documentation and flag missing elements that may delay downstream underwriting steps.
* Use familiarity with underwriting concepts to better interpret risk perspectives credit policies and documentation standards while preparing case files and data summaries.
* Demonstrate the ability to operate effectively in a night shift work from office environment while maintaining focus attention to detail and reliable communication with cross functional partners.
* Exhibit advanced analytical thinking problem solving skills and comfort with financial data so that process issues and outliers are quickly recognized and addressed.
* Show capability to document processes follow established guidelines and contribute practical ideas that enhance customer experience and societal trust in lending activities.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include credit risk or loan processing courses and recognized training in advanced MS Excel or data analysis.
