title: System Administrator – Python for Data Science
Quant Trader / Researcher – Options & Systematic Derivatives
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Quant Trader / Researcher**
to design, research, backtest, and trade systematic options strategies across NSE and BSE.
  
  
This is a
**research-to-trading role**
where you will own ideas end-to-end—from identifying market behaviour and developing hypotheses to backtesting, live deployment, and monitoring real P&L.
  
  
The primary focus will be on
**weekly index and liquid stock options**
, with particular emphasis on volatility, Greeks, expiry behaviour, market microstructure, and systematic signal generation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, backtest, and trade systematic options strategies across Nifty, Bank Nifty, FinNifty, Sensex and liquid stock options.
* Research the behaviour of Delta, Gamma, Theta and Vega across weekly expiry cycles.
* Develop strategies around theta decay, gamma dynamics, expiry-day behaviour, pinning and volatility dislocations.
* Research implied volatility surfaces, term structure, skew, IV crush and realised-vs-implied volatility.
* Generate and evaluate signals using technical, derivatives and market-microstructure data.
* Work with datasets including Open Interest, PCR, OI changes, basis, price/volume and intraday data.
* Use statistical modelling, time-series analysis and machine learning for signal generation, regime detection and risk-reward estimation.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting across different market regimes, time periods and volatility conditions.
* Identify overfitting, look-ahead bias, survivorship bias and other research pitfalls.
* Translate validated research into live trading strategies in collaboration with trading and technology teams.
* Monitor live strategy performance, risk, exposures and P&L and recommend improvements where required.
* Continuously research new systematic opportunities and improve existing strategies.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in options trading, quantitative research or systematic derivatives trading.
* Hands-on experience trading or researching Indian options markets.
* Strong understanding of options pricing, Greeks, volatility and derivatives strategy construction.
* Good understanding of NSE/BSE market structure and weekly expiry mechanics.
* Strong Python skills with experience in Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn and/or Polars.
* Strong foundation in statistics, probability, time-series analysis and quantitative modelling.
* Experience working with large historical and/or intraday market datasets.
* Ability to clean, transform and engineer features from financial market data.
* Experience with backtesting frameworks or quantitative research infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of Sharpe ratio, drawdown, Calmar ratio, hit rate, exposure and risk-adjusted returns.
* Ability to independently take a research idea from hypothesis through backtesting and, ultimately, live deployment.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, research-driven environment.

**Preferred / Good To Have**

* Experience in volatility modelling or volatility trading.
* Experience with options market-making or systematic execution.
* Experience applying machine learning to trading strategies.
* Experience building a backtesting framework or research infrastructure from scratch.
* Experience with order-flow and market-microstructure signals.
* Experience trading or researching expiry-day strategies.
* Familiarity with high-frequency or tick-level data.

What We Offer
  
  

* Opportunity to work on systematic strategies across some of the world’s most liquid derivatives markets.
* Direct ownership of research ideas that translate into live positions and real P&L.
* Exposure to quantitative research, live trading, technology and risk management.
* A high-performance environment that values rigorous research over shortcuts.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced traders, researchers and technologists.
* Scope to build and influence Northstar’s systematic trading capabilities from the ground up.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate is
**not just a trader or just a researcher**
. We are looking for someone who understands options deeply, thinks quantitatively, can code and backtest independently, and is comfortable taking ownership from
**idea → research → validation → live strategy → performance monitoring**
.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai

3–5 years

Quantitative Trading / Research
  
  
**Employment:**
Full-Time

title: Intelligence & Insights – Manager / Senior Analyst
description:
TRYST, IIT Bombay, is looking for talented professionals to join its
**Intelligence & Insights team**
at two levels –
**Manager (5–7 years)**
and
**Senior Analyst (2–3 years)**
.

This is an exciting opportunity for professionals from management consulting, industry research, strategy, technology intelligence and analytics backgrounds who are passionate about understanding emerging industries, technological developments and the future of innovation.

The selected professionals will work at the intersection of
**frontier research, industry strategy, technology, investment and national priorities**
, helping shape TRYST's perspective on India's evolving industrial and technological landscape.

**Key Focus Areas**

The Intelligence & Insights team will work across the following domains:

* Healthcare & Life Sciences
* Semiconductors & Electronics
* Energy & Clean Technology
* Climate & Sustainability
* AI & Digital Technologies

AI and digital technologies will also be explored as cross-industry enablers across TRYST's priority sectors.

**Role 1: Manager – Intelligence & Insights**

The Manager will lead industry, technology and innovation intelligence across TRYST's priority domains, developing strategic perspectives and identifying opportunities that connect industry challenges with IIT Bombay's research strengths.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead industry, technology and innovation intelligence, covering market structures, industry segments, value chains, emerging technologies and frontier research.
* Develop five-year and ten-year industry outlooks, scenarios and strategic assessments.
* Evaluate India's competitive positioning, strategic dependencies and capability gaps against leading global economies, companies and research institutions.
* Identify high-value technology challenges across industries and connect them with IIT Bombay's research capabilities.
* Evaluate the innovation and investment landscape, including public research funding, deep-tech venture capital, corporate R&D and commercialisation barriers.
* Prepare industry outlook reports, white papers, strategic presentations and executive briefings for senior stakeholders.
* Engage with CXOs, R&D leaders, founders, investors, policymakers and faculty to validate and strengthen industry perspectives.
* Lead, mentor and develop the team of analysts while establishing research frameworks, methodologies and quality standards.

**Role 2: Senior Analyst – Intelligence & Insights**

**Experience: 2–3 Years**

The Senior Analyst will lead research and intelligence on AI & Digital Technologies while supporting the broader industry intelligence agenda across TRYST's priority sectors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct in-depth research on industries, technologies and markets, developing structured views of industry segments, sub-segments and value chains.
* Develop market models and analytical assessments to evaluate market size, growth opportunities and strategic dependencies.
* Track emerging technologies, frontier research, startups and investment activities to identify opportunities for research translation and commercialization.
* Contribute to five-year and ten-year industry outlooks, comparative assessments and global best-practice studies.
* Analyse India's position across relevant technology and industry segments, identifying areas where India leads, lags or depends on global capabilities.
* Synthesise research findings into high-quality reports, presentations, briefs and publications.
* Support engagements and interactions with industry leaders, investors, policymakers and faculty.
* Build expertise in AI and digital technologies while contributing to intelligence across healthcare, semiconductors, energy and climate-related domains.

**Preferred Candidate Profile – Applicable to Both Roles**

We are particularly interested in candidates with:

* Experience in management consulting, strategy consulting, industry research, market intelligence, research and analytics, corporate strategy, or R&D and product-related roles.
* Exposure to direct client and stakeholder interactions, including industry leaders and senior decision-makers.
* Strong experience in primary research, industry analysis, market intelligence and gathering insights through stakeholder engagements.
* Industry exposure in one or more of the following areas:
* Semiconductors & Electronics
* Energy & Clean Technology
* Healthcare & Life Sciences
* Climate & Sustainability
* Understanding of technology trends, innovation ecosystems, product development, technology commercialisation and emerging deep-tech opportunities.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving and research capabilities.
* Excellent communication, report writing, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Educational Qualifications

**Manager:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science.
* MBA or an advanced degree from a leading institution is preferred.

**Senior Analyst:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science or Pharmacy.
* Master's degree or MBA will be an advantage.

**Why Join TRYST – IIT Bombay?**

* Shape where one of India's leading research institutions directs its research translation efforts.
* Work at the intersection of frontier science, industry strategy, capital and national priorities.
* Gain direct exposure to industry leaders, investors, policymakers and world-class faculty.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives that connect cutting-edge research with industry needs and real-world opportunities.

title: Commercial Planning Manager
description:
**Position**
- Manager – Planning & Commercial

**Location**
- BKC, Mumbai

**Experience-**
7–10 years in retail planning and commercial operations, including team supervision.

**Industry**
- Retail/FMCD

**Education**
-Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Finance, Business Administration or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Job Purpose**

Drive planning and commercial management for Samsung’s D2C COCO retail business through annual planning, performance analysis, inventory availability, expense management and financial controls. Partner with the GM & Business Head – D2C COCO on P&L planning and tracking, supporting revenue and profitability objectives through coordination with Operations, Finance, Marketing, category teams and Head Office.

**Purpose of Role and Key Deliverables**

Manage business planning and commercial processes, ensuring timely reporting, stock readiness, cost discipline and compliance. Key responsibilities include:

**Business Planning and Reporting**

**1. AOP and Business Performance**

• Prepare the AOP covering category-wise sales, margins, OPEX and inventory; phase targets into monthly, weekly and daily plans.

• Drive P&L planning and tracking in partnership with the GM & Business Head – D2C COCO; analyse variances, update forecasts and follow through on corrective actions.

• Assess the revenue, margin and inventory impact of pricing, promotion and product-mix recommendations.

**2. MIS, Business Tools and Management Reviews**

• Prepare and present AOP and weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual business reviews, highlighting performance, risks and actions.

• Maintain the Stock Tracker, Affordability Tracker, Weekly Sales Review dashboard and CRM MIS; ensure refresh, validation and Monday delivery of weekly reporting.

• Reconcile data before reporting; train Operations on the tools and build standard templates suitable for future COCO stores.

**Inventory Management**

**3. Forecasting, Replenishment and Launch Readiness**

• Forecast category- and SKU-level demand and submit monthly requisitions. Plan replenishment in sequence: store stock, STO from warehouse, Estore virtual stock, then fresh demand; ensure timely receipts.

• Maintain appropriate weeks of stock cover, especially during launches and promotions; address stock-outs, ageing and excess inventory.

•Coordinate with product managers, supply teams and Operations on launch stock, demo availability and timely display readiness.

**4. Stock Control and Warehouse Coordination**

• Oversee stock records, transfers, returns, physical verification and system reconciliations; coordinate stock flow and documentation with warehouse and logistics teams.

• Investigate discrepancies and initiate stock adjustments, recovery proposals and insurance claims through approved processes

**Financial and Commercial Management**

**5. Offers and Head Office Coordination**

• Coordinate approved offers with category teams; proactively communicate bank offers, cashback, EMI/finance schemes, discounts, eligibility and validity through the Affordability Tracker before implementation.

• Monitor execution and commercial impact; resolve discrepancies and track claims, settlements and Head Office dependencies.

**6. Financial Controls, Reconciliations and Compliance**

• Ensure billing, cash, card and digital collections reconcile with system records and settlements; investigate day-end variances and track outstanding items to closure.

• Process NEFT refund RFAs and other commercial requests; review gift card reconciliations and replenishment, approving only within delegated authority.

• Maintain audit-ready records and close audit findings; coordinate cash, POS, inventory and loss-prevention controls with Operations, cashier and security teams.

**7. OPEX, Cost Management and Mall Coordination**

• Manage all operating expense budgets; prepare proposals and business justifications and obtain required management approvals.

• Track committed and actual costs against budget, explain variances and implement cost-control measures, monitoring savings and service standards.

• Oversee invoice checks, expense documentation and payment follow-ups; coordinate with Jio World Plaza on lease obligations, CAM, marketing fund charges and related reconciliations.

**Administration and Team Management**

**8. Team and Administrative Oversight**

• Manage assigned planning, MIS, inventory and administration personnel; set priorities, review delivery, coach staff and maintain process documentation and backup coverage.

• Oversee administrative services, vendors and facility requirements with Operations; follow through on service obligations, renewals and identified safety or maintenance gaps

**Skills:**
Advanced formula-led Excel modelling and dashboards without macros (lookups, pivots, dynamic ranges and data validation); SAMS/SAP, POS, large sales-data extracts and PowerPoint.

**Attributes:**
Analytical judgement, accuracy, ownership, integrity, clear presentation skills and mature stakeholder management.

The

**(CIR)**
is part of Deloitte’s Research & Insights organization within the Clients, Strategy & Growth function. CIR develops research on complex and emerging business issues that cut across industries, functions, technologies, and broader economic and societal trends.
  
  
Our work brings together perspectives from multiple domains to help business leaders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how they should respond. The role requires strong research and analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to quickly build familiarity with unfamiliar topics. The candidate should be comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative evidence and translating complex information into clear, differentiated business insights.
  
  
CIR deliverables include research reports, articles, surveys, case studies, data-driven analyses, executive briefings, presentations, and other thought-leadership content.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Specialist, you will be expected to:
  
  

* Conduct primary and secondary research across a broad range of business, technology, economic, workforce, and societal topics.
* Quickly develop familiarity with new subject areas and synthesize information from multiple sources into clear research findings and insights.
* Support the development of research proposals, hypotheses, research questions, methodologies, and project plans.

* Use generative AI and other research tools to improve research discovery, analysis, synthesis, and writing while ensuring appropriate validation of sources and findings.
* Contribute to horizon scanning and sensing activities to identify emerging trends, technologies, business models, and other developments relevant to CIR’s research agenda.
* Work closely with U.S. and global colleagues, researchers, subject-matter experts, and other internal stakeholders to incorporate feedback and support project priorities.
* Support senior researchers in preparing for executive briefings, webinars, internal discussions, and client-facing conversations.
* Manage assigned activities and deliverables to agreed quality standards and project timelines.

**Experience**
**Requisite Experience and Skills**

* 3–6 years of experience in business research, thought leadership, strategy research, market intelligence, consulting research, academic research, or a related field.
* Experience contributing to research projects involving complex or emerging business issues.
* Experience working with U.S. or global teams and stakeholders is preferred.

* Strong primary and secondary research skills, with experience in one or more areas such as surveys, interviews, quantitative analysis, qualitative research, case-study research, or academic research.

* Ability to work across diverse topics and quickly develop a working understanding of unfamiliar subject areas.
* Strong synthesis skills, with the ability to connect findings across multiple sources and domains.

* Ability to work with quantitative and qualitative datasets and communicate findings through effective charts and visualizations.
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Python, R, or similar analytical tools is an advantage.

**Writing And Communication Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to develop clear, concise, evidence-based content for senior business audiences.
* Strong narrative writing skills and experience contributing to research reports, articles, presentations, or similar content.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple and structured manner.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to incorporate feedback from researchers, subject-matter experts, and senior stakeholders.

**Generative AI and Emerging Research Tools**

* Proficiency in using generative AI tools for research discovery, synthesis, analysis, and business writing.
* Understanding of the need to validate AI-generated information, sources, data, and conclusions.
* Experience using generative AI or other tools for horizon scanning and identification of emerging signals is preferred.

team conducts research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to what is coming next.

title: Institutional Equity Division - Vice President, Quantitative Researcher – Algorithmic Trading (Mumbai)
description:
**Company Profile**
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.
  
  
As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.
  
  
**Department Profile**
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
Morgan Stanley's Equities Quantitative Research (QR) team develops quantitative models, trading strategies and technology that support the Firm's electronic trading business.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**Quantitative Researcher**
to join the team in Mumbai, focusing on research and development for
**Morgan Stanley Electronic Trading (MSET)'s algorithmic trading products**
.
  
  
The role will apply techniques and insights from
**high-frequency trading, market making and electronic market microstructure**
to improve algorithmic trading performance and execution outcomes. The successful candidate will combine rigorous quantitative research with strong software engineering skills and experience conducting realistic, high-fidelity simulations using
**full-depth, order-level market data**
.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Research and develop quantitative techniques to improve the performance, execution quality and trading outcomes of MSET's algorithmic trading products.
* Apply concepts from high-frequency trading and market making to algorithmic execution, including short-horizon price prediction, order placement, liquidity capture, fill probability, queue dynamics and adverse selection.
* Analyze large-scale full-depth order book and order-level (Level 3) market data to understand market behaviour and identify opportunities to improve trading decisions.
* Develop quantitative models, signals and features using order flow, liquidity, cross-asset information and other market data to forecast short-horizon market behaviour and improve execution decisions.
* Apply rigorous statistical techniques including time-series analysis, statistical inference and predictive modelling to evaluate research hypotheses and identify robust effects.
* Design and implement high-fidelity, event-driven simulations using historical order-level market data to evaluate trading strategies under realistic conditions, including appropriate modelling of queue position, fill behaviour, latency and transaction costs.
* Conduct cross-asset research, incorporating information from multiple instruments and order books to improve trading decisions and execution performance.
* Develop rigorous methodologies for measuring execution quality and trading performance, including transaction-cost analysis and evaluation against relevant execution benchmarks, while accounting for latency, market impact, transaction costs, adverse selection and simulation bias.
* Apply appropriate out-of-sample testing and validation methodologies to distinguish robust signals from overfitting and simulation artefacts.
* Translate successful research into high-performance implementations suitable for latency-sensitive production environments.
* Profile and optimize performance-critical code for latency, throughput and computational efficiency.
* Work closely with quantitative researchers, electronic traders and technology teams globally to take research from hypothesis and simulation through to production.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional quantitative R&D experience in high-frequency trading, electronic market making, algorithmic trading or a closely related systematic trading environment.
* Experience applying market microstructure concepts to real-world trading problems.
* Strong programming skills in a performant, low-latency language such as C++, Java or Rust, including experience developing efficient, performance-critical software.
* Strong proficiency in Python or a comparable quantitative research environment for data analysis, modelling and rapid research iteration.
* Experience working with full-depth / Level 3 order book data and order-level market events, including analysis of detailed order-book state and dynamics.
* Experience developing or using event-driven market simulation and backtesting frameworks for high-frequency trading or execution research.
* Strong quantitative and statistical modelling skills, including experience with time-series analysis, statistical inference, predictive modelling and empirical research.
* Experience designing rigorous experiments and applying out-of-sample validation to evaluate predictive signals and guard against overfitting.
* Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Financial Engineering or another highly quantitative discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience researching algorithmic execution, smart order placement, liquidity capture, execution optimization or transaction-cost analysis.
* Experience applying techniques developed in an HFT or electronic market-making environment to broader algorithmic trading problems.
* Strong understanding of electronic market microstructure, including order-book dynamics, matching mechanics, queue position, liquidity, fill behaviour, adverse selection and market impact.
* Experience developing and evaluating quantitative trading strategies using cross-asset and cross-instrument information.
* Strong knowledge of modern C++, algorithms, memory management, concurrency and performance optimization.
* Experience working with very large event-level datasets and high-performance simulation or research infrastructure.

**The Candidate**
The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a
**quantitative researcher with strong software engineering ability**
. They will bring a deep understanding of how electronic markets behave at the order-book level and be able to translate that understanding into practical improvements in algorithmic trading.
  
  
We are particularly interested in candidates who can apply the sophisticated modelling, forecasting and simulation techniques used in high-frequency and market-making environments to
**improve execution decisions, trading performance and client outcomes across Morgan Stanley's electronic trading platform**
.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

description:

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. **Financial and Valuation Advisory**
Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.
  
  
**Transaction Advisory Services**
Houlihan Lokey’s Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) practice assists private equity and corporate clients with financial, IT and tax due diligence, business analytics, and technical accounting matters associated with corporate mergers, divestitures, and acquisitions (M&A). Drawing on Houlihan Lokey’s market leadership in middle-market M&A transactions, our due diligence experts provide candid, unbiased, and rigorous support on matters most impacting deal value, and assist investors in identifying and evaluating key value drivers and risk factors.
  
  
TAS India
  
  
TAS India covers Financial due diligence, Accounting and financial reporting and Digital value creation services. We have a highly integrated ‘one-team’ working model where TAS India team members are fully embedded into an engagement lifecycle - from client pitch to client discussions through closure. They have similar exposure to project complexities and client situations as their counterparts in the global TAS teams, and work in similar ownership and accountability construct. With a strong industry orientation and innovation-focused environment, we offer a unique proposition comprising best-in-class functional, industry and technology competencies along with an exposure to global M&A markets.

TAS is seeking talented professionals to join our fast-growing Digital Value Creation group (DVC) at the Associate level. DVC provides our clients value-creating insights from vast market, operational, and financial data. DVC professionals work closely with HL due diligence, valuation and investment banking teams alongside clients’ deal and operating teams. This opportunity provides you broad exposure to different transactional issues affecting businesses in an M&A environment.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity for someone with proficiency in data analytics along with experience in applying data analytics techniques to financial and operational analyses that is fundamental to an M&A process. DVC provides you ample exposure to the M&A and corporate finance industry and capital markets. Work experience

title: Senior Manager - Demand Planning, S& OP and Inventory Management
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Manager to own demand planning, S& OP and inventory management for
  
  
our portfolio of 7+ private beauty and personal care brands.
  
  
The business operates across eight channels — our own platform, general trade, modern trade, EBOs,
  
  
marketplaces, quick commerce and D2C
  
  
This is an ownership role. You will run forecasting and S&OP end to end, own network inventory health,
  
  
and build the planning system that lets the business grow without adding planners. It will suit someone
  
  
who has built a planning process from a weak base, not only operated a mature one.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Demand planning. Own the forecast at SKU, brand, channel and warehouse level. Build forecasting logic
  
  
that reflects how different brands actually behave — high-SKU seasonal makeup does not plan like
  
  
steady-demand hygiene. Run weekly demand sensing, track bias by channel, and complete the shift
  
  
from primary-sales to secondary-sales-based planning.
  
  
S&OP.
  
  
Run the monthly cycle end to end — demand consolidation, supply reconciliation, gap resolution
  
  
and executive review. Chair brand-level reviews with sales, brand and supply stakeholders, bringing
  
  
genuine challenge to the numbers rather than collating them. Own the constrained plan and its sign-off.
  
  
Inventory management. Own network inventory health and DOH at warehouse, brand and SKU level.
  
  
Set coverage norms and safety-stock logic rather than managing by exception. Reduce inventory without
  
  
trading away fill rate. Own liquidation and expiry control for a shelf-life-constrained portfolio.
  
  
Supply coordination. Convert the demand plan into a rolling procurement plan with manufacturing
  
  
partners — PO coverage, lead times, MOQ and capacity constraints — and manage supply risk with
  
  
named mitigations.
  
  
Systems and automation. Move recurring planning reporting onto automated pipelines with the
  
  
analytics team, and shape the forecasting toolset so planners spend their time on judgment rather than
  
  
assembly.
  
  
Team. Lead and develop team, and build a function that runs reliably whoever is in the room.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  

* 4-7 years in supply chain, with at least 2 years owning demand planning or S& OP as the

accountable person
  
  

* Multi-brand, multi-channel CPG, FMCG or beauty experience; beauty or personal care an

advantage
  
  

* Has planned across both offline distribution and e-commerce, not one or the other
* Has chaired S&OP with senior stakeholders and driven real decisions through it
* Strong grounding in statistical forecasting and inventory theory, with the judgment to know

when to override the model
  
  

* Strong Excel, SQL and Power BI or equivalent; exposure to a planning tool such as o9, Kinaxis,

Blue Yonder or Anaplan is plus
  
  

* MBA or equivalent preferred

The traits that matter most here: the instinct to build systems rather than carry a function personally,
  
  
the willingness to hold a position with commercial stakeholders when the forecast disagrees with them,
  
  
and comfort operating at speed in a business where process maturity is being built while the business
  
  
grows exponentially
  
  
**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

title: o9 EOP SP configurator
description:

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**
You provide software and application knowledge to support implementation of the given solutions.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
**Role Summary**
  
  
As the
**SP and IBP Configurator**
, you will be the technical linchpin for configuring, validating, and sustaining Mondelez’s o9 platform. You will translate business requirements into scalable planning models, ensuring seamless integration with enterprise systems like SAP and Oracle. This role demands expertise in o9’s data modelling, workflow design, and analytics tools to drive global supply chain transformation.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  
**Platform Configuration (SP , STD , TLB )**
  
  

* Configure o9’s Supply Planning, STD (Short Term Deployment), TLB (Truck Load Building) workflows to align with Mondelez’s global processes.
* Design Attribute-Based Hierarchies, Time Bucket Profiles, and Aggregation/Disaggregation Rules for multi-level planning (SKU, plant, region).
* Develop custom planning logic using o9’s planning engines (heuristics, time-series forecasting) and scripting tools (Python, R). o9 Data Model & Planning Engine Design
* Build master data structures (products, locations, customers) and key figures (demand signals, capacity constraints).
* Optimize pegging rules, supply allocation strategies, and exception management workflows, IBP Risk & Opportunities and S&OE adjustments.
* Configure Scenario Manager for what-if analysis (e.g., demand spikes, supply disruptions).

**Integration and Data Requirements**
  
  

* Design data pipelines using Talend, Kafka, or REST APIs to synchronize o9 with SAP ECC, APO, BPC, and external market data sources.
* Validate data quality through o9 Loader and troubleshoot integration errors in collaboration with IT teams.

**Scenario Management & Analytics**
  
  

* Develop interactive dashboards using o9’s KPI Engine to track forecast accuracy, service levels, and inventory turnover.
* Configure exception alerts for stockouts, excess inventory, and production bottlenecks.

**Testing, Validation, and Support**
  
  

* Execute unit testing, integration testing, and UAT for o9 configurations, ensuring alignment with business requirements.
* Resolve post-go-live issues via ServiceNow tickets and provide Level 2/3 support for planners.

**Documentation & Training**
  
  

* Create technical playbooks for configurations, including data mappings, calculation logic, and user permissions.
* Train regional planners

**More About This Role**
**Experience:**

* 3-5+ years of experience configuring o9 Planning Tool, with a focus on Demand Planning and/or Supply Planning modules.
* 3-5+ Years of experience in Implementing supply chain planning solutions or working in the supply chain/ logistics organization with focus on planning is preferred.
* Proven track record of successfully implementing/ supporting o9 in complex business environments.
* Experience with various o9 modules (e.g., Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Sales & Operations Planning) is highly desirable.
* Experience in CPG, Manufacturing industry is a plus.

No Relocation support available

title: Principal Engineer - Flood Risk Modelling
description:
**Job Description**
As Principal Engineer (Flood Risk Modelling) within our SWM Consulting (GCC) team, you will take responsibility to provide technical support, resource & financial management, mentoring and independently deliver flood modelling projects to ensure accurate and efficient project delivery for internal and external clients.
  
  
The role requirement includes leading projects based on hydraulic modelling and flood risk based studies using industry standard software (Flood Modeller Pro, Tuflow, Estry, HEC-RAS, Infoworks ICM 2D) as well as other projects requiring detailed technical analysis and providing support to junior colleagues.
  
  
You will be expected to have a strong background/working knowledge on 1d-2d hydraulic modelling, hydrological modelling, major flood alleviation schemes, highway infrastructure projects and GIS based analytical tools with a thorough understanding of the UK Water industry and legislation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Works collaboratively within the team and proactively supports junior staff in developing their technical knowledge and to independently deliver the tasks/projects.
* Excellent grasp on technical design procedures and standards, policy, contracts and specifications and technical software relevant to the UK water industry.
* Ability to recognise situations where tasks can be delegated to help develop others and improve time management.
* Demonstrable experience in checking and reviewing work produced by the technical team with a strong knowledge of reviewing/QA procedures on hydraulic modelling, hydrology and flood risk management based projects.
* Proactively contributes to the culture of safety, health and well-being of self and of individuals and the team; recognises the impact of what we do on the safety of others
* Demonstrable experience of leading/working collaboratively with a large team in the delivery of projects (or section of work on larger multi-disciplinary projects)
* Lead projects and large-frameworks and provide thorough guidance to junior colleagues on flood risk assessments, 1d-2d hydraulic modelling, hydrology, option appraisal studies and GIS based desk studies.
* Excellent working knowledge of analytical skills on hydraulics, hydrology and hydraulic design. Excellent GIS skills on data management and excellent working knowledge of QGIS, ArcGIS and/or Mapinfo.
* Ability to review detailed project reports and technical notes and an ability to guide junior staff on detailed technical writing.
* Demonstrable experience in application of Project Management procedures, BMS and proposal development. Strong experience of financial management of projects and an ability to monitor project financials, programme in adherence to BMS policies.
* Continuously upskill on the industry standards, specifications and tools used in the UK water sector and cascade the skills to junior colleagues.
* Working towards Chartership with ICE or CIWEM (Desirable)

**Qualifications**

* Masters Degree in Water Resources Engineering or equivalent.
* Strong prior experience on flood risk management based projects, hydraulic modelling, hydrology and preferably with exposure to UK policy, standards, specifications and software tools used in the UK Water Industry. A Minimum of 10+ years industry experience and UK market experience is required.
* Demonstrated experience of multiple domains/skillsets within flood risk management sector and UK Water Industry.

+ 1d-2d Hydraulic Modelling
+ Hydrological Modelling
+ Flood Risk Assessment
+ Detailed Technical Reviews and QA
+ Option Appraisal Studies, Flood Alleviation Schemes, Surface Water Management
+ Hydraulic Design
+ GIS based desk-studies
+ Detailed Project/Modelling Reporting
+ Project Management
+ Mentoring and Training Ability
+ Ability to support Bids & Fee Proposals

* Strong experience in multiple UK modelling software (Flood Modeller Pro, TUFLOW, Estry, Infoworks ICM, MIKE, HEC-RAS 1d-2d, QGIS, ArcGIS)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and MS Office and/or PowerBI
* Ability to independently lead/resolve issues on technical matters, strong background in collaborating with other design disciplines on multi-disciplinary projects.

* Experience mentoring teams and driving technical strategy across multiple projects.
* Familiarity with digital assets, financial technology (FinTech), trading platforms, tokenization, blockchain ecosystems, or related financial services domains is desirable

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

description:
**Job Description**
The Mortgage Loan Engineering Team within Global Banking & Markets (GBM Private) is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting robust, scalable applications for mortgage structured products on behalf of our businesses and clients. Our core focus is building highly scalable systems to drive and support the expansion of the lending business within the Capital Solutions Group (CSG) and GBM Private.
  
  
This dual-functional role offers a unique opportunity to act as the GS India Finance Limited (GIFL) IT Entity Lead and technical driver. You will collaborate directly with GBM Private businesses, strats, and front-to-back engineering teams in GBM, utilizing a cutting-edge technology stack while navigating the complex regulatory, operational, and financial landscape of the Indian market.
  
  
**Role Overview**
You will oversee the design, development, and governance of strategic reporting platforms, data pipelines, and internal regulatory applications. Concurrently, you will serve as the primary IT administrative and regulatory contact for the GIFL entity.
  
  
Your contributions will directly ensure structural and technical compliance with key regulatory bodies—such as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)—while modernizing financial operations, leading legacy systems migration, integrating enterprise data lakes, and leveraging state-of-the-art AI-assisted development tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Financial Reporting & Data Engineering
* Design, optimize, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines to ingest complex financial products (including corporate and mortgage loans, commercial paper, and debt instruments) from distributed enterprise data repositories and data lakes.
* Implement automated reporting frameworks for core business metrics, including Asset Classification (days-past-due calculations), Statements of Account (historical and projected cash flows), and Secured Borrowing Monitoring (portfolio concentration risk).
* Transition legacy operations into platform-independent, single-click executable workflows to systematically retire redundant applications and manual processes.
* Establish secure, automated connectivity with enterprise data lakes utilizing cloud-native events and secure file transfer mechanisms.
* Software Modernization & AI-Driven Development
* Modernize legacy core business applications by leading enterprise framework migrations (such as upgrading legacy Java and Spring Boot applications).
* Leverage cutting-edge AI software engineering assistants and generative AI coding tools to accelerate codebase refactoring, dependency upgrades, and code quality.
* Drive security migrations from legacy internal authentication systems to robust, industry-standard single-sign-on (SSO) and OAuth protocols.
* Architect complex regulatory compliance workflow portals and tracking databases using enterprise low-code platforms.
* IT Governance, Regulatory Compliance, & Audits
* Serve as the primary IT contact for local regulatory inquiries, managing timely compliance responses and gap analyses against updated IT outsourcing guidelines and directives.
* Drive technical preparation and map deliverables for internal and external IT audits, deploying real-time data reconciliation engines to secure clean, issue-free audit outcomes.
* Prepare and present IT operational, cybersecurity, and compliance metrics to the IT Strategy Board of Directors on a quarterly cycle.
* Manage recurring access certifications, capacity-utilization audits, and tracking of committed technical remediation deliverables.
* Production Support & Optimization
* Enhance API retrieval speeds through multithreading, multiprocessing, and database query optimization.
* Maintain robust, automated synchronization between core internal databases and external asset management or vendor systems.
* Architect scalable, high-performance data schemas supporting both single-tenant and multi-tenant structures.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Min. 8 years of working experience and deep proficiency in Java or Python, with hands-on experience executing complex framework migrations. Familiarity with modern web technologies (such as HTML5, JavaScript, React/Redux, and JSON).
* Hands-on experience driving Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) efficiency using modern generative AI-assisted programming tools.
* Strong track record working with cloud ecosystem services, automated data-ingestion pipelines, secure file transfer protocols, and modern data lakehouse architectures.
* Experience building enterprise compliance portals and workflows using professional low-code development platforms.
* Expertise in multithreaded API optimization, relational and NoSQL databases, proprietary querying and modeling environments, and modern authentication frameworks.
* Strong experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD), Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), and standard build automation and scripting tools.
* Familiarity with local financial market regulations, specifically IT outsourcing standards, insider trading prevention, and structured regulatory digital tracking requirement is highly desirable.
* Exceptional communication and relationship-management skills with a proven track record of collaborating with executive board members, external regulators, internal control groups, and front-office desks.

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
  
  
Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
  
  
**Position details**
The use of models presents model risk, which is the potential for adverse consequences from decisions based on incorrect or misused model outputs and reports. Model risk can lead to financial loss, poor business and strategic decision-making, or damage to a banking organization’s reputation. Model validation is the set of processes and activities intended to verify that models are performing as expected, in line with their design objectives and business uses.
  
  
The candidate will report to the Head of Model and EUCC Risk in MGS India. The team is responsible for the enterprise-wide model validation and control function to ensure the continued safety and soundness of models used across the bank. Model Risk Management touches models across all lines of businesses and the candidate will have opportunities to work in validation across all areas of the bank.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on independent validation and effective challenge of market risk models.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Independently validate counterparty credit risk and XVA models, including:

+ Exposure models: PFE, EPE, EEPE, EAD; Monte Carlo simulation engines; netting and collateral (CSA) modeling, margin period of risk (MPoR), and initial margin under ISDA SIMM
+ XVA models: CVA, DVA, FVA etc - including underlying pricing, calibration, and Greeks
+ Regulatory capital models: SA-CCR, IMM components, default risk charge, and CVA capital (BA-CVA / SA-CVA under Basel III final reforms.

* Conduct end-to-end validation, including review of modeling methodologies, assumptions and limitations, risk factor evolution (HW, LMM, SLV, etc.), calibration approaches, proxy choices, implementation logic, and numerical robustness
* Design and execute independent testing and benchmarking, including sensitivity analysis, convergence and stability tests, stress testing, backtesting of exposure profiles, and benchmarking against alternative methodologies or market practices
* Review underlying pricing models across asset classes (Rates, Credit, FX, Equities, Commodities) that feed into XVA and exposure calculations
* Support assessment of compliance with Americas Model Risk Management Policies and Procedures, U.S. regulatory expectations, and Basel CCR standards (SA-CCR, IMM, CVA framework)
* Engage with model development, XVA desk, counterparty credit risk, front office, and technology teams to challenge methodologies, resolve validation findings, and support remediation while maintaining independence
* Prepare clear and concise validation reports for senior management, model risk committees, auditors, and regulators
* Contribute to activities across the model lifecycle - inventory classification, ongoing performance monitoring, annual reviews, issue tracking, and assessment of material model changes

**Job Requirements**

* 6 to 11 years of experience in CCR/XVA model validation, model development, XVA desk quant, or front-office quantitative roles within a bank or financial institution
* Working knowledge of counterparty credit risk and XVA concepts — Monte Carlo exposure simulation, netting and collateral mechanics, CSA modeling, MPoR, and the CVA/FVA/KVA/MVA framework
* Familiarity with derivative pricing across at least one asset class (Rates, Credit, FX, Equities, Commodities), including stochastic models commonly used for exposure simulation (e.g., Hull-White, LMM, local/stochastic volatility)
* Exposure to regulatory frameworks: SA-CCR, IMM, Basel III CVA capital (BA-CVA / SA-CVA), ISDA SIMM, is strongly preferred
* Solid grounding in quantitative finance, probability, statistics, and stochastic calculus
* Awareness of model risk management frameworks and regulatory guidance such as FRB SR 11-7, OCC 2011-12, and Basel CCR standards
* Proficiency in at least one programming language used in quantitative analysis (e.g., Python, C++, R)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document findings and engage with stakeholders
* Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD preferred) in Quantitative Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related discipline

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

title: Manager/Senior Manager-Credit Risk
description:
**Manager / Senior Manager – Credit Risk**

**Department:**
Risk and Quants

**Location**
: Gurugram/ Mumbai

**Experience:**
7–11 years

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced credit risk professional to lead model development, validation, and regulatory advisory engagements for global banks and financial institutions. The role combines deep technical ownership of PD and LGD models, IFRS 9 and Credit Risk RWA frameworks with team leadership, client management, and business development responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end development, redevelopment, calibration, and enhancement of PD, LGD, and EAD models across retail, SME, and wholesale portfolios for both regulatory (Basel IRB) and accounting (IFRS 9) purposes.
* Lead independent validation of credit risk models, covering conceptual soundness, data quality, methodology, assumptions, performance testing, benchmarking, and outcome analysis, in line with SR 11-7, PRA SS1/23, and client model risk policies.
* Design, review, and challenge IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) frameworks, including lifetime PD term structures, SICR and staging criteria, forward-looking macroeconomic scenarios, scenario weighting, and post-model adjustments.
* Oversee Credit Risk RWA computation and analysis under the Standardised and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches, including exposure classification, credit risk mitigation, CCF/EAD treatment, RWA reconciliation, and variance analysis.
* Advise clients on Basel III and Basel IV (Basel III final reforms / CRR3 / Basel 3.1) requirements, and lead impact assessments for the revised Standardised Approach, IRB input floors, IRB scope restrictions, and the output floor.
* Drive automation of model development, validation, and monitoring workflows in Python; define coding standards, perform code reviews, and build reusable analytical libraries.
* Design and lead model monitoring frameworks and annual model reviews, including KPI definition, threshold setting, and remediation tracking.
* Review and sign off model development and validation documentation, ensuring compliance with internal governance and regulatory expectations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, including model owners, model validation teams, internal audit, and regulators.
* Manage, coach, and mentor a team of analysts and lead analysts; own project planning, quality assurance, and timely delivery.
* Contribute to business development through proposals, solution design, proofs of concept, and thought leadership, including AI/ML applications in credit risk.

**Core Technical Focus Areas**

* **PD and LGD Modelling & Validation:**
  Logistic regression and scorecards, rating master scales, long-run average default rate calibration, margin of conservatism, workout and downturn LGD, cure rates; validation testing such as Gini/AUROC, KS, binomial and Jeffreys tests, Hosmer-Lemeshow, PSI/CSI, and back-testing.
* **IFRS 9:**
  ECL methodology, PIT vs. TTC PD conversion, lifetime PD (e.g., Markov chain, survival, vintage approaches), SICR and staging, macroeconomic satellite models, and management overlays.
* **Credit Risk RWA:**
  SA and IRB risk-weight functions, asset correlation and maturity adjustment, credit risk mitigation, CCF/EAD, RWA drivers and movement analysis, and capital adequacy reporting.
* **Basel III and Basel IV Regulatory Areas:**
  Basel IRB framework, CRR/CRR3, PRA Basel 3.1, EBA guidelines on PD/LGD estimation and definition of default, output floor, input floors, ICAAP, and regulatory stress testing.
* **Python:**
  Advanced use of pandas, NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels, and scikit-learn; building reproducible modelling and validation pipelines; ML challenger models (e.g., gradient boosting); version control with Git.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Financial Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or Data Science, or B.Tech./MBA (Finance) from a reputed institution.
* 7–11 years of experience in credit risk model development and/or validation in a bank, consulting firm, or risk analytics organisation.
* Proven hands-on track record in PD and LGD (and EAD) model development and validation for Basel IRB and IFRS 9.
* In-depth knowledge of IFRS 9 ECL, Credit Risk RWA computation, and Basel III / Basel IV requirements.
* Strong understanding of model risk management guidelines such as SR 11-7, PRA SS1/23, and EBA/ECB internal model guidance.
* Advanced, hands-on proficiency in Python; SAS and SQL experience is good to have.
* Experience leading teams and managing client deliverables end to end.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.

**Good to Have**

* Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, or CFA.
* Exposure to CECL, CCAR/DFAST, or ICAAP stress testing.
* Experience applying machine learning or GenAI in credit risk modelling and validation.
* Experience working directly with onshore / international client stakeholders.

**Disclaimer:**
The above job description serves as an informative reference for the tasks you may be required to perform. However, it does not constitute an integral component of your employment agreement and is subject to periodic modifications to align with evolving circumstances.

: We appreciate the accuracy and authenticity of the information you provide, as it plays a key role in your candidacy. As part of the Background Verification Process, we may verify your employment, education, and other details. Please ensure all information is factual and submitted on time. For any assistance, your recruiter is available to support you.

title: Senior Analyst- BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's Risk and Compliance Practice Area, your focus will be supporting the Risk Analytics team and will work in a growing global team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain-specific data and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute on cases and proposals by contributing relevant analysis and insights and help case teams create strong impact for clients. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, occasional travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected to understand client requirements, and design / develop solutions.
  
  
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage, you will contribute to developing intellectual property & assets for the business and assist in onboarding and training junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise. You will apply your subject matter knowledge to support project proposals, including outside-in analyses, competitive benchmarking, and maturity assessments. You will contribute to the development of client-ready deliverables, including presentations, white papers, maturity models, and regulatory trackers and will support ongoing knowledge curation efforts, including vendor landscape evaluations and toolkit development for the compliance and risk domain.
  
  
You will collaborate with case teams to support clients in identifying, assessing, and managing regulatory, financial, and non-financial risks across a range of domains (especially credit risk). You will conduct research and analysis on relevant regulations, risk and compliance frameworks, and industry benchmarks to generate actionable insights. You will liaise with specialized teams (e.g., BCG X, Risk Expert Consultants) to co-develop optimal solutions and ensure seamless delivery of projects and will work alongside consultants to collect, synthesize, and analyze case team learnings, contributing to the development of new knowledge assets such as case vignettes, frameworks, and methodologies.
  
  
The R&C PA helps clients to manage key risks strategically, to advance organizational resilience and establish a profound risk culture, by defining and transforming R&C operating models. We cover a diverse set of topics across financial and non-financial risks and assist in enabling clients' strategy through technical enablement with the help of our deep expertise in risk modelling, analytics and digitization.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 2+ years of consulting experience in the Banking/Financial Services, Insurance (in India) sectors and Credit risk; candidates with consulting experience strongly preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 3+ years minimum industry experience required; 4-6+ years of industry experience strongly preferred in Banking/Financial Services, Insurance (in India) in financial risk and regulations - Credit Risk (required), additional Risk types (bonus)
* Degree requirement: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or Law
* Credential requirement: Financial Risk Manager certification administered by the Global Association of Risk Professionals or Chartered Financial Analyst
* Exposure to regulatory frameworks especially BASEL guidelines, Reserve Bank of India guidelines
* Fluency in written and spoken English, strong written and verbal communication skills, strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
**Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)**

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

T
**opic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)**

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

**Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)**

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving client problems through formulating relevant research and/or analytical approaches in Risk Analytics in an inquisitive and structured way
* Communicating with case teams and clients team members, in a credible and confident way
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic often virtual, proficient in agile ways of working
* Being flexible and bringing a curious and creative mindset, open to new things and able to propose innovative ideas
* Navigating complexity and ambiguity

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
****This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.****

In your capacity as a BI Manager for Finance, you will drive results by resolving critical inquiries regarding business performance across various financial sectors. You will serve as the lead ambassador for BI programs within the department, steering strategic growth through the creation and oversight of analytical frameworks that shape organizational outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Direct the complete lifecycle of reporting solutions from requirement discovery through deployment and support.
* Document report logic, data definitions, and processes to promote self-service and long-term knowledge transfer.
* Enforce best practices to guarantee maintainability and technical sustainability over time.

**Who You Are**

* Professional background with a BE/B.Tech and 8–10 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related fields.
* Proven track record of delivering stakeholder-facing BI solutions, preferably within Finance or Financial Reporting domains, and co-ordinate across departments.
* Expertise in dashboard authoring, publishing, and administration using Tableau Cloud (essential).
* Proficiency with legacy BI platforms like OBIEE and OAS to support and maintain current setups.
* Strong understanding of data architecture and data warehousing concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, ETL/ELT processes, data marts, fact/dimension design) — able to work closely with the data team to translate business/reporting requirements into clear technical data requirements that can be designed and built.
* Advanced SQL capability covering data modeling, complex queries, and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience leveraging Google BigQuery for analytics workflows.
* Skilled in designing BI enterprise architecture and transforming ambiguous business demands into structured technical plans.
* Strong communication and stakeholder leadership skills, equipped to manage competing priorities and act as the BI ambassador for key business units.
* Hands-on experience configuring and managing a ticketing/workflow tool (e.g., Jira Service Management or something similar ).
* Prior experience in consulting, product-focused environments, or financial analytics, with financial domain knowledge considered a plus.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
