title: Risk Reporting 2LOD Sr. Analyst, Assistant Vice President
description:
As a Senior Market Risk Reporting Analyst, you will shape how market risk is measured, monitored, and reported across Citi's key European and UK legal entities. You will join the EMEA Legal Entity Market Risk Reporting team at a pivotal time, combining regulatory-grade production reporting with the opportunity to build advanced portfolio analytics using Python, automated data pipelines, and interactive dashboards. This role places you at the intersection of risk management, data science, and regulatory compliance, giving you direct visibility into Citi's cross-asset risk profile.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Produce, analyze, and present comprehensive market risk profiles across Rates, FX, Credit, Equities, and Commodities.
* Conduct deep-dive analysis on key risk measures, including Value at Risk, Expected Shortfall, Factor Sensitivities, Issuer and Concentration Risk, and Firmwide Stress Testing.
* Ensure legal entity compliance with European and UK regulatory frameworks, including ECB, PRA, FCA, and EBA standards.
* Deliver auditable analytics for regulatory examinations, ICAAP exercises, and periodic regulatory filings.
* Maintain a strong control environment across the data lifecycle and identify data quality issues at the source.
* Drive remediation of data issues in partnership with first-line and technology teams.
* Apply Python, machine learning, and statistical modeling to detect anomalies in risk movements and automate risk commentary.
* Partner with Market Risk Managers, Traders, Structurers, and Legal Entity Risk Officers to explain P&L and risk fluctuations.
* Design and deploy interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, and Python to transform static risk reporting into real-time analytics tools.

title: Engineering Manager - Data Science
description:
**Engineering Manager - Data Science**

**Job Overview**

As an Engineering Manager, AI & ML (Data Collection), you will play a vital role in executing the company’s AI and machine learning initiatives with a strong focus on data collection technologies. This position will require deep technical expertise in unstructured data processing, data collection pipeline engineering, and a hands-on approach to managing and mentoring engineers. Your leadership will ensure that AI & ML data collection systems are developed and operationalized at the highest standards of performance, reliability, and security. You will be working closely with individual contributors, ensuring that projects align with broader business goals and AI/ML strategies.

This role requires deep engagement in the design, development, and maintenance of AI & ML models, solutions, architecture, and services. You will need to provide strong technical direction, problem-solve complex technical challenges, and ensure that the team consistently delivers high-quality, scalable solutions. You will leverage your deep knowledge in areas such as advanced natural language processing (NLP), generative AI (GenAI) and large language models (LLMs), ML Operations (MLOps), data architecture, data pipelines, and cloud-managed services.

Your leadership will ensure that our AI/ML systems align with global business strategies, maintaining seamless integration and high-performance standards. You will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML data systems—from research and development to deployment and operationalization.

You will be responsible for mentoring team members, resolving technical challenges, and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration while ensuring they have the right tools, frameworks, and guidance to succeed. This role offers a unique opportunity to drive impactful change in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, where your efforts will directly contribute to the success of our AI/ML initiatives globally. Your ability to collaborate with cross-departmental stakeholders, provide leadership across locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You will solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.

**Team Overview**

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers and data scientists responsible for building AI & ML solutions and services as part of robust data collection pipelines handling large volumes of unstructured data. Your team will focus on building scalable and reliable systems to process and categorize data that is essential for downstream data collection processing.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **AI & ML Data Collection Leadership:**
  Drive the execution of AI & ML initiatives related to data collection, ensuring that the team’s efforts are aligned with overall business goals and strategies.
* **Technical Oversight:**
  Provide hands-on technical leadership in the engineering of ML models and services, focusing on unstructured data, NLP, and classifiers.Oversee and contribute to the implementation of scalable solutions that meet high standards of reliability and efficiency.
* **Team Leadership & Development:**
  Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and data scientists, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Ensure effective communication and coordination within your team and across geographically dispersed teams.
* **NLP Technologies:**
  Contribute to the development and application of NLP techniques, including classifiers, transformers, LLMs, and other methodologies, to efficiently process and categorize unstructured data. Ensure these models are integrated seamlessly into the broader AI/ML infrastructure.
* **Data Pipeline Engineering:**
  Design, develop, and maintain advanced data collection pipelines, utilizing orchestration, messaging, database, and data platform technologies. Ensure pipelines are optimized for scalability, performance, and reliability.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with other AI/ML teams, data collection engineering teams, product management, and others to ensure data collection efforts support broader AI/ML goals and product objectives.
* **Innovation & Continuous Improvement:**
  Continuously explore and implement new technologies and methodologies to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of data collection and processing systems. Stay at the forefront of advancements in NLP and data processing.
* **System Integrity & Security:**
  Ensure that all data collection systems meet the highest standards of integrity, security, and compliance. Implement best practices for data governance and model transparency.
* **Talent Acquisition & Retention:**
  Play an active role in recruiting, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Foster an environment where team members are encouraged to innovate, feel valued, and achieve their full potential.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Apply Agile, Lean, and Fast-Flow principles to improve team efficiency and the delivery of high-quality data collection solutions.
* **Support Company Vision and Values:**
  Model and promote behaviors that align with the company’s vision and values. Participate actively in company-wide initiatives and projects as required.

**Experience, Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on AI & ML technologies, particularly in data collection and unstructured data processing.
* 3+ years of experience in a leadership role managing individual contributors.
* Strong expertise in NLP and machine learning, with hands-on experience in classifiers, large language models (LLMs), and other NLP techniques. Additionally experience in Gen AI, RAG, Agentic AI is essential
* Extensive experience with data pipeline and messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Airflow, and cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake).
* Expert-level proficiency in Java, Python, SQL, and other relevant programming languages and tools.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and containerization (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker) with experience in managing these systems globally.
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent communication skills with a collaborative approach to working with global teams and stakeholders.
* Experience working in fast-paced environments, particularly in industries that rely on data-intensive technologies (experience in fintech is highly desirable).

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on 

Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 

and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s 

AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. 

 

As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

 

**The Role**

The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.

 

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

 

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

 

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
  1. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  2. Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  3. Embedding generation and optimization
  4. Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  1. Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  2. Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  1. Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  2. Relevance and precision/recall
  3. Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  4. Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Business Process Automation Associate
description:
**Business Process Automation Associate · Mumbai · Reports to the Chief Technology Officer**

**The mandate**

Our client is a large, listed Indian building materials company with a multi-decade brand, a national retail footprint and manufacturing in Gujarat. Much of its daily work still depends on spreadsheets, repeated reports and manual follow-ups, and its data sits across systems that are not fully connected. This role exists to fix that, one process at a time. The Associate will learn how each function works, identify where time and accuracy are lost, and personally build the automations that solve those problems. When this is done well, teams spend less time moving information and work from the same numbers.

**What you will own**

*Understanding the business*

* Map how key functions, including sales, supply chain, finance, HR and customer service, actually operate.
* Identify and rank bottlenecks by time lost, error risk and business impact, then agree priorities with the CTO.

*Building the solutions*

* Personally design, build, test and maintain automations for repetitive reporting, approvals, data entry and follow-ups.
* Connect the ERP, CRM and internal applications so that data moves between them reliably.
* Create a single, trusted view of the numbers that functional teams use most often.

*Making change stick*

* Document each new process and train the people who will use it.
* Track usage and time saved after launch, and fix what is not working.

**What you bring**

* Translate Voice of Customer (VoC) and field learnings into concrete product requirements and roadmap inputs
* Explore and validate AI/ML-based approaches that advance PDC's data product capabilities

* Direct collaboration with customers and global R&D teams
* A role with real product influence — your field learnings shape the roadmap
* Dual career track: technical specialist or engineering leadership

* Master’s / Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, VLSI, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in semiconductor process and defectivity, with hands-on knowledge of CAD and design-based inspection concepts
* Proficiency in Python; experience building scripts, tools, or analytical workflows
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and practical experience applying them to data analysis or product development
* Comfort with GenAI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging, and documentation
* Willingness to travel ~50% to leading fabs globally
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams
* Excellent communication skills — equally effective with customers, field teams, and R&D engineers

Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular

Yes, 50% of the Time

Yes

The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Knowledge of how insurance works and basics of Actuarial profession
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc, will be a plus
* Ability to utilize AI tools to expedite current processes and workflows

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

title: Associate - Digital Delivery - T&I
description:
**Job Description**
WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.
  
  
The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.
  
  
You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

* Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance
* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.
* GIS & Digital Twin Integration
* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS) with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational Digital Twin environments (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.
* 3D Visualization & Reality Capture
* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of Reality Capture datasets (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.
* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Lead Financial Planning & Analysis (PSS08118)
description:
**About The Company**
This organization operates in the quick-service restaurant sector, managing prominent brands in Indonesia. It is focused on delivering strong financial performance and growth through strategic business finance leadership and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The
**Lead - FP & A (DGM/GM)**
role exists to lead FP&A and Business Finance for key brands in Indonesia, with end-to-end responsibility for management P&L, planning, forecasting, MIS, commercial analytics, and business partnering. This business-facing finance leadership position reports directly to the
**CFO Indonesia**
and partners closely with Operations and cross-functional leaders to identify risks and opportunities, translate insights into actions, and support delivery of the Board-approved PBT plan.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the management P&L and lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reviews.
* Analyse Actual vs Budget, Forecast, and Prior Year performance; identify key variances and drive actions to close performance gaps.
* Partner with Operations on store-level sales, COGS, labour, and other controllable cost performance.
* Monitor and drive gross margin initiatives across dine-in and delivery channels to support organisation targets.
* Lead the annual budget, strategic planning process, and monthly rolling forecasts.
* Provide early visibility of PBT risks and opportunities with clear recommendations and action plans.
* Build financial scenarios covering sales, pricing, commodities, FX, labour, rent, and changes in the store portfolio.
* Deep-dive sales, transactions, sales mix, and POS/Tableau data across pricing, coupons, markdowns, promotions/LTOs, customer behaviour, and market/store performance.
* Analyse dine-in versus delivery economics, including delivery through food aggregators, and assess profitability impact.
* Evaluate marketing and promotional ROI based on incremental sales and margin contribution.
* Prepare and present detailed weekly business performance reviews for the Leadership Team.
* Lead menu mix management and pre- and post-promotion evaluations.
* Drive control and optimisation of COGS, labour, rent, delivery commissions, marketing, and other major P&L lines.
* Lead or support financial evaluations and commercial negotiations with landlords, vendors, aggregators, and other strategic partners.
* Monitor commodity and FX exposure, including beef, chicken, oil, fries/potatoes, and rice, assessing potential P&L impact.
* Lead financial evaluation of new stores, closures, relocations, and renovations.
* Evaluate store economics, capex, rent, EBITDA, payback, and potential cannibalisation.
* Track new-store performance against approved business cases and highlight corrective actions where required.
* Own decision-oriented MIS, dashboards, and management reporting using SAP, POS, Tableau, and Excel.
* Drive automation and the use of AI and analytics to improve speed, accuracy, and productivity of the FP&A function.
* Prepare and present Board-level analysis, insights, and presentations.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing FP&A/MIS team of 3–4 direct reports.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Education: Chartered Accountant or a Master’s degree in Finance.
* Experience: 7–10 years of relevant experience, including 4–6+ years in FP&A, Business Finance, or Commercial Finance, and 3+ years of people-management experience.
* Leadership: Experience leading and developing a team of 3–4 direct reports; ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and report to executive leadership.
* Technical Expertise: Proficiency in Excel, advanced financial modelling, data analytics/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, ACL, Qlik), SAP/S4 HANA, and POS systems; practical experience using AI and automation tools.
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical, logical, and problem-solving skills; excellent PowerPoint, communication, and executive presentation skills; ability to challenge business constructively and influence financial outcomes.
* Language: Fluent English with professional business proficiency; Bahasa Indonesia preferred or willingness to learn quickly.
* Preferred Industry: Experience in QSR/restaurants, retail, FMCG, e-commerce/delivery, or other high volume consumer businesses.

Why Consider this Opportunity?
  
  

* Lead finance for major quick-service restaurant related brands with significant market presence in Indonesia.
* Drive strategic financial planning and commercial decision-making impacting P&L and business growth.
* Partner closely with cross-functional leaders to influence operational and financial outcomes.
* Leverage advanced analytics, AI, and automation to transform FP&A capabilities.
* Develop and lead a high-performing finance team in a dynamic, high-volume consumer business environment.
* Present insights and recommendations directly to the Leadership Team and Board, enhancing visibility and impact.

title: MS - FDL - Manager - Data Operations
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Data Operations & Technical Oversight**

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
* Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
* Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
* Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
* Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
* Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
* Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our mission to change the way the world snacks. Make It With Pride.**
You will represent and communicate data requirements to help us understand our data assets and the relationships among them. You will investigate, analyze and scope data requirements to support the development of data integration, data retrieval and reusable data sets.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will:
  
  

* Analyze business requirements as a guide for data modeling and apply data analysis, design, modeling, and quality assurance techniques, based on a detailed understanding of business processes, to establish, modify or maintain data structures and associated components (entity descriptions, relationship descriptions, attribute definitions
* Advise on the details of data structures and associated components
* Manage the iteration, review and maintenance of data requirements and data models and you will assist in creating the sematic layer of data
* Have cross-functional understanding to create reusable data assets
* Choose a suitable data modeling approach for each project, such as by assessing the suitability of existing data models and build data models with the flexibility to change when business requirements change
* Reconcile multiple logical source models into a single, logically consistent model and you will ensure that the proposed model follows data architecture guidelines and best practices
* Rationalize the relationships expressed in the logical data model to the schema of the physical data store (that is, database tables and columns)

**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
  
  

* Extensive experience in data modeling in a large complex business with multiple systems
* Ability to simplify complex problems and communicate them to a broad audience

**More About This Role**
At Mondelēz International, data science is a critical accelerator in our mission to lead the future of snacking. We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our ISC Central Analytics team and strengthen the data-science capability across our Integrated Supply Chain — with a primary focus on Quality and Food Safety analytics and support / scale our Manufacturing Data Science practice.
  
  
You will sit at the intersection of quality, food safety, and manufacturing operations, building AI, machine-learning, NLP, GenAI, computer-vision, optimisation, and simulation solutions that make our supply chain smarter, safer, and more resilient. The quality dimension is your home base — QCMS performance, audit readiness, QFS intelligence, compliance risk — but you will also extend the Central Analytics team's manufacturing data-science portfolio by helping scale predictive maintenance, process optimisation, and IIoT-driven analytics across the plant network.
  
  
Your work will transform quality, food-safety, and manufacturing data into production-ready intelligence that reduces Quality & Food Safety defects, non-conformances, compliance risk, RM/PM yield loss, unplanned downtime, and cost — while improving throughput, Customer Service Level (CSL), asset reliability, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**What you need to know about this position:**
**Quality Control Management System (QCMS) — Primary Focus**

* Build quality prediction models for product-quality outcomes (CTQ and CTP parameters), supplier quality risk, defect probability, non-conformance risk, process drift, and first-pass yield across Biscuits, Chocolate, Gum & Candy categories.
* Develop QCMS audit-score prediction models to anticipate internal and audit outcomes, identify likely findings, quantify site-level quality risk, and prioritise preventive actions ahead of audits.
* Create Quality Intelligence using NLP, clustering, causal analysis, and machine learning to classify non-conformances, identify recurring root causes, predict recurrence, score effectiveness, and predict closure delays — aligned with Mondelēz CAPA and Quality Policy (QP) frameworks.
* Build analytics for hazards, hygienic zoning, food safety, pathogen monitoring, environmental monitoring, sanitation, allergen control, and cross-contamination risk in line with the Mondelēz HACCP Standard, Hygienic Zoning Programmes, and Prerequisite Programmes (PRPs).
* Develop calibration and measurement-system analytics for calibration overdue risk, instrument drift, measurement uncertainty, compliance gaps, and quality impact from calibration failures.
* Use NLP and GenAI to extract insights from QCMS audit reports, CAPA narratives, consumer complaints, deviations, SOPs, HACCP/Food Safety Plans (FSP), maintenance logs, and supplier communications; enable AI-assisted quality investigations and audit preparation.
* Build analytics connecting supplier quality, incoming-material risk, and customer-quality outcomes to create end-to-end quality visibility across the supply chain — from raw material to consumer.
* Build quality dashboards, risk scorecards, alerts, and self-service analytics for Q&FS, BU Quality, Global Food Safety, Plant Operations, and RDQ stakeholders.

**Manufacturing Data Science — Core / Supporting Focus**

* Build IIoT-enabled analytics using data from PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES , sensors, edge devices, vision systems, LIMS, and QMS platforms.
* Develop predictive-maintenance models for equipment failure, asset health, remaining useful life, condition-based monitoring, anomaly detection, and maintenance prioritisation — leveraging IL6S (Integrated Lean Six Sigma) loss-elimination methodology.
* Support automated process control and closed-loop control through process modelling, deviation prediction, setpoint recommendations, and feedback-driven control strategies.
* Apply statistical process control, process-capability analysis (CpK/PpK), design of experiments, and root-cause methods (8D, 5-Why, FMEA) to reduce variation and improve yield — in partnership with the Process Excellence and Supply Chain Excellence teams.
* Build mathematical optimisation and simulation models for production scheduling, line balancing, capacity planning, material flow, quality-resource allocation, sanitation scheduling, and calibration planning.
* Support Deployment & Industrialization of models to cloud, edge, or on-premise environments with monitoring, retraining, governance, and auditability.

**Platform, Data & Delivery**

* Partner with Q&FS, BU Quality, Global Food Safety, RDQ, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Excellence, CS&L, Process Excellence, Engineering/Maintenance, Procurement, HSE, and MDS (Mondelēz Digital Services) teams to define high-impact use cases and measurable success criteria.
* Design, build, validate, deploy, and continuously improve ML, statistical, NLP, computer-vision, optimisation, simulation, and GenAI solutions using Databricks and Azure/AWS .
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and governed data architectures and data-science solution patterns on Azure/AWS in collaboration with the AI, Data & Analytics Platform team.
* Integrate data from SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, MES, SAP EWM, o9, IMS, QMS/eQMS (QCMS), food-safety systems, audit tools, and IIoT platforms into reliable Databricks-based data products — leveraging Collibra / Ataccama for data governance and MuleSoft / SAP BTP for integration.
* Build real-time dashboards, alerts, scorecards, and self-service analytics using Tableau, Power BI, Databricks SQL, or Python-based tools for Q&FS, plant, and ISC stakeholders — feeding into Executive dashboards and KPI reporting where applicable.
* Operationalise models through MLOps practices, including version control (GitHub/ADO), CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining, governance, security, and auditability.
* Quantify business impact through MDLZ-specific quality, food-safety, manufacturing, and supply-chain KPIs.

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**
**Mandatory**

* 5–8+ years of experience in quality analytics, food-safety analytics, manufacturing analytics, supply-chain analytics, industrial AI, or data science in an operational/FMCG environment.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Databricks and Strong cloud experience (Azure and/or AWS) is required, particularly across data engineering, data-science solutioning, and solution architecture.
* Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, time-series libraries, and TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Strong SQL, PySpark, and experience building scalable data pipelines and governed data products in Databricks.
* Strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, classification, regression, forecasting, and model validation.
* Experience designing end-to-end data-science and data-engineering architectures on cloud, including ingestion, storage, processing, feature engineering, model training, deployment, monitoring, and governance.
* Experience building dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Grafana, Databricks SQL, or Python-based tools.
* Experience working with QMS/eQMS, IMS, MES, SAP ERP, CMMS, historians, IIoT platforms, or audit-management systems.
* Strong stakeholder-management, communication, and data-storytelling skills — comfortable presenting to both plant-floor teams and senior ISC leadership.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge of quality and food-safety frameworks such as HACCP, GMP, PRPs, Hygienic Zoning, allergen control, environmental monitoring, sanitation controls, and CAPA — familiarity with MDLZ Quality Policies (QPs) is a plus.
* Knowledge of Manufacturing & Domain Frameworks such as Industry 4.0, IoT telemetry, Data Vault 2.0, and statistical process control (SPC) is a plus.
* Experience with NLP techniques such as text classification, named-entity recognition, topic modelling, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience with computer vision, image processing, object detection, segmentation, and defect classification in manufacturing or food-production environments.
* Experience deploying GenAI solutions using LLMs, vector databases, prompt engineering, and responsible-AI guardrails.

**Company Description**

Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
  
  
You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
  
  
This is an early-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
* Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**What We're Looking For**

* A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
* A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
* A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
* Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
* Impact-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
* An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.

**Essential**

* 6 - 8+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands-on modeling responsibility.
* Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
* Hands-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
* Git-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
* Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.
* Python for data work and automation.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Alteryx, particularly in a migration context.
* Experience with Airbyte, Dagster & DBT or comparable ELT tooling.
* Salesforce-specific data modeling experience.
* Exposure to predictive modeling or machine learning workflows.
* Experience with large customer engagement datasets (1M+ rows).
* Ability to build and maintain Tableau dashboards, even if it isn't your primary craft.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Supply Chain Intern
description:
**What You'll Work On**
Across B2C, B2B, logistics, warehouse operations, quick commerce, and inventory planning, the intern will contribute to:
  
  

* Operational data analysis: Working with order, inventory, and logistics data to track performance across the supply chain network and surface patterns worth acting on.
* SLA & TAT tracking: Monitoring turnaround times and service levels across warehouse and logistics flows, and flagging deviations from target.
* Warehouse operations exposure: Understanding day-to-day floor operations — inbound, outbound, inventory accuracy — across fulfilment and distribution centres.
* Inventory planning support: Assisting with demand-supply matching, stock allocation, and distribution planning across nodes.
* Reporting & dashboards: Building and maintaining reports/dashboards on cost, availability, and efficiency metrics that operations teams use to make decisions.
* Cross-functional coordination: Working with warehouse, logistics, retail replenishment, and planning teams to help resolve day-to-day operational issues.

**Operational Excellence - What We Expect**
This internship isn't just about executing tasks — it comes with a standing expectation to bring an operational excellence mindset to everything you touch:
  
  

* Continuous improvement: Don't just complete a task as given — look for ways to make the underlying process faster, cheaper, or less error-prone, and flag it.
* Root-cause orientation: When a number looks off or a process breaks, dig into why it happened rather than just reporting that it happened.
* Process discipline: Document what you find and what you fix clearly enough that someone else could pick it up — improvements should be repeatable, not one-off.
* Metric ownership: Be comfortable owning a metric end-to-end — tracking it, explaining its movement, and proposing what would move it in the right direction.

**Who We're Looking For**
We're looking for a B.Tech graduate or a final year student who thinks in numbers and structure first, and who genuinely wants to understand how physical supply chains work — not just analyze them from a spreadsheet.
  
  

* Analytical strength: Comfortable with data — able to slice, structure, and interpret numbers, spot patterns, and question them before presenting.
* Logical, first-principles thinking: Can break down an ambiguous operational problem into its component parts without needing to be told how.
* Genuine interest in supply chain operations: Curious about how B2C and B2B flows, logistics networks, warehouses, quick commerce, and inventory planning actually function end-to-end.
* Ownership: Takes a task from raw data to a finished, presentable output without needing constant hand-holding.
* Communication: Can explain a number, a chart, or a finding clearly to someone who doesn't have the analytical background.

**Skills And Tools Exposure**

* Strong working knowledge of Excel (formulas, pivots); SQL or BigQuery exposure is a strong plus
* Basic understanding of statistics and logical/quantitative reasoning
* Familiarity with dashboarding tools (Metabase, Power BI, or similar) is a plus, not mandatory
* Exposure to supply chain, logistics, or operations coursework/projects is valued

title: ML Research Scientist
description:
**ABOUT PARAMAIQ & NYAAYOS**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. India runs one of the largest judicial systems on earth: more than 55 million pending cases and one of the largest legal workforces anywhere. Yet legal expertise stays concentrated in a handful of senior counsel and metro firms. For a litigant in a district court, often arguing in a regional language, the outcome can turn on who they can afford. NyaayOS turns the primary sources of Indian law (the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the BNSS and BSA, decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, statutes, and gazettes) into a reasoning layer any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes, so the bottleneck shifts from access back to advocacy. We give an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading

firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

Generating text is the easy part. The hard part is making sure every sentence we put in front of a lawyer rests on real, currently valid authority. That is the problem you own. You own how NyaayOS represents legal knowledge, and how it finds and verifies the law behind an answer. Indian law is vast, cross-referenced, and always moving statutes get amended, judgments get

overruled, positions shift. Turning that into something a machine can search, reason over, and stan behind is the core research problem of the company. You settle it with experiments against a legal eval set you build with our in-house lawyer, not with intuition. The work ships into a product lawyers rely on, and it is judged there.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* How we represent a large, changing body of law so a machine can reason over it and know what is currently authoritative.
* How we retrieve the right law with precision, where the answer can turn on a single fact, provision, or jurisdiction.
* How we verify that an answer is grounded in a real source that is still good law and catch it when it isn't.
* The legal eval set as the source of truth. You design the benchmarks and you own the number.
* The research direction. On a small team, you frame the problem, run the experiment, and make the call.

**THE HARD PROBLEMS YOU'LL TAKE ON**

* Representing law that changes under you. An authority that governs today can be overruled
* tomorrow, and the representation must know the difference.
* Proving groundedness at scale. A fluent answer citing a real sounding but wrong or dead authority is worse than no answer. Verifying grounding reliably is unsolved in this domain.
* Defining "correct" where experts disagree. Before you can measure a system, you must build ground truth in a field where correctness is argued, not given.

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

* Strong command of modern retrieval and representation: dense and sparse embeddings, vector
* and lexical search, rerankers, and when each win. You can build and evaluate a retrieval system end to end.
* Hands-on at the model layer for RAG and reasoning: prompting, structured extraction, and using
* LLMs as components of a larger system.
* Knowledge representation in practice: knowledge graphs, entity and relationship modelling, and
* using structure inside search and reasoning.
* Eval-driven for real: you design benchmarks, build datasets, and measure factuality and
* groundedness, not just offline accuracy.
* Comfortable where learned models meet symbolic or rule-based logic.
* Strong Python and rigorous experiment design, and you write clearly enough that an engineer can build from your spec.

**BONUS POINTS**

* A high-stakes domain where being wrong has real consequences: legal, medical, financial.
* Indian law, or Indian-language NLP.
* Information extraction and NER from messy documents.

title: AI Agent Engineer Intern
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe AI systems for real-world deployment. Our work spans agentic AI, alignment, interpretability, evaluation systems, enterprise AI, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data.

We build AI systems where transparency, auditability, robustness, and controllability are first-class constraints. Our environment is fast-moving, research-driven, and highly hands-on. We value people who bring open ideas, take ownership, and turn ambiguity into meaningful outcomes.

The Role

We are looking for
****AI Agent Interns****

to work on high-impact agentic AI problems across applied, research, and product directions.

This is not a narrow internship focused on building small internal bots. You will work on real agentic systems, evaluation infrastructure, enterprise use cases, research prototypes, and product tooling that can shape how AI agents are built, tested, aligned, and deployed.

Depending on your interests and strengths, you may contribute across one or more of three tracks:

1. Applied Agentic AI

On the applied side, you will work on high-impact enterprise agentic use cases. This may involve building agents that reason over complex workflows, interact with tools and data systems, execute multi-step processes, evaluate outcomes, and operate reliably in real-world environments.

Example work may include enterprise workflow agents, agents over structured or proprietary data, human-in-the-loop agent systems, decision-support agents, and applied prototypes that can evolve into production-grade components.

Success in this track means building useful, reliable, and high-value agentic systems that solve real enterprise problems.

2. Agent R&D and Evaluation

On the R&D side, you will work on new ideas in agent architecture, harness design, evaluations, long-horizon reasoning, alignment, and interpretability.

This may include building new agent harnesses, designing evaluation frameworks, studying agent failure modes, benchmarking tool use and planning, or contributing to research papers, technical reports, and reusable research infrastructure.

Success in this track means producing research-quality insights, evaluation systems, benchmarks, or technical contributions that improve how agentic systems are understood and assessed.

3. Product and Tooling Agents

title: Research Engineer — Agent Architectures (Coding & Autonomous Systems)
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building 
****aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems****

. While that is the vision, the mission to build safety aware autonomous system in the extreme near term. Our research work spans around areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI, Eurips etc. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai & remote), Paris, & London. 

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Most of the variance in agent performance comes from the system around the model, not the model itself. This role researches that system. The coding agent is the primary testbed: it takes an objective, works on a repository, verifies its own changes, and produces a record of what it did. It runs inside a customer's network, usually with no internet egress, against codebases that are large, old, thinly tested and load-bearing. Small models under real latency and cost budgets are a target, not a fallback.

Three areas:

****Harness.****

Action space and tool surface design, context construction policy, where deterministic program analysis should replace model inference, control topology (single loop versus decomposition), verification design, and allocation of inference-time compute.

****Memory.****

Schemas for execution state held outside the context window, compaction policy and what it destroys, retrieval under closed-world constraints, and whether an agent measurably improves on a repository over time.

****Evals.****

Task construction from real repository history with executable verification, scoring partially-checkable long-horizon work, variance and contamination control, and failure taxonomies that attribute a failure to a component.

The work is controlled experiments on architecture, not prompt tuning: isolate a failure from eval traces, form a hypothesis about the responsible component, change it, ablate it, and establish whether the gain holds across repositories and model sizes. Outputs are papers, benchmarks and released tooling where we can publish, and shipped architecture where we cannot.

You will work directly with our alignment and interpretability researchers on post-training, behavioral evaluation, and reading what an agent actually did rather than what its trace claims.

What We Are Looking For

Research judgment with systems depth. You should be able to isolate a failure, design the experiment that tests your explanation of it, build what the experiment needs, and tell the difference between a real gain and an artifact of your setup.

****Agentic systems.****

Two or more years building agents that ran against real workloads, not demos. Working knowledge of the current landscape (ReAct-style agents, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, the current generation of coding agents) and a specific account of where each stops working. Experience with tool-use protocols and orchestration under partial failure, retries, timeouts and non-idempotent actions.

****Evaluation.****

You have built an eval dataset or harness that other people then used. Comfortable with SWE-bench-class benchmarks and their construction, containerised task execution at scale, statistical treatment of noisy multi-run results, and pass@k, best-of-N and majority-vote scoring and their failure cases.

****Code intelligence and program analysis.****

ASTs and tree-sitter, static and dataflow analysis, symbol indexing and code search, call graph and dependency resolution, codemods and automated migration tooling. You should be able to build a repository-scale index and defend its design.

****Backend and infrastructure.****

Advanced Python. Sandboxing and containerisation (Docker, gVisor, Firecracker or equivalent), distributed execution of thousands of parallel trials, artifact and dependency management, and on-premise or air-gapped deployment. Experiments that cannot be run at volume are not useful here.

****Observability.****

Distributed tracing, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, and the replay and inspection tooling that makes a non-deterministic system debuggable end to end.

****Model side.****

You do not need to be a training specialist, but you should be fluent in post-training methods (SFT, DPO, RL for agents), distillation, inference-time scaling, and quantisation and serving trade-offs at small parameter counts. You should have a view on where architecture ends and the model begins.

You treat performance, reliability, cost, safety and interpretability as one connected set of constraints, and you make reasonable calls when the problem is loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.

Qualifications

* Five or more years in research engineering, systems, or ML infrastructure, with at least two on agentic or LLM-based systems. A PhD in ML, PL, systems or a related field counts toward this, as does equivalent industrial research work.
* A public record we can read: first-author publications at ML or systems venues, a maintained open-source project, a benchmark, or a substantial technical writeup. We weigh a well-argued repository as heavily as a paper.
* Demonstrated ownership of a system from design through production behavior.
  
  

Useful but not required: developer tooling or IDE internals, language servers and LSP, refactoring engines, compiler work, large monorepo or legacy modernisation programs, RL infrastructure, and alignment, interpretability or safety tooling in production.

We publish. We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric

title: Architect - Data Modeller
description:

If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Architect Data Modeler**
**Exp Range**
: 8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job Location**
: Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Modeler is responsible for the structural design of the platform's canonical and derived data assets. You will own the Common Data Model (CDM) at the schema level — the dimension, fact, bridge, and reference tables that hold normalized clinical, claims, and demographic data — and the source-to-target mappings (STTMs) that define how source-system data lands in CDM and how CDM data is reshaped into FHIR resources.
  
  
This role is hands-on. You will produce schema designs in collaboration with the architect, write STTM specifications that engineers implement against, and work with clinical informatics and source-system experts to ensure the model accurately reflects the data's clinical and operational meaning. Your output is the contract between source data and CDM, and between CDM and downstream consumers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the schema-level design of the Common Data Model — DIM (patient, person, encounter, provider, organization), FACT (observation, diagnosis, procedure, medication administration, claim line, encounter), BRIDGE (relationship-qualifier-aware), and REF (terminology and crosswalk) tables. Design columns, types, NULL semantics, hash key composition, SCD2 patterns, and partitioning strategies in coordination with the architect
* Develop and maintain Source-to-Target Mappings (STTMs) for every source-system feed — EPIC HL7v2 ADT/ORU/ORM, Cerner HL7v2, ambulatory EHR feeds, state HIE CCDA, payer claims CSVs, FHIR ingestion. STTMs specify field-by-field source-path → CDM-column mapping with explicit transformation, NULL handling, and validation rules
* Develop and maintain STTMs for FHIR serialization — for each in-scope US Core 6.1 resource (Patient, Encounter, Condition, Observation, Procedure, Practitioner, Organization, AllergyIntolerance), specify how every FHIR element derives from CDM columns, including cardinality, profile constraints, and terminology bindings
* Design data product schemas — the longitudinal patient mart, population analytics aggregations, risk adjustment marts, HEDIS measure pre-aggregations. Each data product has a defined grain, columns, and refresh semantics
* Author and maintain unit specs at the model level under the spec-driven development framework. Each table has a versioned spec; model changes go through the spec review process before implementation
* Collaborate with data engineers to translate model specs into dbt implementations. Review dbt model code for adherence to the spec, including column naming, hash key construction, SCD2 macro usage, and test coverage
* Participate in source-system data profiling — analyze sample data from each source to identify quality issues, edge cases, and modeling implications before specs are finalized. Profile findings drive STTM design
* Define and enforce reference data (REF) management practices — terminology crosswalks (LOINC, SNOMED, ICD-10, RxNorm, CPT), source-code-to-standard-code mappings, and the SCD2 patterns that govern reference data evolution
* Document data dictionaries, lineage, and the canonical model glossary. Engage with Atlan or equivalent governance tooling to publish model documentation for downstream consumers
* Work with clinical informaticists and source-system experts to validate that the model and STTMs accurately represent clinical reality. STTMs are the contract between engineering and clinical informatics; you own that contract

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field
* 5+ years of data modeling experience for large-scale data warehouses, data lakes, or data platforms
* Demonstrated ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models — dimensional modeling (Kimball), data vault, or hybrid patterns. This project uses a Kimball-influenced canonical model with SCD2 dimensions and per-source row preservation
* Strong SQL proficiency. Experience reading and reviewing dbt SQL models is required; ability to author dbt models is a plus
* Experience modeling for analytical and operational data layers simultaneously — understanding how a normalized canonical model serves both downstream analytics and FHIR API consumers
* Hands-on experience with healthcare data standards — HL7v2 segment-level structure, CCDA document structure, and FHIR R4 resource models. Familiarity with US Core profiles and FHIR Bundle composition
* Experience producing source-to-target mappings (STTMs) at field-level granularity for multi-source data integration projects
* Experience modeling SCD2 patterns and the operational implications of late-arriving data, restatement, and version closure
* Experience with terminology systems used in healthcare — LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, CPT, RxNorm — and their crosswalk patterns
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform data services (Cloud Storage, BigLake, Dataproc) and open table formats. Direct Iceberg experience is a plus
* Strong written communication skills. STTMs and model documentation are read across engineering, QA, clinical, and governance audiences

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Direct experience with the Optum Health Data Engine canonical model or comparable healthcare canonical models (OMOP, PCORnet CDM, Sentinel)
* Experience with master data management modeling — patient matching attributes, source-system identifier preservation, ECI lifecycle
* Experience with Atlan or comparable governance and lineage tooling
* Hands-on dbt authorship including macros, tests, and project structure
* Familiarity with FHIR Implementation Guides beyond US Core (CARIN BB, Da Vinci, IPA)
* Experience with data modeling tools (ER/Studio, Erwin, dbdiagram, SqlDBM) for diagram production

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*
