title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Job Overview**
General Mills, Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Sr Data Scientist to join the Data Science team. Data Scientists within our team are dedicated to build enterprise intelligent automations and enable Core ML, Deep Learning, Generative AI solutions on various use cases in CPG. They are also responsible for curating a community of practice to determine the best standards and practices around data science at General Mills.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead the design and delivery of scalable data science solutions that solve high-value business problems across Core ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
* Partner with business stakeholders to frame problems, translate needs into measurable outcomes, and communicate insights and recommendations clearly.
* Develop and evaluate ML models across regression, classification, forecasting, optimization, NLP, and deep learning, apply robust experimentation, evaluation, and error-analysis practices.
* Design and implement Agentic AI, LLM, NLP, and RAG solutions, including data curation, ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval optimization, fine-tuning, and human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* Define and maintain business semantics, including ontologies, taxonomies, and metadata, to enable consistent retrieval and reasoning across enterprise information.
* Collaborate with ML engineers and systems engineers to deploy, monitor, and improve production models, proactively address performance degradation and maintainability through MLOps practices.
* Champion Responsible AI by applying privacy, security, governance, transparency, and bias-reduction practices throughout solution design and delivery.
* Provide technical leadership through solution reviews, consultation, and constructively challenge other data scientist on the approach.
* Contribute to best practices as we evaluate new platforms, tools, and pipelines.
* Apply sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques for complex, diverse business problems.
* Build connections with senior internal and external experts to bring relevant perspectives into solution design.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships, manage priorities and delivery commitments, and represent Data Science as a thought partner across functions.
* Mentor junior data scientists, interns, and contractors and support their technical and domain development.
* Stay current on industry trends, lead applied research aligned to business needs, and contribute to relevant open-source innovation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10-12 years of relevant analytics or data science experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering production ML and AI solutions.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline from a Tier 1 institute.
* Strong expertise in supervised machine learning, including regression, decision trees, ensemble methods, time series, forecasting, neural networks, and model performance tuning, exposure to unsupervised learning and NLP.
* Strong understanding of production ML practices, including MLOps, containerization, data lineage, model monitoring, and visualization.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL and Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with Agile delivery practices, including sprints, estimation, and daily stand-ups.
* Strong stakeholder management, consulting, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience in the FMCG/CPG domain, supply chain analytics experience is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in leading the design and implementation of complex end-to-end data science solutions using Generative AI, LLM, NLP, Agentic AI, or RAG from business problem framing and data curation through fine-tuning, evaluation, and production deployment.
* Strong understanding and experience in architecting high-quality Agentic AI and RAG workflows, including data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, and optimizing retrieval performance using established frameworks and vector stores.
* Expertise in hypothesis-driven experimentation, defining robust evaluation strategies, error taxonomies, and human-in-the-loop reviews.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI tooling such as Vertex AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, embeddings, or vector databases.
* Experience with deep learning, optimization, or operations research.
* Experience with GCP architecture and enterprise-scale AI solution design.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals and Responsible AI governance.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Should be able to independently support and project manage workstreams involving multiple stakeholders, show strong sense of accountability and decisiveness in strong work ethic
* Must be process oriented and organized, operate efficiently to deliver high-quality work in a fast paced and dynamic environment across different teams

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Who are we looking for?**

We are hiring a technical owner for our in-house AI products. This is a mid-layer engineering role. You will own the products we have already built, upgrade them, take them through to deployment, and stay close enough to users that the product actually gets adopted.

You are a technical resource first. You write, review, and ship. You understand the stack, the models, the infra, and the business problem well enough to make the right build decisions yourself.

**What you will own**

* In-house AI products: architecture, upgrades, quality, and release until deployment
* Technical execution for AI development happening inside the company
* Software and hardware infrastructure the products run on (hosting, servers, environments, usage, cost, reliability)
* Product adoption from a technical side: rollout, stability, usability, and feedback into the next build

**What will be your key responsibilities?**

**Build, upgrade, deploy**

* Own development and upgrades from design through testing to production
* Work in the codebase: architecture, AI tooling, integrations, and release quality
* Definition of done is deployment. Code that is written but not live is not done
* Keep the product stable: fewer regressions, less leftover WIP, faster path from change to live

**Technical ownership**

* Own the in-house AI product(s) as a builder: what we ship, how it is built, and whether it holds up in production
* Turn business problems into technical solutions, not a list of tickets for someone else
* Make build vs buy vs ignore calls on AI tools, models, and frameworks

**Infrastructure**

* Stay hands-on with hosting, servers, environments, usage, and cost
* Size infra to the product. Reliability and spend are part of the job, not a side conversation
* Keep product decisions and server reality aligned

**AI and technology**

* Stay current on AI tools, models, frameworks, and how the market is moving
* Recommend what we should adopt, what we should skip, and what we should build ourselves
* Keep the stack current without chasing every new tool

**Adoption and business lens**

* Treat adoption as a core outcome. A product that is live but unused has failed
* Support internal rollout with a product that is stable, fast, and easy to use in real workflows
* Measure usage and drop-off, then feed that back into what you build next
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, speed, trade-offs, and whether this makes the business better

**What are the key requirements for the role?**

* 4-6yrs of strong technical base: architecture, APIs, data flow, models, and deployment. You can build, not only describe
* Hands-on with AI products and the current AI toolchain (LLMs, embeddings, agents, evaluation, orchestration)
* Working knowledge of software and hardware/infra: hosting, servers, environments, basic networking and usage
* Experience taking a product from build to live yourself, ideally an internal tool or AI product in a services / professional-firm environment
* Cloud hosting, cost optimisation, and production monitoring experience
* Product sense with a business lens: adoption, value, and cost, not only shipping features
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, bias to action, comfort with incomplete information
* Clear communicator with engineers and with the business
* Comfort helping people move from old workflows onto a new product
* Mid-level: you can run this without being managed day to day

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

* Complete required training and engage in development discussions; where supervisory responsibilities apply, support safety leadership, coaching, talent development, succession planning and retention.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Data Science or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in business analysis, ERP/CRM transformation, data analysis, process improvement, reporting, implementation or a related role.
* Experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, business-rule documentation, traceability and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience with source-to-target mapping, reconciliation, data quality, controls, testing, defect management, UAT, cutover readiness or stabilization.

* Working knowledge of ERP/CRM data structures and their impact on Commercial processes, reporting, controls, interfaces, workflows, applications and analytics.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs for technical teams.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities and dependencies, escalate risks and collaborate across global teams and flexible time zones.
* Focus on data quality, security, controls, supportability, business continuity and measurable outcomes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to a JDE-to-Oracle Fusion transition, Oracle Fusion implementation, Atlas or a comparable enterprise transformation.
* Experience with Salesforce or another CRM upgrade/migration involving customer, account, opportunity, pricing, contract, tender, product and activity data.
* Experience with JDE, Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, EDW, WDF, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Alteryx or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Certification or formal training in business analysis, project delivery, ERP, CRM, process improvement, data analytics, testing or change management.
* Experience in energy, oilfield services, industrial businesses or other global matrix organizations.

title: Team Lead - Capacity Planning
description:
**Role:**

The Capacity Planner plays a crucial role in ensuring efficient resource allocation and optimal utilization of available capacity within the organization. This role involves analyzing historical data, forecasting future demand, and developing strategic plans to align workforce capacity with business requirements. The Capacity Planner collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to identify capacity gaps, recommend solutions, and implement effective workforce management strategies.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Analyze historical data, trends, and patterns to forecast future demand for resources across various business units or projects.
* Develop and maintain capacity models, incorporating factors such as skill sets, workload fluctuations, and resource availability to ensure optimal resource utilization.
* Collaborate with project managers, operations teams, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand resource needs, and align capacity planning efforts with organizational goals.
* Monitor and report on capacity metrics, such as utilization rates, capacity gaps, and resource allocation effectiveness, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
* Identify potential capacity risks or bottlenecks and propose proactive mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity and meet service level agreements (SLAs).
* Participate in resource planning meetings, presenting capacity analysis and recommendations to support informed decision-making.
* Develop and maintain capacity planning tools, templates, and dashboards to streamline data collection, analysis, and reporting processes.
* Stay up-to-date with industry best practices, trends, and emerging technologies in capacity planning and workforce management.

**Criteria:**

* Any Graduation
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in capacity planning, workforce management, or resource planning roles.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in using capacity planning tools, spreadsheet applications, and data visualization software.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Our Philosophy

Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Core Risk Governance – Technology & Risk, RQA, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
Managing risk is central to BlackRock’s investment process. Risk & Quantitative Analysis provides independent oversight of investment and enterprise risks and helps strengthen risk management across the firm.
  
  
Core Risk Governance team which sits in RQA India as part of Core Risk Management team, brings together risk governance, analytics and exception management capabilities to deliver scalable and resilient risk oversight across BlackRock’s investment risk platform.
  
  
The team focuses on making processes more consistent, controlled, automated, and easy to use through better data, reporting, analytics, and technology solutions.
  
  
Core Risk Management is extending its location strategy to Mumbai. This role will be the first senior hire supporting teams expansion in new location and will play a critical role in establishing the leadership, culture, operating discipline, and technical capability needed to build a successful Mumbai presence.
  
  
**Job Purpose / Background**
The Vice President, Core Risk Governance – Technology & Risk, will be the senior Core Risk Management leader based in Mumbai and a key member of the Core Risk Governance team.
  
  
This is a highly visible leadership role combining people management, technical delivery, risk expertise, and location build-out. The successful candidate will establish and lead the initial Mumbai team, create strong connectivity with the Gurgaon organization, and help build a cohesive, high-performing, and scalable multi-location operating model.
  
  
The role requires a seasoned leader with more than 10 years of experience managing teams, strong hands-on technical capabilities, and meaningful experience in risk management or financial services. The Vice President will lead the design and delivery of technology, data, analytics, reporting, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that strengthen risk governance and oversight.
  
  
The VP will combine strategic judgment with the ability to engage deeply in solution design and execution. The successful candidate will set high standards for talent, technology delivery, controls, operational resilience, and stakeholder outcomes while helping shape the long-term growth of Core Risk Management in Mumbai.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior Core Risk Management leader in Mumbai and establish a strong local presence aligned with the wider Gurgaon-based organization.
* Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team across technology, data, analytics, and risk-governance capabilities.
* Create an inclusive and connected team culture, ensuring strong collaboration, consistent standards, and effective knowledge sharing between Mumbai and Gurgaon.
* Support the phased development of the Mumbai location, including talent strategy, hiring, onboarding, capability building, workforce planning, and leadership development.
* Provide direct or matrix leadership to Mumbai-based analysts, associates, interns, and future hires, ensuring clear accountability and effective integration into their respective Core Risk Management teams.
* Help shape the Core Risk Governance technology, data, automation, and AI roadmap, translating business and risk priorities into scalable solutions.
* Lead the end-to-end delivery of technology and analytics initiatives from problem definition and solution design through testing, implementation, adoption, and production support.
* Provide strong technical leadership across Python, SQL, data engineering, cloud and enterprise data platforms, automation, analytics, application development, and AI-enabled workflows.
* Remain sufficiently hands-on to review solution architecture, challenge technical approaches, resolve complex delivery issues, and raise engineering and analytical standards.
* Partner with Risk, Investment, Data, Technology, Compliance, and Control teams to understand business requirements and deliver practical, controlled, and sustainable outcomes.
* Apply risk-management expertise to the development of reporting, analytics, controls, monitoring, and governance solutions that support investment-risk oversight and senior decision-making.
* Establish disciplined delivery standards covering software and product development lifecycles, testing, documentation, code quality, access management, issue tracking, release governance, and operational resilience.
* Build robust data-quality checks, monitoring, exception management, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, and escalation processes for risk analytics and AI-enabled applications.
* Ensure solutions are accurate, transparent, explainable, secure, user-focused, and aligned with relevant risk, data, technology, privacy, and control expectations.
* Assess emerging technologies and AI capabilities, balancing innovation and speed with reliability, safety, governance, and appropriate human oversight.
* Communicate priorities, risks, delivery progress, and key decisions clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership forums.
* Act as a role model for ownership, collaboration, sound judgment, technical excellence, and talent development.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
* More than 10 years of relevant experience across technology, data, analytics, risk management, investment management, or financial services.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams for at least 5 years, including people management, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and building leadership depth.
* Proven ability to establish or significantly scale a team, capability, or location while maintaining strong connectivity with a broader global or multi-location organization.
* Strong hands-on technical capability in Python, SQL, data engineering, cloud platforms, enterprise data solutions, automation, analytics, or application development.
* Experience designing and delivering complex technology, data, analytics, or AI-enabled solutions in a controlled production environment.
* Strong understanding of modern solution architecture, data pipelines, system integration, secure development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Meaningful experience in risk management, investment management, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, governance, controls, or a closely related financial-services discipline.
* Ability to connect technical design with risk context, business outcomes, user needs, and control requirements.
* Proven experience translating complex business and risk requirements into clear technical strategy, delivery priorities, and executable plans.
* Strong understanding of data governance, including ownership, data quality, lineage, reconciliation, metadata, access controls, and audit-ready documentation.
* Experience with artificial intelligence, large language models, agentic workflows, search, document intelligence, workflow automation, or AI governance is highly desirable.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively, navigate ambiguity, and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex risk and technology topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Key Attributes**

* A senior people leader who can create followership, develop talent, and build a strong local culture from the ground up.
* A credible technical leader who can operate at both strategic and detailed levels.
* Strong risk judgment and an appreciation for independent oversight, governance, controls, and operational resilience.
* A builder’s mindset, with the ability to establish new capabilities and convert ambiguity into a clear operating model.
* High standards for quality, transparency, accountability, and execution.
* Strong ownership and the ability to lead through influence across teams, locations, and seniority levels.
* A collaborative and inclusive approach that strengthens connectivity between Mumbai, Gurgaon, and global partners.
* A pragmatic innovator who balances speed and ambition with safety, sustainability, and control.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

**Job Summary**
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in biostatistics and statistical programming focuses on designing programming and validating clinical study analyses using SAS and Base SAS. The professional will support global teams by transforming complex clinical and observational data into reliable statistical outputs that drive regulatory submissions healthcare decisions and innovative therapies ensuring high quality and compliance in every deliverable.

* Transform complex clinical trial and observational datasets into well structured analysis datasets using SAS and Base SAS to enable robust statistical evaluation of study outcomes.
* Develop maintain and optimize reusable SAS programs and macros that streamline recurring statistical programming tasks and improve efficiency across multiple clinical projects.
* Create accurate tables listings and figures from clinical data using SAS procedures and data step programming to support study reports and regulatory documentation.
* Validate programming outputs through independent code review and rigorous comparison against specifications to ensure consistency traceability and regulatory grade quality.
* Collaborate closely with biostatistics and data management teams to interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into detailed programming specifications and execution steps.
* Apply biostatistical principles to implement standard and advanced analyses that address efficacy safety and exploratory endpoints in clinical and post marketing studies.

* Document all programming activities including dataset derivations logic decisions and validation evidence in a clear and audit ready manner aligned with company and regulatory standards.
* Contribute to continuous process improvement by proposing refinements to programming workflows standard code libraries and quality control practices that enhance delivery speed and reliability.
* Support cross functional reviews by explaining statistical programming approaches and findings in a concise and accessible way that enables informed decision making by study stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of programming deliverables with global compliance expectations for clinical research including adherence to internal policies and recognized biostatistical programming conventions.
* Participate in hybrid meetings and knowledge sharing sessions to exchange best practices in SAS programming and biostatistics fostering a collaborative and learning oriented environment.
* Advance the company mission to improve patient outcomes by delivering statistical evidence that supports safe effective and innovative medical solutions used in healthcare systems worldwide.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate solid hands on proficiency in SAS and Base SAS including data manipulation reporting and macro usage gained through two to four years of dedicated statistical programming experience.
* Apply strong knowledge of statistical programming concepts such as dataset derivation analysis data structures and standardization to build reliable and reproducible outputs.
* Utilize practical understanding of biostatistics including common clinical trial endpoints and statistical methods to implement analyses that are scientifically sound and contextually appropriate.
* Show capability to read write and speak English at a novice native level sufficient to understand requirements prepare documentation and participate in basic project discussions.

SAS Certified Specialist Base Programming or equivalent statistical programming certification relevant to SAS and biostatistics.

title: Process Mining Consultant
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
We are seeking a Process Mining Consultant with 10+ years of total experience including 2-3 years of experience reading, interpreting, and translating process mining insights into decisions that process efficiency and/or effectiveness. This role will partner with business stakeholders, process owners, continuous improvement (CI) analysts, and digital and technology (D&T) to deliver use cases using process mining technology, to create as-is process maps, and convert data-driven findings to business-actionable insight. Sitting within the Strategy & Operational Excellence function, this person will be responsible for supporting key initiatives under General Mills' CI and process mining program.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and process-improvement discipline with a practical understanding of how process mining and business intelligence outputs work, enabling them to partner effectively with Process Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and D&T. This person should be able to translate technical process mining output into structured, plain-language narratives that business stakeholders can act on and help drive improvement opportunities from insight to committed action.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Business Partnership & Process Discovery**

* Partner with process owners and SMEs to scope use cases, define KPIs, and co create current-state process maps.
* Interpret exception patterns, rework loops, and conformance gaps. Turn findings into clear visuals and actionable business narratives.
* Facilitate cross-functional workshops to share findings and build pipeline of improvement opportunities.

**Insight & Value Delivery**

* Quantify cycle-time, Order Touches, Lead Time, waiting-time, rework impact, and correlate findings to business KPIs (DSO, OTIF, cycle time etc.).
* Classify activities as value-add, non-value-add, or required non-value-add. Build an automation roadmap for D&T prioritization.
* Build insights dashboards for process owners and sponsors presentations. Participate in monthly readouts and create action tracker as per discussion and deliver outcomes as required.
* Validate process-mining outputs for accuracy and completeness. Identify data or coverage gaps for D&T to resolve.
* Translate D&T’s technical data work into practical business insights grounded in reliable source data.
* Understand how source systems feed the process-mining tool. Use this knowledge to challenge findings and ask informed questions.

**Capability Building**

* Help internal teams on how to read and apply process mining insights.
* Contribute to the process-mining playbook and methodology.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
* 10+ years of professional experience, including 2-3 years in process mining or business analysis using Signavio.
* Hands-on experience with Signavio, or another process-mining tool from user side.
* Experience working across markets, systems, geographies, and time zones in a large, matrixed organization.

**Process and Technical Knowledge**

* Ability to turn process-mining, analytics, or BI outputs into actionable business insights.
* Strong knowledge of process mapping, variant analysis, conformance checking, and KPI design, in partnership with D&T.
* Strong working knowledge of P2P, R2R, and O2C processes.
* Ability to apply process-mining techniques to identify rework, cycle-time issues, exceptions, and control gaps.
* Working knowledge of data flows, dashboards, analytics platforms, source-system integration, and process-level data models.

**Core Skills**

* Ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean/Six Sigma Green Belt/ Black Belt
* Certification in a recognized process mining platform (preferably in Signavio or Celonis Data Analyst)
* Background in a large, complex enterprise environment with exposure to core business processes such as Supply Chain Operations, HR, or Finance.
* Exposure to change management, process improvement, or product delivery practices

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Information Technology Intern

We produce globally recognized brands and build leaders across functions. You'll work in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning - with the opportunity to make a real impact early in your career.

title: Analyst, CMBS Ratings - India
description:
About Us: Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and structured finance instruments globally. Currently with 700 employees in eight offices globally. Formed through the July 2019 acquisition of DBRS by Morningstar, Inc., the ratings business is the fourth-largest provider of credit ratings in the world. Morningstar DBRS is committed to empowering investor success, serving the market through leading-edge technology and raising the bar for the industry. Morningstar DBRS is a market leader in Canada, the U.S. and Europe in multiple asset classes. Morningstar DBRS rates more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities worldwide and is driven to bringing more clarity, diversity of opinion, and responsiveness to the ratings process. Morningstar DBRS approach and size provide the agility to respond to customers’ needs, while being large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources. Visit: https://dbrs.morningstar.com/ to learn more.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a member of the CMBS team, you will conduct thorough quantitative and qualitative research on the underlying loans and properties that collateralize Commercial Mortgage Backed Securities transactions. In addition, you will assist the onshore team with setting up Net Cash flow models; assist with special projects/initiatives, as needed. With some seasoning, you also will be expected to have thorough understanding underwriting and support on various other task across the ratings value chain. This position is based in our Navi Mumbai office.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze the credit risk in SF securities by performing tasks that includes reviewing deal documents, analyzing periodic data and setting up net cashflow templates.
* Collect, organize and analyze data from internal and external sources for use in criteria development, ratings and research reports.
* Accurate and timely retrieval, analysis, research and reporting of CMBS pool level and property level performance, including:
* Identifying and analyzing risky assets based upon qualitative and quantitative factors o Identifying macro and micro risk factors, including market, property type, tenant, and borrower, to determine and measure exposure within the CMBS pools and loan portfolios.
* Monitoring, analysis, and executive summary reporting on CMBS transactions, including an investigation of potential default or loss scenarios for underlying real estate loan collateral.
* Compile and prepare periodic portfolio reports for use by senior staff and identify material changes for research causes.
* Maintain regular and open communication with the operations team and technology team about assigned tasks, priorities and ensure applications under development meet the defined requirements and pass the user acceptance testing prior to its release.
* Take ownership of the tasks with focus on quality and accuracy of the deliverables
* Demonstrate strong learning curve and eagerness to move up the rating value chain
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and company policies and procedures.

**Requirements**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in a credit research domain, with knowledge of CMBS, experience at a rating agency is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance or Management Studies
* Masters, CFA or CFA program enrollment are a plus
* Fluent in English, with good verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Highly motivated, self-starter who is keen to learn, has a positive attitude and a strong work ethic
* Ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and deliver results in a timely manner
* Good inter-personal skills and ability to participate/ contribute as a team player
* Experience with Intex, REIS and CBRE is a plus

Morningstar DBRS is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
**About Us**
Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and project and structured finance instruments globally. Rating more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities, it is one of the top four credit rating agencies in the world.
  
  
Morningstar DBRS empowers investor success by bringing more transparency and a much-needed diversity of opinion in the credit rating industry. Our approach and size allow us to be nimble enough to respond to customers' needs in their local markets, but large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources they require. Market innovators choose to work with us because of our agility, tech-forward approach, and exceptional customer service.
  
  
Morningstar DBRS is the next generation of credit ratings.
  
  
If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker.

title: Senior MLOps Engineer
description:
**Job Scope:**

As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you will own the operational backbone that takes AI models from experimentation to reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient production.

This role sits at the intersection of AI/ML, infrastructure, and DevOps. You will ensure models are reproducible, observable, secure, and continuously improving in real-world environments. You will work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, infrastructure teams, and product leaders to operationalize AI at enterprise scale workflows.

**Experience:**

5–8 years of relevant experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, or AI Platform roles.

**Key Responsibilities:**

A. Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management

• Design and maintain robust pipelines for model training, validation, deployment, rollback, and versioning.

• Own end-to-end model lifecycle management across experimentation, staging, and production.

• Enable safe and repeatable promotion of models using CI/CD practices.

• Implement model registry and artifact management systems.

B. MLOps Infrastructure & Tooling

• Build and manage MLOps platforms using tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Ray, Airflow, or equivalent.

• Design scalable inference architectures for batch and real-time serving (REST, gRPC).

• Optimize GPU/CPU utilization for training and inference workloads.

• Collaborate with infra teams on Kubernetes-based model serving and orchestration.

C. Monitoring, Observability & Reliability

• Implement monitoring for model performance, drift, data quality, latency, and cost.

• Build alerting systems for model degradation and infrastructure failures.

• Enable explainability, logging, and traceability for AI outputs where required.

• Perform root-cause analysis for model or pipeline failures.

D. Data & Experimentation Pipelines

• Design reproducible data pipelines for training, validation, and inference.

• Ensure dataset versioning, lineage tracking, and schema enforcement.

• Support A/B testing, canary deployments, and controlled model experiments.

• Integrate feedback loops from production back into retraining workflows.

E. Security, Compliance & Governance

• Enforce security best practices for model access, secrets, and credentials.

• Ensure compliance with data privacy and AI governance standards (GDPR, SOC2, India DPDP Act).

• Build audit trails for model decisions in regulated or sensitive use cases.

• Partner with legal, security, and compliance teams on AI governance frameworks.

F. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement

• Work closely with AI/ML engineers to productionize research outputs.

• Collaborate with Product Managers to align model SLAs with business expectations.

• Enable developers and internal teams with reusable MLOps templates and tooling.

• Mentor junior MLOps or ML engineers through code reviews and best practices.

**Qualification:**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Engineering, or related field.

• 8 plus years of experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, or AI infrastructure roles.

• Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).

• Hands-on experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Ray, Airflow, or similar MLOps stacks.

• Experience with CI/CD for ML (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Jenkins).

• Strong experience deploying models on Kubernetes with GPU workloads

• Solid experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).

• Proven track record of deploying and maintaining AI models in production.

• Experience supporting AI systems at scale with real users and SLAs.

**sadhatrao@yotta.com**

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
AI Platform Engineer
  
  
**Department**
: CEFS IT (CRM&S - CRM)
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
CIB
  
  
**Experience Required**
: 7+ years in software engineering, AI engineering or related fields (or equivalent proven experience)
  
  
**Product:**
AI‑Native CRM Platforms
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Looking for a highly skilled candidate with 7+ years of experience to join our dynamic development team as an AI Platform Engineer. In this role, the candidate will architect and deploy autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agentic systems designed to automate complex CRM+ application features and orchestrate multi-step processes across enterprise data. This is an exceptional opportunity for a candidate to drive innovation in Agentic AI, RAG pipelines, and LLMOps within a high-scale, regulated corporate and institutional banking environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy autonomous and semi‑autonomous AI agents that automate CRM workflows (sales assistance, support automation, lead qualification) and orchestrate multi‑step processes across enterprise data. Implement permission‑aware tool adapters, bounded autonomy, guard‑rails, escalation mechanisms and full audit‑logging to satisfy AML and security compliance
* Build production‑grade Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that ingest structured and unstructured data, perform chunking, embedding, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, metadata filtering and re‑ranking using vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate). Create reusable LLM abstraction layers that support multiple model providers and open‑weight models, with model routing, fall‑backs, rate‑limiting, cost‑tracking and token‑consumption optimization (caching, context‑window management)
* Design and implement robust state & memory management for autonomous agents—handle checkpointing, persistent context storage, efficient serialization/retrieval, and scalable memory‑access patterns to support long‑running, multi‑turn interactions while maintaining consistency and compliance.
* Develop AI‑powered CRM capabilities such as customer profiling, lead qualification, meeting preparation, interaction summarization, follow‑up generation and next‑best‑action recommendation. Build natural‑language interfaces that let users query customer information, generate insights and trigger workflows conversationally. Enable agents to retrieve context, update CRM records and execute authorized actions while integrating LLM reasoning with business‑rule engines and existing CRM processes
* Engineer scalable backend services and APIs (Python, FastAPI, async) that expose agent functionality, integrate with CRM systems, databases, email/calendar services, document repositories and external APIs. Implement reliable execution patterns – background jobs, message queues, retries, timeouts, idempotency and fault tolerance – and construct event‑driven architectures with Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Design and operate AI‑infrastructure and LLMOps pipelines: containerize services (Docker), orchestrate on‑prem or cloud‑native Kubernetes clusters (Helm, Argo CD GitOps), manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and implement observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) together with model‑lifecycle tooling (MLflow, experiment tracking, model registry). Optimize latency, throughput, concurrency, resource utilization and inference cost; enforce access controls, tenant isolation, secrets management and audit trails.
  
  

* Provide technical leadership across product, engineering and compliance teams: own end‑to‑end architecture, prototype, productionise and maintain AI solutions; develop reusable frameworks and standards for agentic AI; conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor junior engineers; and continuously evaluate emerging agentic‑AI frameworks, models and deployment technologies for product relevance.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Proficiency in tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Familiarity with Oracle databases, Understanding schema, SQL
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long-term commitment with the team and organization

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Agentic AI & Multi‑Agent Systems – Mastery of LangGraph / LangChain, tool‑calling, function‑calling, planning, task decomposition, state management, checkpointing, retries, human‑in‑the‑loop approval and performance metrics (completion rate, accuracy, latency, cost).
* LLM & RAG Engineering – End‑to‑end RAG pipeline design, context‑engineering, prompt optimization, grounding, hallucination mitigation, token‑window management, caching strategies and multi‑provider model routing.
* AI‑Powered CRM Capability Design – Ability to translate CRM domain expertise into intelligent features (profiling, scoring, summarization, recommendation) and embed LLM‑driven reasoning with rule‑engine and workflow automation.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – Delivery of high‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), secure API‑gateway configuration (Kong) and robust integration adapters that enforce permission models and idempotent behavior.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps Practices – Deep experience with Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD), CI/CD automation, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki).
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Proficiency with SQL/relational databases, vector‑search technologies, document processing, feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data‑quality governance, schema evolution and caching.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Practical knowledge of scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training/evaluation, hyper‑parameter tuning and lifecycle management with MLflow.
* Security, Governance & Compliance – Implementation of permission‑aware tool execution, audit logging, model governance and adherence to AML, GDPR and internal risk‑management policies.
* Performance Measurement & Optimization – Definition and monitoring of agent/LLM metrics (accuracy, latency, cost), systematic A/B testing and optimization techniques (semantic caching, prompt caching, context compression).

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with vLLM, LoRA/QLoRA fine‑tuning, quantization and GPU‑based model serving behind firewalls.
* Hands‑on work with LLM evaluation and tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry or comparable tools.
* Advanced agentic‑AI patterns: durable execution, Model‑Context Protocol (MCP), persistent agent memory and sophisticated human‑in‑the‑loop workflows.
* Proficiency with common ML libraries (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) for rapid prototyping and model development.
* Knowledge‑graph expertise (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, JanusGraph) for large‑scale network analytics and entity resolution.
* Experience with large‑scale streaming and batch processing frameworks (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Delta Lake) and data‑pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow).
* Familiarity with multi‑tenant SaaS architecture, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, SSO and enterprise identity‑management solutions.
* Background in recommendation, ranking, lead‑scoring, customer segmentation, forecasting or churn‑prediction models for CRM intelligence.
* Infrastructure‑automation expertise (Terraform, Pulumi, GitOps, Helm, Argo CD) and sandbox quota management for GPU nodes.

**Specific Qualifications:**
NA
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Core Programming & Software Engineering – Python, FastAPI/Flask, asynchronous development, REST/GraphQL APIs, SQL/relational databases, Git version control, automated testing, CI/CD best practices.
* Agentic AI & LLM Engineering – LangGraph/LangChain, tool/function calling, state & memory management, planning, task decomposition, multi‑agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, vector‑DB integration, prompt engineering, cost & rate‑limit controls, model routing.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – High‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), API‑gateway configuration (Kong), rule‑engine integration (Drools or custom), secure credential handling, idempotent design.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps – Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD GitOps), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI), IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki), secrets management, tenant isolation.
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Structured and semi‑structured data handling, document ingestion & processing, embedding generation, vector‑search (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate), feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data lineage, quality and governance.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training, evaluation, hyper‑parameter optimization, MLflow experiment tracking, model registry and artifact versioning.
* Collaboration & Problem‑Solving – Cross‑functional communication, stakeholder alignment, comprehensive documentation, mentorship, systematic troubleshooting and adaptability to regulated environments.

**Behavioral Skills**

title: Consulting Architect - Search
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

title: Associate - CRM - Mumbai
description:
**Who We Are**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, global revenue exceeding USD 14 billion, and over 60 years of industry experience. We are a leading service provider for the mid-market with client service at our heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited is the Indian member firm of BDO International. We offer strategic, operational, accounting, tax, and regulatory advisory and assistance for both domestic and international organizations across various industries. Led by more than 300 Partners and Directors alongside a team of over 10,000 professionals across 12 key cities, BDO India is experiencing rapid growth, scaling our business dimensions and expanding our team multi-fold.

**Role Overview**

BDO India is seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven Associate CRM Data Management & Operations to oversee the integrity, quality, and governance of customer and business development data within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).

The role will be responsible for driving CRM data quality initiatives, managing stakeholder data requests, ensuring compliance with Master Data Management (MDM) standards, supporting user onboarding and access management, and partnering with internal teams to continuously improve CRM processes and data governance practices.

This position requires strong analytical capabilities, hands-on CRM administration experience, stakeholder management skills, and a proactive approach to driving operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**CRM Data Governance & Quality Management**

* Ensure the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of CRM data across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Quotes, and Orders.
* Conduct regular audits of CRM records against defined MDM standards and implement corrective actions to address data quality gaps.
* Lead data cleansing, de-duplication, validation, and enrichment initiatives to improve overall CRM data health.
* Maintain and monitor CRM data quality scorecards, identifying trends, risks, and areas requiring remediation.
* Track compliance with CRM data entry standards across business units and prepare periodic management reports.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen governance controls.
* Maintain documentation including data dictionaries, governance guidelines, audit logs, and process documentation.

**CRM Operations & Data Request Management**

* Manage the firm's CRM Data Request Management process, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of stakeholder requests.
* Review and approve account creation requests in line with established governance protocols.
* Facilitate backend creation and maintenance of Accounts, Contacts, and Leads within D365.
* Ensure adherence to defined service levels for all requests:
* Standard Requests Within 3 business days
* Priority Requests Within 1 business day
* Monitor request queues, maintain tracking logs, and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Analyze request patterns and identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and enhance self-service capabilities.
* Develop and maintain reusable reports, dashboards, and data assets to support business development and leadership requirements.

**Stakeholder & User Management**

* Act as a key point of contact for CRM-related data queries and support requests from Partners, Directors, and business teams.
* Support onboarding and offboarding of CRM users, ensuring appropriate role-based access and security controls.
* Collaborate with the Digital Office and relevant teams on data migration activities, system enhancements, configuration updates, and process improvements.
* Conduct user awareness sessions and promote adherence to CRM data governance standards and best practices.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports on data quality metrics, request turnaround times, compliance levels, and governance KPIs.
* Support the CRM Governance Lead in implementing data quality initiatives and governance frameworks.
* Identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness and user experience.
* Participate in CRM enhancement projects and contribute to the evolution of data governance capabilities within the firm.

**Qualifications, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
* 3 - 6 years of experience in CRM Operations, Data Management, Data Governance, or CRM Administration.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (preferred) or similar CRM platforms.
* Strong understanding of CRM data management, data quality, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI.
* Experience in data cleansing, de-duplication, reporting, and maintaining data integrity across large datasets.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Detail-oriented, process-driven, and committed to data accuracy and governance.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within defined SLAs.
* Excellent communication skills and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Thanks & Regards,

**SANIKET KADAM**

Senior Associate - Talent Acquisition

(Ranked #2 Pan India in Selection-to-Onboarding Efficiency and #3 in both Hiring Quality and Volume)

saniketkadam@bdo.in

29, Tulsi Pipe Rd, Dadar West,

Mumbai, Maharashtra 400028.

title: Data Coordinator (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To coordinate and drive the governance of commercial data quality across SAPAC — ensuring the accuracy, integrity and reliability of key commercial data and analytics — with ownership of the data remaining with the region's markets and functions.
  
  
The Data Coordinator leads the regional data governance function: monitoring data quality, facilitating improvement, coordinating audits, controls, standards, reporting and market execution, making issues transparent and escalating where necessary, while serving as SAPAC's representative in Getinge's global data governance network. Alongside the Data Steward, the role runs the region's verification and audit cadence and supports designated markets directly; as Lead, it additionally owns the Steering Committee reporting pack and carries named accountability for the regional baseline and governance plan.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
**Establish the capability (first 90 days)**

* Be formally registered as SAPAC Data Coordinator with Global Master Data Management; join the global Data Coordinator network and cadence; receive the relevant global data quality reporting, including the installed base quality report
* Adopt the global governance principles, definitions and available standards as the starting point for all regional work; identify where global standards apply before any regional standard is considered
* Establish the regional data governance scorecard and baseline each market against it, presenting it as the Steering Committee's standing Data Health Dashboard (named accountability)
* Stand up the Steering Committee reporting pack and a monthly service-findings call with the SAPAC Service Director
* Agree with the Steering Committee which markets are designated for direct execution, and establish the review-and-approval workflow with each market's Finance Director or nominated data owner
* With the Data Steward, agree the allocation of markets and recurring tasks between the two roles for committee approval

**Lead accountabilities (ongoing)**

* Prepare the Steering Committee pack each cycle: scorecard movement, audit findings, execution volumes, governance/execution time split, escalations
* Represent SAPAC in the global Data Coordinator network: bring regional issues, gaps and requirements into the global governance process
* Escalate systemic issues that cannot be resolved regionally through the global process rather than creating local workarounds
* Facilitate business-owned regional standards (see below) and monitor their adoption by market
* Apply the agreed prioritisation rule between committee meetings; escalate unresolved conflicts to the chair

**Run the regional governance cadence**

* Quarterly audit of annual price-increase application by market — timeliness of list and contract price application, with revenue impact of any delay (distinct from the per-load accuracy verification run by the Data Steward)
* Quarterly credit-note root-cause analysis and trending by market and category — asking why each pattern occurs and which process or ownership issue sits behind it
* Quarterly reporting of service-contract renewal timing against the regional standard
* Half-yearly field-safety traceability tests: verify that sampled equipment can be located to a functional location and customer within target time
* Coordinate the installed base accuracy programme: the global IB report relationship, the country accuracy score, and escalations — data ownership stays with the market and service organisation; corrections are executed by the Data Steward
* Interpret cost-to-price reconciliation results in the quarterly report (reconciliations are run by the Data Steward)
* Share recurring verification and reporting across markets with the Data Steward under the agreed allocation

**Execution for designated markets**

* Review price files prepared by the Data Steward before load, and coordinate the Finance Director sign-off workflow for each designated market
* Ensure every executed change carries a documented market approval so ownership and audit trail stay with the market
* Execute directly under the agreed market allocation where capacity requires

**Facilitate regional standards**

* Controlled price-override standard, and a lightweight pricing-discrepancy case log with root-cause categories distinguishing data error, process error and customer-side causes (Regional Finance)
* Two-person validation standard for pricing and master data changes (Regional Finance)
* Service-contract renewal-timing standard — renewal gaps and backdating (SAPAC Service Director)
* Service-contract structure that makes preventive-maintenance parts inclusion visible in the system (SAPAC Service Director)
* Regional renewal-approval standard — documented multi-level sign-off, drawing on existing good practice in the region (SAPAC Service Director with SSU leadership)
* Distributor installed-base collection standard, building on existing good practice in the region (SAPAC Service Director with market leadership)
* Consistent service-hours definitions — billable / non-billable / non-productive (SAPAC Service Director)
* Structured escalation of issues outside the region's control to global process owners, with documented business impact (Global MDM / global process owners)

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated on Phase 1 results)**

* Validate the data feeding the global contract profitability reports and supplement with regional analysis, with Finance as business partner
* Like-for-like benchmarking of pricing and service KPIs across markets once definitions are standardised
* Scope further analytics with the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have**

* 4–8 years in data governance, master data management, finance operations or commercial operations, with experience facilitating standards or controls and getting them adopted across teams
* Working knowledge of SAP master data: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and installed base, service contracts
* Strong analytical skills in Excel and Power BI; comfortable profiling data, building reconciliations and presenting exceptions to senior stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority — across markets, functions and cultures, with people who do not report to you
* The ability to distinguish a data-quality symptom from the underlying process or ownership issue, and to drive prevention of recurrence rather than repeated correction
* Fluent written and spoken English; clear, concise written reporting
* Resilience and persistence — establishing a new regional capability is a marathon rather than a project

**Good to have**

* An analytics background or a clear ambition to grow into analytics — the role has a defined Phase 2 pathway into regional analytics and benchmarking
* Experience in a regulated medical-technology or life-sciences environment (ISO 13485 awareness, field safety corrective action traceability)
* Familiarity with CPQ, Salesforce or service-management systems
* Experience working with distributor channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Principal Engineer, AI Platform
description:
**Job Role: Full Stack Principal Engineer, AI Platform**

**Office Location: Andheri East, Mumbai**

**About Accrete**

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.

At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Full Stack Principal Engineer**
to join our
**AI Platform team**
. The ideal candidate will have a
**PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field**
and a strong background in designing and building AI-driven systems. You will play a pivotal role in architecting, building, and scaling the platform that powers Accrete's AI products and agentic systems.

This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
. You will work across the full technology stack while driving architectural decisions, solving complex engineering challenges, and shaping the technical direction of the AI Platform. You will collaborate closely with software engineers, ML engineers, data scientists, and product teams to turn advanced AI capabilities into reliable, scalable, and production-ready systems.

**What You'll Do**

**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of core components of the AI Platform.
* Drive technical direction across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and platform services.
* Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable systems for complex AI agent workloads.
* Solve complex and ambiguous technical problems and make sound architectural decisions considering scalability, performance, reliability, cost, and time-to-market.
* Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical risks and proactively drive solutions.
* Establish engineering best practices across system design, code quality, testing, security, observability, and maintainability.

**Full-Stack & AI Platform Development**

* Design and build end-to-end features across frontend and backend systems.
* Develop scalable APIs, services, and core libraries that power AI applications and agents.
* Build developer-facing tools and intuitive interfaces for interacting with AI models, agents, and data.
* Design and develop infrastructure for securely running and orchestrating AI agents and AI workloads in production.
* Integrate AI/ML models, data pipelines, and emerging AI capabilities into production systems.
* Build modular platform components that can evolve with advances in AI technology.

**Scalability, Innovation & Collaboration**

* Architect systems for high performance, availability, scalability, and fault tolerance.
* Drive improvements in platform reliability, latency, resource utilization, observability, and developer experience.
* Contribute to the long-term technical roadmap of the AI Platform and evaluate emerging technologies relevant to AI/ML systems.
* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineers and help raise engineering standards across the organization.
* Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, code reviews, and complex problem-solving sessions.
* Collaborate with product, ML, data, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Own initiatives from
  **concept and architecture through implementation, deployment, and continuous iteration**
  .

**What We're Looking For**

**Education & Experience**

* **Ph.D**
  in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field or
  **Master's degree**
  in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field
  **from a**

  .

* Proven experience owning complex, high-impact engineering initiatives from architecture through production.

**Technical Expertise**

  , or similar technologies.
* Strong backend development experience with
  **Python, Go, or similar languages**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **REST, GraphQL, and API/service architectures**
  .
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Strong experience with
  **AWS, GCP, or Azure**
  .
* Experience with
  **Docker, Kubernetes**
  , and cloud-native architectures.
* Strong understanding of
  **CI/CD, DevOps, observability, and production operations**
  .
* Experience designing systems for
  **security, reliability, performance, high availability, and fault tolerance**
  .

**Leadership & Problem Solving**

* Exceptional systems-thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong technical judgment with the ability to evaluate complex engineering trade-offs.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
