title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Analyst I, Agentic Search
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created agentic AI role within our HQ Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation org, and will be based in our India office.
  
  
As the Agentic Search Analyst, you will be a key part of General Mills’ Marketing Activation and Operations team, helping translate real-time data signals into prioritized actions that improve the visibility, accuracy and representation of our brands in leading AI systems. This role will sit at the intersection of data and insight generation, with a focus on interpreting regular outputs from LLM (large language model) optimization partners and converting those outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for the broader AEO (answer engine optimization) team. You will regularly receive and analyze data from third-party vendors, identify what the results mean for content, help inform optimization decisions, map the phasing of recommended actions, and coordinate implementation with cross-functional partners. In addition, you will be building cross-functional relationships, and working across marketing, content, and operations teams to bring in key insights that are actionable and help us show up in the agentic results.
  
  
This role is ideal for a highly curious, detail-oriented analyst who enjoys working through complex datasets, finding the story in the data, and helping teams move from insight to action.
  
  
Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.-based functional partners and managers.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

title: Market Supply Planner
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Team Overview**
As Market Supply Planner (International) within Logistics Operations, you will own market supply planning for finished products across international markets, balancing product availability, inventory, service, cost, and waste. You will partner with regional planning teams, plants, Centers of Excellence, and General Mills India Center teams to strengthen planning capabilities, standardize processes, and improve business performance. This Mumbai-based hybrid role offers the opportunity to influence global planning standards through data-driven decision-making and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Own market supply and inventory planning for finished products, including product availability, inventory strategy, stock optimization, and replenishment to origin warehouses based on demand insights.
* Manage the supply chain interface between market teams and upstream plants and enterprise supply teams, ensuring timely and cost-effective supply while proactively minimizing shortage risks.
* Manage stock policy and shelf-life requirements to achieve service targets and reduce product waste; maintain accurate supply parameters and master data in SAP, OMP, and other planning systems.
* Lead demand consolidation and variance validation for international markets, monthly production regrouping decisions across make-to-order and make-to-stock products, and weekly supply sufficiency analysis and execution.
* Represent markets in weekly supply and operations execution meetings with plants; identify and escalate supply gaps, exceptions, and operational challenges to enable timely resolution.
* Analyze planning data, validate system-driven activities and outputs, run supply segmentation models, and provide feedback to improve segmentation standards and planning effectiveness.
* Build strong partnerships with regional supply Centers of Excellence, concurrent supply planners, deployment and replenishment teams, finite planners, inventory analysts, customer service, logistics, and other global stakeholders; provide analytical support and triage planning alerts.
* Own make-to-order and make-to-stock metric analysis and publication; identify automation and in-process measurement opportunities, strengthen governance, conduct loss analysis, support exports planning, and improve ways of working through service-level agreements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Full-time graduation from an accredited university.
* At least 4 years of experience in supply chain, including planning, forecasting, basic operations, inventory planning, and statistical analysis.
* Working knowledge of supply planning tools, including SAP enterprise resource planning and OMP.
* Working knowledge of data-processing and visualization tools, such as Tableau.
* Ability to process and evaluate large data sets and translate analysis into practical supply-chain actions.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization and collaborate with a broad range of global stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in operations, supply chain management, or a related field.
* CSCMP or APICS certification.
* Experience in international market supply planning, make-to-order or make-to-stock planning, supply segmentation, or exports planning.
* Experience with metrics governance, automation, loss analysis, process standardization, and continuous improvement.
* Experience partnering with regional planning Centers of Excellence and global supply-chain teams through service-level agreements.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Company Description**
Forage AI builds and operates custom, fully managed data extraction pipelines for organizations whose products, research, and AI systems rely on external data. Clients define the data requirements—fields, sources, formats, and cadence—while Forage AI manages source discovery, crawling, parsing, multi-layer QA, delivery, and ongoing maintenance. The company specializes in web data extraction at scale, intelligent document processing for structured data from complex documents, and AI solutions such as RAG-ready datasets and NLP workflows. Its offerings are designed to be custom-built, fully managed, and sovereign by design, ensuring that client data remains under their control. Forage AI primarily serves large enterprise data teams, data product companies, data platforms, and AI training organizations.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Data Scientist role based in Mumbai. The Data Scientist will work closely with engineering and product teams to design, implement, and optimize data pipelines and models that power web data extraction, intelligent document processing, and AI solutions. Responsibilities include exploring and analyzing large, complex datasets, building predictive and descriptive models, and developing metrics and dashboards to monitor data quality and pipeline performance. The role involves applying statistical and analytical techniques to improve extraction accuracy, automate QA processes, and support new data products and AI workflows. The Data Scientist will also collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Data Science and Statistics, with experience applying statistical methods to real-world data problems.
* Proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Analysis for exploring datasets, identifying patterns, and generating actionable insights.
* Ability to create clear and effective Data Visualization to communicate complex results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and relevant libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch).
* Experience working with large-scale or unstructured data, including web data, documents, or logs, and familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of machine learning concepts, model evaluation, and deployment practices.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Ability to work on-site in Mumbai, collaborate in cross-functional teams, and communicate clearly in written and spoken English.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

title: MSET QR Counterparty Risk Strats, Manager, Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Company Profile**
*Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.*
*As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.*
**Department Profile**
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Equity businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, Strats to risk management.
  
  
The Quantitative Research (QR) Counterparty Risk group has a global footprint across New York, London, and Hong Kong, and works closely with a range of business lines, including Prime Brokerage, Listed Derivatives, OTC Clearing, Institutional Equities, and Fixed Income Trading. In addition to providing ad hoc analysis to support live business decisions, the team works on a wide variety of projects, including enhancing counterparty risk metrics, developing tools for collateral and resource optimization, and applying data analysis and machine learning techniques. We are looking to hire highly talented, creative individuals who are enthusiastic about research and eager to contribute to a leading-edge team in an intellectually stimulating environment.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
This role, based in Mumbai, requires the individual to work with global Morgan Stanley Quantitative Research Counterparty Risk team.
  
  
The expected working hours will be London hours.
  
  
**The Key Elements Of The Role Are**

* Perform regular calibration and performance monitoring tasks on models and ensure timely delivery of high-quality analysis.
* Help to automate regular calibration and performance monitoring tasks
* Analyze back testing data to attribute P&L to risk factors and identify data quality or modelling issues.
* Support the development and prototyping of risk models and risk management techniques under the guidance of senior team members.
* Contribute to developing the team’s suite of quantitative tools.
* Analyze historical data to identify trends within the hedge fund industry and produce reports for clients and senior management.
* Support the development of stress tests for regular reporting and in response to specific market events, such as upcoming elections.

**Core Requirements**

title: Credit Risk Researcher, Vice President
description:
As a Vice President in Credit Risk Research at Citi, you will conduct high-impact analysis across wholesale and retail portfolios that directly shapes how the firm identifies, measures, and manages credit exposure. This individual contributor role gives you the platform to inform senior leadership, influence governance frameworks, and apply deep credit risk expertise to decisions with firm-wide consequences. If you can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insight, this position offers the scope and visibility to make a lasting impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct in-depth credit risk research across wholesale and retail portfolios, producing assessments that equip senior leadership with well-informed risk decisions.
* Develop and refine credit risk measurement methodologies, keeping Citi's approach to credit risk rigorous and aligned with evolving market conditions.
* Analyze credit portfolios to identify emerging risk concentrations, trends, and vulnerabilities, translating findings into clear risk mitigation recommendations.
* Monitor counterparty and sector-level credit risk trends to maintain an accurate, current view of Citi's credit exposures.
* Produce high-quality risk assessment reports and research outputs that communicate complex findings clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Present research conclusions to senior business and risk leaders, informing strategic credit risk decisions.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of credit risk governance frameworks, embedding research outputs into risk oversight processes.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Hold a bachelor's degree in economics, finance, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Bring 8+ years of experience in financial services and analytics, with deep expertise in wholesale or retail credit risk research or a closely related discipline.
* Apply strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to develop and enhance credit risk measurement methodologies.
* Interpret complex credit data to identify material risk themes and draw well-reasoned conclusions.
* Communicate nuanced credit risk findings clearly and confidently to senior and executive-level audiences, in writing and in person.
* Maintain familiarity with credit risk governance frameworks and the regulatory environment governing credit risk management in banking.
* Manage multiple research workstreams simultaneously, delivering rigorous, high-quality outputs within defined timelines.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Hold an advanced degree, such as a Master's, in economics, finance, statistics, or a related quantitative field.

What We Offer
  
  
At Citi, Credit Risk Research Vice Presidents work at the center of one of the world's most significant financial institutions, with direct access to complex, high-stakes analysis and the leadership teams who act on it.
  
  

* Work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, balancing structure with flexibility.
* Gain direct exposure to senior risk and business leadership, with your research informing decisions at the highest levels of the firm.
* Influence credit risk governance frameworks that shape Citi's wholesale and retail portfolio strategy.
* Build your career through Citi's global network of risk professionals and ongoing learning opportunities in credit risk.
* Thrive in a performance-driven environment that recognizes intellectual contribution, accountability, and high-quality analytical work.
* Access comprehensive wellbeing support and resources designed to support work-life balance.

Join Citi as a Vice President in Credit Risk Research and apply your expertise where it shapes the credit risk intelligence guiding one of the world's leading financial institutions.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Operations Research Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), Mumbai

**Job Category:**
Project Research Staff

**About the Project**

This government-funded initiative focuses on the development, integration and demonstration of drones and allied technologies. Within this programme, the role will contribute to UAV Traffic Management (UTM) research by developing methods and tools to coordinate drone operations safely and efficiently while accounting for airspace constraints and operational requirements. The project promotes research, technology development and industry-academia collaboration.

**Role Overview**

The Operations Research Scientist will build simulation-based modelling and analysis frameworks for managing traffic. The work will connect rigorous Operations Research methods with practical decision-support capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Formulate and solve optimization models for UAV routing, trajectory planning, mission scheduling, fleet/resource allocation, airspace network design and traffic-capacity planning.
* Develop strategic deconfliction and coordination algorithms for safe, efficient planning of multiple UAV operations.
* Build simulation and analytical frameworks to evaluate traffic demand, congestion, throughput, delays, resource utilization and system performance.
* Apply Operations Research methods to transportation, logistics, fleet coordination and network-management challenges.
* Analyze operational, trajectory and geospatial data to define performance metrics, conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses, and validate model outcomes.
* Translate research models into reproducible, testable software components, collaborating with software and autonomy teams and documenting technical findings.
* Bridge the gap between theoretical R&D and production-ready engineering solutions.

**Qualifications and Key Skills Required**

* PhD in a relevant discipline with relevant experience, OR MTech/ME or BTech/BE (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline with relevant research or industry experience. Relevant disciplines include Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a closely related field.
* Strong fundamentals in optimization, mathematical modelling, algorithms, simulation modelling and quantitative analysis.
* Familiarity with optimization modelling libraries or solvers (e.g., Pyomo, OR-Tools, Gurobi or CPLEX), simulation tools (e.g., SimPy, AnyLogic or equivalent), and Monte Carlo Simulation is desirable.
* Proficiency in Python, modelling and data analysis.
* Ability to validate models, conduct sensitivity or scenario analysis, interpret results, and communicate technical findings clearly in written reports and discussions.

* Track key business metrics, identify trends and investigate deviations from targets.
* Analyse product-level and channel-level economics, including margins, advertising costs, inventory and working capital.
* Prepare structured business reviews, financial analyses and decision-support reports for the founder.
* Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations rather than simply compiling reports.

**2. Strategic Planning & Business Problem-Solving**

* Work with the founder on business planning, growth initiatives, market opportunities and expansion strategies.
* Conduct research and analysis on new categories, distribution channels, competitors and potential partnerships.
* Evaluate business cases for new initiatives, including revenue potential, costs, investment requirements and expected returns.
* Support annual and quarterly planning, budgeting and performance reviews.
* Develop structured recommendations for business problems and support the founder in evaluating alternative courses of action.

**3. Cross-functional Execution & Accountability**

* Track key priorities and initiatives across Finance, E-commerce, Operations, Marketing and Sales.
* Coordinate with functional owners to monitor progress against agreed timelines and deliverables.
* Identify bottlenecks, unresolved issues and dependencies that require management attention.
* Prepare agendas, action trackers and follow-up reports for key business reviews.
* Ensure important decisions translate into clear action plans with accountable owners and deadlines.
* Escalate delays, risks and deviations to the founder with relevant context and proposed solutions.

**4. Financial Analysis & Fundraising Support**

* Support the preparation and analysis of budgets, forecasts, cash flows and business performance reports.
* Assist in evaluating unit economics, contribution margins, customer acquisition costs and other relevant business metrics.
* Support fundraising activities through preparation of investor materials, financial analyses, data-room coordination and investor updates.
* Assist with valuation analysis, financial modelling and business-plan preparation.
* Coordinate with Finance and external advisers to gather accurate information for investor discussions and strategic decisions.

**5. Special Projects & New Initiatives**

* Take ownership of selected projects assigned by the founder, from problem definition through implementation.
* Support the evaluation and launch of new categories, products, channels and business initiatives.
* Work with internal teams and external partners to drive projects to completion.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce costs and enhance organisational productivity.
* Undertake research, analysis and execution of time-sensitive business priorities.

**6. Business Intelligence & Process Improvement**

* Help establish a reliable and consistent reporting framework across the organisation.
* Identify gaps in business data, reporting processes and performance tracking.
* Work with Finance and Operations to improve data accuracy, consistency and availability.
* Develop standard templates for business reviews, project tracking and management reporting.

**About Credit Saison India**
Established in 2019, Credit Saison India (CS India) is one of the country’s fastest growing Non-Bank Financial Company (NBFC) lenders, with verticals in wholesale, direct lending and tech-enabled partnerships with Non-Bank Financial Companies (NBFCs) and fintechs. Credit Saison India is committed to growing as a lender and evolving its offerings in India for the long-term for MSMEs, households, individuals and more. Across its business arms of lending and corporate venture capital, Saison International is committed to being a transformative partner in creating opportunities and enabling the dreams of people.

**Process Overview\***
The India team is an integral part of Bank of America’s Global Risk Organization, providing model validation, governance, and analytics support to strengthen the Model Risk Management framework and ensure effective oversight across the model lifecycle.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The bank is looking for a quantitative finance analyst in the Global Markets (GM) Model Risk Management team. GM Model risk management team provides independent oversight and validation of pricing models. This includes Credit/Funding Value Adjustment (XVA) models, counterparty credit risk (CCR) models including IMM models, pricing models, margin models, etc. The team covers OTC derivatives across asset classes ranging from interest rates, FX, commodity, inflation, equity, credit and mortgage.
  
  
The team is responsible for assessing model conceptual soundness, regulatory compliance, implementation accuracy, and ongoing performance in line with the Bank's Model Risk Management framework and evolving regulatory expectations, including SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 principles.
  
  
The candidate will work specifically on validating Equity pricing models. The candidate will work closely with front office and Global Risk Analytics model developers, as well as Finance/PVG and other risk management groups.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Independently validate pricing and risk models used for valuation, risk management, and regulatory capital calculations of Equity Derivatives products, including vanilla and exotic options, structured products, variance swaps, correlation products, and hybrid instruments.
* Review model assumptions, mathematical formulations, numerical methods, calibration frameworks, implementation, limitations, and appropriateness of use for pricing and risk management purposes.
* Assess theoretical soundness of pricing methodologies including stochastic volatility models, local volatility models, jump-diffusion models, and correlation frameworks.
* Perform independent quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stress testing, back-testing, and model performance reviews to identify and quantify model risks.
* Evaluate model calibration approaches, market data dependencies, and valuation adjustments associated with equity derivatives portfolios.
* Prepare comprehensive validation reports, technical documentation, and remediation recommendations in accordance with regulatory and internal model risk management standards.
* Work closely with Front Office, Quantitative Research, Market Risk, Model Development, Finance/PVG, and other control functions to communicate validation findings and establish appropriate compensating controls.
* Maintain ownership of a portfolio of pricing models, perform periodic model reviews, ongoing monitoring, required action item closure, and support regulatory examinations and internal audits.

* Education: Masters or Ph.D. degree in Mathematics, Financial Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Computational Finance, Engineering Physics, Computer Science etc.
* Educational institutes: Top tier – IITs, NITs, IIMs etc.
* Certifications (preferred but not mandatory): FRM, CFA, CQF etc.
* Experience Range: 5 – 8 years of experience in Model Validation, Quantitative Analytics, Front Office Quantitative Research, Model Risk Management, or Pricing Analytics.

title: AVP - Data Governance
description:
**Synopsis of the role**
We are seeking a Data Governance Leader to drive data quality, regulatory compliance, and analytics governance across our core credit ecosystem. In this executive-facing role, you will oversee data pipelines, enforce Uniform Credit Reporting Formats, and manage Critical Data Elements across data ingestion lifecycle. Working closely with Senior Leadership, Board committees, and regulatory bodies to align data policies with regulatory frameworks. Additionally, you will lead root cause analysis and establish data trend reporting to mitigate risk. Join us to bridge complex technical architectures with business strategy and shape credit data governance.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Data Quality & Analytics Governance (DQI/DSR): Enforce and maintain Uniform Credit Reporting Formats (UCRF -Forms 1, 2, and 3) across all data pipelines. Oversee end-to-end ingestion processing, ensure automated generation and distribution of Data Statistics Reports (DSR), and establish benchmarks for file-level, CI-level, and Industry-level Data Quality Indexes (DQIs).
* Critical Data Element (CDE) & Lineage Management: Own and continuously update the CDE Master Register covering key attributes such as Loan Status, DPD, Outstanding Balance, and Demographics. Design and enforce risk-based data lineage tracking from initial SFTP ingestion through to consumer credit reports (CIRs) and scoring models.
* Regulatory Compliance & Policy Alignment: Ensure strict compliance with statutory credit data retention policies (7- year and perpetual retention rules) and RBI guidelines. Work closely with legal and compliance teams to adapt internal governance policies to evolving regulatory standards.
* Dispute Resolution Governance: Monitor and optimize dispute resolution workflows to ensure adherence to the statutory 30-day resolution SLA. Collaborate directly with the Internal Ombudsman on complex or escalated dispute rejections to maintain fairness and accuracy.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Algorithm Tuning: Analyze quarterly delink logs and customer complaint dumps to conduct deep-dive RCAs. Identify and resolve algorithm defects, fine-tuning entity resolution match logic and adjusting match thresholds within DCtrl.
* Member Engagement & Data Remediation: Drive engagement with Credit Institutions (CIs) to resolve recurring submission errors, monitor compliance, and enforce data cleanup and resubmission schedules.
* Audit & Anomaly Detection: Execute routine KYC anomaly audits focusing on key identifiers like PAN, Aadhaar, and Voter ID to ensure data integrity and prevent identity misclassification.
* Data Trends: Data Trend Analysis & Reporting: Extract, analyze, and publish data trends to deliver actionable insights to key stakeholders, serving as early warning indicators to mitigate potential risks.

**What Experience You Need**

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Finance, or related quantitative fields.
* Experience: 15+ years of relevant experience in Data Governance, Data Quality Management, or Business Intelligence within a Credit Bureau, Financial Institution, or Fintech.
* Domain Knowledge: Deep expertise in Indian Credit Bureau standards (UCRF, CICRA, DPDP), entity resolution, cascading match algorithms, and data lineage mapping.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, SAS/Python, database architecture (Cassandra/Oracle), ETL frameworks (Talend GCP), and statistical sampling methods.
* Leadership: Strong cross-functional leadership, executive presentation capabilities, and experience presenting governance outcomes to Senior Leadership teams and board committees.

**What Could Set You Apart**

* Prior Experience in Data governance role with large Bank, NBFC or CIC

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services (GBS)**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model. GBS is recognized for operational excellence, innovation, resiliency, and robust risk management.
  
  
In India, we operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), supporting global business functions across multiple locations including Mumbai, GIFT City, Gurugram, and Hyderabad.
  
  
**Process Overview**
The team supports the firm's Market Risk organization through the production, analysis, and enhancement of Risk Not in VaR (RNiV) and VaR-related risk metrics. The team partners closely with Global Risk Market Analytics (GMRA), Global Markets Risk (GMR), Risk Technology, and Quantitative Analytics teams to source model inputs, perform quality controls, execute risk calculations, analyze results, and support ongoing enhancements to the market risk infrastructure.
  
  
As part of the strategic future-state build, the team is developing the SRPnL platform and next-generation VaR engine leveraging full revaluation methodologies. The role offers an opportunity to contribute to model development, testing, benchmarking, production optimization, and risk analysis across a broad range of financial products.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly motivated Risk Quant Analyst to support the future-state build of the SRPnL platform and VaR engine while contributing to the production and enhancement of the firm's RNiV framework.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting lower-lane testing, benchmark analysis, valuation investigations, production process improvements, and quantitative risk analytics. **VaR Engine & SRPnL Platform**

* Support development and testing of the future-state SRPnL platform and VaR calculation framework.

* Analyze and investigate differences between Grid PnL and SFRC PnL outputs.

* Support optimization and stabilization of production batch processes and risk calculation workflows.
* Partner with stakeholders across Risk, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology teams to validate findings and implement improvements.

* Analyze risk-factor drivers and explain changes in RNiV and VaR results.

* Conduct ad-hoc quantitative analysis to support management, regulatory, and business requests.
* Identify opportunities to improve methodologies, controls, automation, and analytical processes.

**Risk Infrastructure & Automation**

* Develop, enhance, debug, and maintain Python-based solutions supporting model execution and production processes.
* Create and maintain process documentation, testing evidence, methodology documentation, and operational procedures.
* Contribute to the broader enhancement of market risk analytics, infrastructure, and automation capabilities.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

**Experience Range:**

* 5-8 years of experience in Market Risk, Quantitative Analytics, Model Development, Valuation, Risk Technology, or related quantitative finance functions.

**Foundational Skills**

* Strong understanding of derivatives pricing, valuation methodologies, and risk analytics.
* Experience with VaR, RNiV, Market Risk Capital models, or related risk measurement frameworks.
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities.
* Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and quantitative investigations.
* Experience working with large datasets and performing complex data analysis.
* Working knowledge of:

+ Quartz
+ Market Risk Suite (MRS)
+ Zinc
+ Tableau
+ SQL

* Broad knowledge of financial products including rates, FX, credit, equity, and derivatives products.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across Risk, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to communicate complex analytical findings effectively.
* Experience identifying and implementing process automation and efficiency improvements.

Mumbai

title: ML/CV Research Engineer
description:
We’re building at the intersection of Multimodal AI, Computer Vision, Spatial Understanding, and Temporal Vision, and are looking for an AI/ML Engineer or CV Researcher to join our R&D team.

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Data Scientist
description:

**Data Scientist**
**Experience: 6–8 years**
**Location-Gurugram, Bengaluru , Pune , Jaipur, New Delhi , Noida , Hyderabad , Chennai , Bhopal , Mumbai**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a Data Scientist with a strong engineering background to design, build, train, and operationalize machine learning models that deliver measurable business impact. You will work end-to-end across feature engineering, model training, inference, and post-processing, leveraging a modern, cloud-native ML platform built on GCP and Kubernetes. This role blends strong statistical and machine learning expertise with hands-on MLOps practices, ensuring models are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Model Development & Data Science
  
  

* Develop, train, and validate machine learning models using Python.
* Perform feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model evaluation.
* Apply appropriate ML techniques for prediction, classification, or optimization use cases. ML Workflow Orchestration
* Use Argo Workflows on Kubernetes to orchestrate model inference and post-processing pipelines.
* Design repeatable, automated workflows for ML experiments and production inference. Model Training & Validation
* Leverage Vertex AI to run scalable model training, hyperparameter tuning, and validation.
* Ensure reproducibility and consistency across training runs. Model Runtime & Inference
* Build and maintain Python-based runtimes for training, inference, and feature engineering.
* Optimize inference pipelines for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Handle and monitor pipelines in production environments..
* Participate in Oncall rotation for inference infrastructure. Model Storage & Lifecycle Management
* Handle trained artifacts in Google Cloud Storage (GCS).
* Track model metadata, versions, and lineage using Argo or custom model registries.
* Support model versioning, rollback, and auditability.. Quality, Monitoring & Governance
* Define model evaluation metrics and validation criteria.
* Support post-deployment monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies.
* Follow best practices for documentation, testing, and responsible AI usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills**

* Strong on-hands proficiency in Python for data science and machine learning use-cases.
* Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn, catboost, …).
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and Kubernetes-based workflows, especially Argo Workflows.

Data Science & ML Concepts

**About The Job**
At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.
  
  
We are seeking Masters in Public Health (MPH) graduates to help train AI models to provide accurate, evidence-based health information and policy analysis. You will challenge Large Language Models on their understanding of population health, biostatistics, and global health equity—ensuring that the models prioritize scientific consensus and ethical health guidelines. title: Research Engineer, Portfolio Management Group (PMG Tech), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Your team
  
  
Portfolio Management Group Technology (PMG Tech) is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group. The team integrates portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data capabilities, making technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
  
  
Risk and Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA uses advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data platforms to enhance decision-making, strengthen risk management capabilities, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Research (AI) Engineer, you will partner with RQA, PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to develop data workflows, analytics solutions, and artificial intelligence-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights.
  
  
Embedded within a PMG Tech Pod, a business-focused, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, artificial intelligence leads, and engineers. You will deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and informed decision-making.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of business problems and risk workflows, along with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will use Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and visualization tools to develop and operate data-intensive applications. You will also apply data quality practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, and data operations to create reliable, production-grade solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and maintain web-harvesting processes, data pipelines, transformations, and workflows that support research hypotheses and data analysis.
* Develop platform capabilities that source high-quality data and create scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
* Create research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, and exploratory tools that support insight generation and research workflows.
* Engage with investors, researchers, risk managers, and quantitative analysts to understand their workflows and translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data-extraction and data-management capabilities that accelerate investment research.
* Partner with artificial intelligence leads to source data and build applications that supplement research with artificial intelligence-assisted insights.

Your experience
  
  

* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Structured Query Language, supported by analytical thinking and effective problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data analytics, or the development of data-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of, or curiosity about, investment research and risk-management workflows or similar domains.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, research, and business teams and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with web-harvesting techniques and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence and machine learning tooling, large language model experimentation, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, and question-and-answer applications. Experience with dashboards, notebooks, lightweight research tools, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, or directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Power Market Engineer (Mumbai)
description:
**Description**
The Resource Planning and Market Assessment (RP&MA) team is responsible for economic analysis of various electric utilities across the US, with a focus on integrating renewables and storage to plan for the clean energy grid of the future. We advise our development team, company leadership, and external clients on optimal resource planning decisions. We contribute to investment decisions in solar, wind, battery storage and hydrogen. We are a data-driven team that believes in continuous improvement and collaboration. This means that we are always looking to develop better tools, processes, and modeling approaches through learning and knowledge sharing. We are looking for someone who enjoys challenges, works well in a collaborative team environment, and revels in seeking answers through data analytics. The Engineer of RP&MA Planning is part of a highly skilled professional team and reports to the Manager of the department.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform a broad range of studies and other consulting services to support electric utilities and asset developers to make decisions backed by business and engineering analysis regarding their investments and power supply requirements, such as integrated resource planning, market assessments, valuations, and power supply RFP evaluations.
* Researching about the US power markets (PJM, MISO, NEISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, SERC, ERCOT, NYISO) and assisting for the production cost & capacity expansion models development which can be utilized for the power price forecasting and congestion & curtailment risk evaluation.
* Perform forecasts and evaluations utilizing power supply planning software such as capacity optimization and hourly dispatch software models.
* Extracting key operational characteristics and market assumptions from internal sources and third-party databases like S&P Global and Velocity Suite.
* Analyze life-cycle costs by developing and incorporating technical assumptions regarding capital costs, operation and maintenance costs, performance estimates, and economic assumptions and forecasts.
* Conduct technical and business-related risk assessments that evaluate impacts associated with rules implemented by regulatory agencies.
* Developing presentation materials that communicate clearly the analyses performed and conveying insights that help developers better serve their utility customers.
* Support multiple ad hoc projects inclusive of those above, completing them in a timely manner.

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Power / Energy systems is preferred or bachelor’s in electrical engineering is must.
* Prior experience associated with electric utility operations, planning, or consulting is preferred.
* 2-6 years of experience in production cost modeling, and/or power market economics analysis using industry-standard models such as PROMOD or PLEXOS.
* Knowledge of the US power market is preferred.
* Strong understanding of the economics underlying electric power generation and background in power sector modeling, resource cost-benefit analysis, or related complex system modeling.
* Experience in evaluating complex technical and financial issues independently, developing recommendations, action plans, and managing multiple complex assignments simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, facilitation, team building, collaboration, organization and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment.
* Strong data management, analysis, and presentation skills (Excel, PowerPoint)
* Excellent written and oral communications skills.
* A willingness to learn new service offerings as client needs and the market requires changes to the service offerings provided by our group.
* Experience with production cost models (PLEXOS, PROMOD, etc.) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of US power market economics.
* Sophisticated data management and statistical analysis skills using Excel VBA, Power BI, R and Python

title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

At Lincoln International, we know that the success of our global organization is a direct outcome of the strength of our people. We value diversity, equity and inclusion as a catalyst to foster innovation and creative problem solving, access the best candidates and adapt to a highly dynamic, competitive environment.
