Lincoln International is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We encourage you to read more about our commitment to diversity and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) efforts.
  
  
**Lincoln International follows a hybrid work structure with an emphasis on in office collaboration.
  
  
Our employees work in our offices Monday through Thursday each week, with the option to work remotely or from the office on Fridays.**
The Senior Data Coordinator will serve as the day-to-day lead for a team of Data Specialists supporting strategic data, technology, and operational initiatives across Lincoln International's Valuations & Opinions Group. This is a hands-on working-lead role. In addition to setting daily priorities, coordinating workloads, coaching early-career team members, and reviewing work quality, this individual will be expected to perform the team’s core data and operational responsibilities as needed, particularly during periods of high volume, complex assignments, or limited team capacity.
  
  
The role will support client onboarding to Lincoln's next-generation valuation platform (Anaplan), private-market data collection and reporting, functional testing of new platform capabilities, ongoing support for valuation technology platforms, and continuous improvement initiatives, including emerging AI and data-extraction solutions.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with the Anaplan Technology team, Data & Analytics, the Salesforce Data team, Product teams, and valuation professionals. The role requires strong operational discipline, financial acumen, project coordination skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders while keeping the team focused, organized, and accountable.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities:**
Team Leadership & Daily Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day direction, coaching, and support to a team of Data Specialists, serving as the primary point of coordination for daily activities.
* Set priorities, assign work, and balance team capacity across multiple onboarding, data, testing, and support workstreams.
* Review team output for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness, reinforcing clear quality standards and expectations.
* Monitor productivity, turnaround times, and workflow bottlenecks; proactively adjust assignments and escalate risks when needed.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-training, and consistent documentation to strengthen team coverage and reduce key-person dependencies.
* Support the onboarding and development of new team members through structured guidance, feedback, and hands-on coaching.
* Remain actively involved in day-to-day execution and perform the core responsibilities of the Data Specialist team as needed, including completing complex or time-sensitive assignments, addressing capacity constraints, and modeling expected quality standards.

Client Onboarding & Project Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate the onboarding of valuation clients onto Lincoln's Anaplan platform, ensuring required data, activities, and stakeholders are aligned.
* Manage multiple concurrent onboarding, testing, and operational initiatives.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, issue logs, and status updates.
* Identify delivery risks and resource constraints early, communicate impacts clearly, and coordinate appropriate next steps.
* Facilitate cross-functional execution across Data & Analytics, the Anaplan Technology team, the Salesforce Data team, Product teams, and other Business Enablement partners.

Data Quality, Governance & Reporting
  
  

* Oversee the collection, validation, maintenance, and reporting of private-market data.
* Establish and reinforce quality-control procedures that improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness.
* Investigate data exceptions and recurring issues, coordinate resolution, and recommend sustainable process improvements.
* Maintain clear process documentation, operating procedures, and ownership standards to support scalable execution.
* Provide stakeholders with visibility into work status, data-quality issues, and outstanding dependencies.

Product & Technology Support
  
  

* Partner with the Anaplan Technology team on new platform capabilities and enhancements, including requirements clarification, functional testing, issue documentation, and validation of fixes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing and ensure test scenarios, results, defects, and follow-up actions are documented clearly.
* Support valuation technology platforms by triaging user questions, coordinating issue resolution, and identifying recurring support needs.
* Support the evaluation and responsible adoption of emerging AI and data-extraction solutions that improve team productivity and data-processing capabilities.

**Qualifications:**
Interested candidates should demonstrate the following experience and capabilities:
  
  
**Required Experience & Skills**

* Approximately 7-8 years of relevant experience in data operations, financial analysis, valuation, financial reporting, or a related field.
* Experience providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, or work coordination for junior or early-career team members.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong project coordination skills, including planning, milestone tracking, risk identification, issue management, and status communication.
* Analytical foundation with an understanding of financial statements and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong working knowledge of the team’s core data, financial analysis, and operational processes, with the ability and willingness to independently complete, troubleshoot, and provide guidance on the work performed by Data Specialists.
* Experience analyzing or preparing company financials, financial models, valuation analyses, or related reporting.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and build productive working relationships across levels and functions.
* Ability to periodically work extended hours, in the office or remotely, as required to support business deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CFA designation completed or actively being pursued.
* Experience with Anaplan or another enterprise planning or workflow platform.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, or other data and reporting tools.
* Experience supporting technology implementations, functional testing, or user acceptance testing.
* Experience in financial services, investment banking, valuation, or a related professional-services environment.

Professional & Cultural Characteristics
  
  

* High integrity and personal values consistent with Lincoln's Culture Statement: Excellence, Entrepreneurship, Integration, Collaboration, and Integrity.
* Proactive, organized, and self-motivated, with the judgment to identify priorities and move work forward with limited supervision.
* Resourceful problem solver who can identify root causes, recommend practical solutions, and follow through on execution.
* Confident and articulate communicator who provides clear direction and escalates issues constructively.
* Collaborative, team-oriented, and comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment with evolving priorities.
* Committed to developing others while remaining willing to work hands-on alongside the team.
* Curious and adaptable, with a strong interest in learning new financial concepts, technologies, and operating processes.

* Establish evaluation frameworks to measure response quality, relevance, latency, accuracy, and task completion
* Conduct experiments and analyse model outputs to identify performance gaps and validate improvements
* AI Safety, Reliability, and Production Deployment

* Conversational AI: Hands-on experience developing and deploying voice bots or conversational AI systems in production
* LLM Optimisation: Knowledge of prompt engineering, model evaluation, fine-tuning, and improving response quality

title: Tech Lead - Data Science
description:
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Tech Lead -
**Data Scientist**
to play a key role in building our
**Agentic AI Platform**
— a system of autonomous, tool-using AI agents that plan, reason, and execute complex business workflows end-to-end. The ideal candidate combines strong ML fundamentals with hands-on experience in LLM-based application development, agent orchestration frameworks, and Microsoft Azure cloud services. You will architect and ship production-grade agentic solutions, mentor junior team members, and set technical direction for GenAI initiatives across the organization.
  
  
Experience -8 to 12 yrs
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and productionize multi-agent systems — including planning, tool calling / function calling, memory, and orchestration — using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.
* Develop RAG pipelines end-to-end: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search (Azure AI Search / FAISS / pgvector), re-ranking, and grounding for agent knowledge.
* Integrate agents with enterprise systems and APIs via tool/function calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar connector patterns.
* Build and maintain LLM evaluation frameworks for agentic workflows — task-completion metrics, hallucination detection, trajectory analysis, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and A/B testing.
* Implement guardrails, safety, and governance for agents: prompt-injection defense, content filtering, role-based tool permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit logging.
* Fine-tune and optimize LLMs where needed (LoRA/PEFT, prompt optimization, model routing, latency/cost trade-offs) on Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry.
* Design, build, and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, NLP) where they complement agentic workflows.
* Own LLMOps/MLOps for the platform: experiment tracking, prompt versioning, CI/CD, observability and tracing (LangSmith, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry), drift monitoring, and retraining strategies.
* Collaborate with data engineers on data quality, availability, and governance across Azure Data Lake, Databricks, and Synapse Analytics.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into agentic AI solutions; present architecture decisions and results to senior stakeholders.
* Mentor junior data scientists, lead code/design reviews, and champion engineering best practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 8-10 years of professional experience in data science / ML, with at least 3 years building LLM or GenAI applications in production.
* Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent (at least one in production).
* Strong understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, agent memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
* Expert-level Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, async programming, API development with FastAPI).
* Hands-on experience with Azure services: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or Synapse.
* Experience with vector databases and embeddings (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, or pgvector).
* Solid grounding in classical ML: supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning; experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale data.
* Proven MLOps/LLMOps experience: MLflow, prompt/model versioning, CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), and production monitoring.
* Ability to evaluate and mitigate LLM-specific risks: hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, and cost/latency constraints.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI Assistants/Agents SDK, or Anthropic tool-use APIs.
* Microsoft certifications: AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer), DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate).
* Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Phi) using LoRA/QLoRA and serving via vLLM or Azure ML endpoints.
* Familiarity with observability/tracing for agents: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry.
* Knowledge of containerization and deployment: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps.
* Big data experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) via Azure Databricks.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, graph RAG, or semantic layers for agent grounding.
* Contributions to open-source GenAI/agentic projects or published technical content.

Python, SQL

title: Senior Data Scientist – Builder
description:
**About Puma Energy**
At Puma Energy, data is at the core of how we transform our global operations and deliver value across the energy value chain. Our Data & Analytics team is building a modern cloud-native data platform on AWS and Databricks, enabling trusted, scalable data products that power analytics, AI, and business-critical decision making.
  
  
**We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who is fundamentally a builder —**
someone who personally designs, ships, and owns machine learning and agentic automation systems in production, and who also raises the technical bar for the wider team through hands-on mentorship and sound methodology. This is not a purely strategic or advisory role: you will be in the code, in the data, and in the model — while also guiding other data scientists and engineers on the right approach to take. You will partner closely with our Data Engineering function (which builds our scalable data products on Databricks/AWS/Spark) and with commercial, retail, supply, and trading stakeholders.
  
  
This role goes beyond model-building in a notebook. You will:
  
  

* Own data science products end-to-end — from framing an ambiguous business problem to shipping and monitoring a production model.
* Build and deploy applied agentic automation solutions that augment or replace manual analytical/operational workflows.
* Guide teams on the right technical approach — modeling technique, architecture, and productionization strategy — without taking on formal people management.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate complex problems into scalable, measurable data science and automation solutions.
* Continuously raise the bar on experimentation rigor, reproducibility, and production discipline across the team.

**Responsibilities**
**Build & Ship Production Data Science**

* Design, build, and maintain machine learning models and data science solutions using Databricks, Spark (PySpark), Python, SQL, and AWS.
* Own the full ML lifecycle: problem framing, data preparation, feature engineering, model training and evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
* Build reusable modeling frameworks, curated feature sets, and self-service data science assets for forecasting, optimization, segmentation, and predictive use cases.
* Write clean, maintainable, production-grade code with strong testing, version control, and code-review discipline.

**Applied Agentic Automation**

* Design and build applied agentic automation workflows (e.g., LLM/agent-based systems that plan, retrieve, reason, and take action) to automate analytical, operational, or reporting processes.
* Evaluate and select appropriate agentic frameworks and tooling, balancing reliability, cost, and maintainability for production use.
* Establish guardrails, evaluation, and monitoring practices for agentic systems deployed into business workflows.

**Solution Design & Technical Guidance**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable data science and automation solutions.
* Guide and mentor other data scientists and engineers through design reviews, pairing, and code/methodology review — setting the technical direction without formal management authority.
* Evaluate architectural and modeling trade-offs and influence the team's technical standards and best practices.
* Drive solution design from concept through production deployment.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Build production-grade solutions with a strong focus on quality, testing, observability, and reliability.
* Implement automated model validation, monitoring, and retraining pipelines in partnership with Data Engineering and MLOps.
* Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve model performance and developer experience.

**Business Partnership**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, architects, and engineers to solve high-impact business problems.
* Communicate technical concepts and results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Take end-to-end ownership of solutions from discovery and design to production support.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Core Technical Skills**

* 6–10 years of hands-on experience in Data Science / Machine Learning, with a proven track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML solutions in production — not solely prototyping or advisory work.
* Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with Databricks is essential for this role — this is a non-negotiable requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* At least 1 year of hands-on experience building applied agentic automation solutions (e.g., LLM agents, agentic workflows, tool-using AI systems) that have been deployed or piloted in a real business context.
* Strong expertise in Python, SQL, and at least one ML framework (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) and cloud-native data platforms on AWS.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle: experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring at scale.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals including Git, CI/CD, testing, and code quality.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders, mentor peers, and drive technical discussions — without requiring formal people-management experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Databricks or AWS Certifications.
* Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Airflow/Prefect) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
* Experience with experimentation / causal inference and A/B testing methodology.
* Domain exposure to energy, commodities, downstream fuel/retail, or trading analytics.
* Data visualization skills (Power BI, Tableau, Plotly/Dash).

**What Success Looks Like**

* Own and deliver production-grade data science and agentic automation solutions powering business-critical decisions.
* Enable at least one applied agentic automation workflow that measurably reduces manual effort or improves decision speed.
* Visibly raise the technical bar of the team through mentorship, design reviews, and best practices — while remaining hands-on.
* Build strong partnerships with business stakeholders and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Continuously improve model reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency on the Databricks/AWS platform.

**Why Join Puma Energy**

* Build on a modern AWS + Databricks Lakehouse platform used across a global enterprise.
* Work on challenging, high-impact data science and agentic automation problems with real business impact.
* Own solutions end-to-end with autonomy and accountability — a hands-on builder role, not a purely strategic one.
* Grow your career through technical leadership and mentorship, on an individual-contributor track, without being forced into people management.

title: Team Member Credit Risk Modelling
description:
**Job Summary**
Team Member – Credit Risk Modelling will be responsible for the development, enhancement, implementation, and monitoring of Internal Rating Models and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 frameworks for wholesale portfolios. The role requires strong expertise in credit risk analytics, statistical modelling, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder management within a banking or NBFC environment.
  
  
The candidate should possess 7–8 years of relevant experience in credit risk modelling, with hands-on exposure to Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Exposure at Default (EAD), scorecards, internal rating frameworks, and ECL implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 ECL Modelling & Implementation***
Support development and maintenance of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 framework.
  
  
Implement staging assessment methodologies, macroeconomic overlays, SICR frameworks, and forward-looking adjustments.
  
  
Monitor model performance and recommend enhancements based on portfolio behavior and economic trends.
  
  
Collaborate with finance, risk, and business teams for smooth implementation of ECL methodologies within the Bank/NBFC systems.
  
  
Support provisioning calculations, management reporting, and audit/regulatory requirements.
  
  
***Data Management & Analytics***
Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and analysis using large datasets from multiple source systems.
  
  
Analyse portfolio trends, credit behaviour, migration patterns, and default characteristics.
  
  
Conduct statistical analysis and model diagnostics using SAS, SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  
  
Prepare dashboards and analytical reports for senior management and risk committees.
  
  
***Regulatory & Governance Support***
Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines, Basel framework, IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 standards, and internal model governance policies.
  
  
Prepare model documentation, methodology papers, validation support documents, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
Support internal audit, model risk management, and regulatory inspection requirements.
  
  
***Stakeholder Management***
Work closely with Risk, Finance, Business, IT, and Model Validation teams for implementation and monitoring activities.
  
  
Present model methodologies, assumptions, and performance outcomes to senior stakeholders and committees.
  
  
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of model-related initiatives.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
7–8 years of experience in Credit Risk Modelling within a Bank or NBFC.
  
  
Strong understanding of Internal Rating Models, Basel regulations, and IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 ECL framework.
  
  
Hands-on experience in development/implementation of PD, LGD, EAD, scorecards, or rating models.
  
  
Good understanding of staging assessment, SICR, macroeconomic overlays, and provisioning methodologies.
  
  
Strong analytical and statistical modelling skills.
  
  
Proficiency in SAS, SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  
  
Experience in handling large datasets and performing quantitative analysis.
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to independently manage projects and interact with senior management.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
MBA / CA / FRM / CFA / Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or related quantitative discipline.
  
  
Experience in model validation or regulatory interaction will be an added advantage.
  
  
Exposure to wholesale and retail credit risk portfolios preferred. Role: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Credit Risk Modelling / IFRS 9 & Internal Rating Models

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. **About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position**
**Job Purpose**
The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues — flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source.
  
  
**Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)**

* Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy — distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness)
* All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation
* Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate
* Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template
* Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions
* Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks
* Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling
* Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields)
* For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

**Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)**

* Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets — reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director
* Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval
* Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited
* Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard
* Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround — reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

**Installed base (all markets)**

**The Role:**
The Assistant Vice President in the Model Implementation & Support Team plays a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle of actuarial model enhancements, from design and implementation to validation and impact assessment. The role involves understanding business requirements, developing changes in RAFM, and maintaining supporting tools such as the Assumption Management System and Unify. Assistant Vice President ensure robust model architecture, maintain detailed documentation, and drive process improvements.
  
  
On the testing side, the Assistant Vice President validates model changes through functional and end-to-end testing, ensuring accuracy and consistency across the results production process. They assess the financial impact of changes on the balance sheet and P&L, perform reconciliations, and communicate findings to stakeholders. Defect identification, resolution, and retesting are key responsibilities, along with maintaining a thorough audit trail for governance and approvals.
  
  
By combining technical modelling expertise with strong analytical and communication skills, the Assistant Vice President ensures that model changes are not only technically sound but also financially transparent and aligned with business objectives.
  
  
**Primary Key Responsibilities**

**Model Development**
**Model Testing**

* Liaise with model users, developers, and stakeholders to understand business requirements across both model development and operational components.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications that align with the existing model architecture and operational framework.
* Design, develop, and unit test enhancements to RAFM models, ensuring alignment with actuarial principles and business objectives.
* Maintain a robust audit trail and comprehensive documentation for all model changes.
* Develop and maintain the in-house Assumption Management System (Excel/VBA-based) to support assumption governance.
* Support and enhance Unify, a VBA and Python-based automation tool for streamlining model production processes.
* Build and maintain data creation and result extraction tools for each model release cycle.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define and execute testing and validation strategies for model and operational changes.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of model outputs and operational tools.
* Propose and implement process improvements across both development and operations to enhance efficiency, transparency, and scalability.
* Ensure all changes—whether in RAFM models or operational tools—are well-documented with clear version control and audit trails.
* Adhere to governance standards and contribute to maintaining model integrity and compliance.
* Understand the nature and scope of model changes or enhancements made in RAFM.
* Collaborate with model developers and stakeholders to gather context and expected outcomes of changes.
* Perform Functional Testing (Model Baselining) to validate the correctness of RAFM model coding changes.
* Conduct End-to-End Testing to ensure the full results production process functions as intended, comparing outputs with development or previous production results.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the balance sheet and P&L, and explain the financial implications of model changes.
* Perform step-through analysis to reconcile movements from previous results and support overall financial impact assessments using standardized tools.
* Proactively identify, document, and communicate defects or unexpected results to relevant teams (e.g., Modelling, Assumptions, Data).
* Retest and validate fixes to ensure resolution of identified issues.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of testing activities, results, and financial impact analysis to support audit and approval processes.
* Ensure traceability and transparency of all testing and analysis performed.
* Continuously seek opportunities to enhance testing frameworks, automation, and documentation standards.

title: Environmental Fate Modeller
description:
**Job Purpose**

We are seeking an experienced Environmental Fate & Exposure Assessment Scientist to support the registration and regulatory compliance of Plant Protection Products (PPPs) and Biocides globally. The role focuses on environmental fate assessments, exposure modelling, ecotoxicological risk assessments, and preparation of regulatory dossiers in compliance with EU and international regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct environmental fate and exposure assessments for plant protection products and biocides across soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment, and air compartments.
* Perform environmental exposure modelling using industry-recognized tools, including FOCUS PEARL, PELMO, MACRO, PRZM, SWASH, TOXSWA, SWAN, PERSAM, ESCAPE, CAKE, EUSES, etc....
* Evaluate the environmental behavior, degradation, mobility, persistence, and distribution of active substances and metabolites.
* Prepare, review, and submit regulatory dossiers for EU Plant Protection Product registrations, including dRR Part B.8 (Environmental Fate and Behaviour), dRR Part B.10 (Groundwater).
* Critically assess scientific studies and regulatory data packages to determine study reliability, relevance, and regulatory acceptability.
* Develop scientifically robust risk assessments and provide clear, defensible conclusions to support regulatory submissions.
* Author and peer review technical reports, expert statements, registration documents, and responses to regulatory authority queries.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary regulatory, toxicology, ecotoxicology, and product stewardship teams to support global registration strategies.
* Monitor evolving regulatory requirements and scientific developments related to environmental risk assessment and pesticide/biocide regulation.

**Required Qualifications**

* M.Tech/ Ph.D (minimum) in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Required Experience**

* Significant experience in environmental fate, exposure modelling, and regulatory risk assessment for Plant Protection Products (PPPs) and/or Biocides.
* Proven experience preparing and reviewing EU regulatory dossiers for PPP registrations.
* ***Hands-on expertise with FOCUS modelling tools and environmental exposure assessment methodologies.***
* Experience working with international regulatory frameworks for agrochemicals, pesticides, or biocides.

**Regulatory Knowledge**

Strong understanding of:

* European Union Plant Protection Product Regulations
* Regulations (EU) 283/2013 and 284/2013
* EFSA Guidance Documents
* ECHA Guidance and Regulatory Requirements
* US EPA Environmental Risk Assessment Frameworks
* PCPB and other international pesticide registration requirements

**Key Competencies**

* Environmental Fate & Behaviour Assessment
* Exposure Modelling
* Ecotoxicological Risk Assessment
* EU Dossier Preparation
* Regulatory Strategy & Compliance
* Scientific Report Writing
* Data Evaluation & Interpretation
* Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Collaboration
* Attention to Detail

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
****Process Overview****
The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
  
  
GIS Identity & Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
  
  
****Job Description****
The Data Engineering Services team is seeking a hands-on IAM Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and data engineering capabilities that strengthen Identity and Access Management controls, governance, and risk reduction across the enterprise.
  
  
This role will require to transform complex access, entitlement, identity lifecycle, privileged access, and control data into actionable insights. The candidate will design and develop scalable data pipelines, predictive and detective analytics, AI/ML models, dashboards, and self-service reporting capabilities that help identify control gaps, access anomalies, toxic combinations, certification inefficiencies, and emerging IAM risks. The role requires strong technical depth in analytics, model development, model governance, AI risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to convert data science outcomes into measurable control improvements and executive-ready risk narratives.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Lead advanced analytics and data science initiatives across IAM controls, access governance, entitlement management, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access certifications, and policy adherence.
* Analyze large, complex, and disparate identity, access, entitlement, control, application, and audit datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps, risk concentrations, and opportunities for automation.
* Design, build, validate, and tune AI/ML models for IAM use cases such as access anomaly detection, entitlement mining, role mining, toxic access identification, certification prioritization, privileged access monitoring, and control effectiveness measurement.
* Develop scalable data pipelines, feature engineering processes, reusable datasets, and analytics frameworks using Python, R, SQL, Splunk, Neo4j, and enterprise-approved data platforms.
* Design and maintain executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and self-service reporting solutions that convert IAM control data into actionable insights for process owners, risk partners, and senior leadership.
* Embed model governance and AI risk controls into the analytics lifecycle, including documentation, model inventory, validation evidence, explainability, performance monitoring, drift detection, data lineage, reproducibility, and audit traceability.
* Assess and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, privacy exposure, data quality limitations, explainability gaps, inappropriate automation, overfitting, and adversarial or unintended use of model outputs.
* Partner with IAM, GIS, cyber risk, audit, compliance, privacy, technology, and application teams to translate control requirements into measurable analytics solutions and governance outcomes.
* Drive process improvement and automation by identifying manual control activities, inefficient data handoffs, recurring exceptions, and opportunities to strengthen preventative and detective IAM controls.
* Prepare clear documentation, control evidence, methodology summaries, model performance updates, and risk narratives to support governance reviews, audit readiness, and management reporting.

****Requirements****
**Education :**
B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
  
  
**Certifications If Any**
: NA
  
  
**Experience Range : 10**
+ years
  
  
****Foundational Skills****

* Expertise in advanced data analytics and statistical modeling using Python, R, and SQL
* Proficiency in data visualization and graph analytics using Neo4j, Tableau, or equivalent tools
* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management architecture, technology and standards
* Strong quantitative analysis, data intuition, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
* Proficiency in AI, machine learning, data mining, feature engineering, and statistical analysis
* Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and executive presentation skills
* Proven experience in end-to-end model development lifecycle including data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, deployment readiness, monitoring, drift detection, and performance tuning
* Strong knowledge of model governance practices including model documentation, model inventory, model cards, approval workflows, control evidence, audit traceability, and alignment with enterprise risk management expectations
* Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, explainability gaps, privacy exposure, data quality issues, model drift, overfitting, adversarial misuse, and inappropriate automation of access decisions
* Experience applying AI/ML techniques to IAM datasets such as entitlement mining, access anomaly detection, role mining, toxic access identification, privileged access monitoring, joiner-mover-leaver patterns, and access certification optimization

****Desired Skills****

* Experience with data storytelling and reporting design that helps stakeholders make actionable control and risk decisions

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Clinevo is building our go-to-market engine and looking for folks excited to get their hands dirty in a 0 to 1 journey. If you are expecting a ready-made GTM stack that you only need to maintain, Clinevo Technologies is probably not the right fit for you at this point. However, if you are excited about building the systems from scratch, we would love to hear from you.

We're seeking a hands-on GTM Engineer (B2B Saas) to build the automated systems that find, reach and convert pharmacovigilance buyers for Clinevo Technologies, from data and signals to AI-led outreach, routing and analytics.

You will partner with our sales, marketing, product and tech teams to design, build and run the workflows behind every stage of our funnel. You'll need to possess a strong drive, take ownership of your work, and have an insatiable desire to ship things and make them work.

This role requires a builder with hands-on experience in GTM automation, data enrichment and AI tools, adept at turning manual sales work into repeatable, measurable systems.

**Your responsibility won't be limited to but will include the following:**

* **Data Foundation:**
  Build and maintain a living database of pharma, biotech, CRO, med-device and veterinary companies, with waterfall enrichment for verified contacts and PV-specific data.
* **ICP and Scoring:**
  Define ICP tiers from won and lost deals, and build account and lead scores that blend fit, intent and engagement.
* **Signal Detection:**
  Track regulatory and business signals (FDA warning letters, EMA inspection findings, approvals, leadership changes, M&A, hiring) and route each one to the right play and owner.
* **Inbound Conversion:**
  Build an AI SDR that enriches, qualifies and replies to every website lead in under a minute, 24/7, with instant routing to the right regional rep.
* **Outbound at Scale:**
  Run signal-led, multichannel sequences across email, LinkedIn and phone, with AI-assisted personalisation and human review.
* **Speed to Lead:**
  Alert reps on Slack or Teams the moment a target account engages, so they act while the prospect is warm.
* **Analytics and Reporting:**
  Build full-funnel dashboards, UTM tracking and attribution, and run experiments that improve conversion.

**Other role areas:**

* Sync target lists to LinkedIn matched-audience and retargeting ads, and build personalised landing pages per account or segment.
* Create personalised content at scale: AI-avatar demo videos, account one-pagers and ROI calculators.
* Pre-book meetings around PV conferences and webinars, and follow up within hours.
* Equip sales with pre-call briefs, AI call notes, RFP and security-questionnaire automation, and deal-risk alerts.
* Build expansion plays from customer health signals, champion tracking and cross-sell opportunities.
* Build AI agents and internal tools for research, qualification and CRM hygiene, with prompt libraries and quality checks.
* Own email infrastructure and deliverability, and keep outreach GDPR-compliant, with guardrails on AI-written copy.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  2–5 years in growth, GTM operations, RevOps or SDR roles, with at least one GTM automation shipped end to end in production.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Hands-on experience with Clay or similar enrichment tools, CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce), APIs, webhooks and JSON; scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building with AI coding tools such as Claude Code.
* **AI Skills:**
  Ability to write prompts that produce accurate, persona-specific copy, and judgement on where human review belongs.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Strong ability to measure funnels, attribution and experiments, and translate insights into action.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a system clearly in five minutes.
* **Collaboration:**
  Proven ability to work cross-functionally, particularly with sales and marketing teams.
* **Adaptability:**
  Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, preferably within a SaaS startup.
* **Good to Have:**
  Exposure to life sciences or pharmacovigilance; German, French, Spanish or Italian.

**Location & timings:**

This is a full-time in-person role with the office based in Mumbai. Working pattern & hours are Monday - Friday, 40 hours per week. The timings typically would be 10.30am-7.30pm IST.

title: Principal Data Consultant

We are seeking a

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets.

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows.

* Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets.
* Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data.
* Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources.
* Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products.
* Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.
* Apply LLMs, embeddings and AI-agent workflows to extract structured information from documents, contracts, filings, web content and other unstructured sources.
* Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets
* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.

title: Lead Risk Management
description:
Joining Capco means joining an organisation that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you’re encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can. We believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Such differences may mean we need to make changes to our process to allow you the best possible platform to succeed, and we are happy to cater to any reasonable adjustments you may require. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help.
  
  
**About Capco**
Capco is a global business, data and technology consultancy, focused on the Financial Services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.
  
  
**We Are**

* Experts in capital markets, banking and payments, insurance and wealth and asset management
* Deep knowledge in financial services offering, including e.g. Finance, Risk and Compliance, Financial Crime, Resilience etc.
* Committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent to help us get there
* Focus on maintaining our nimble, agile and entrepreneurial culture

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit financial risk transformation candidates into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance (FRRF) capability.
  
  
Successful candidates will
  
  

* Develop a holistic understanding of portfolio evolution across different Securitization asset verticals, regions and product types within the current portfolio.
* Produce forward-looking portfolio intelligence, identifying emerging portfolio trends, vulnerabilities and opportunities
* Provide independent challenge to portfolio strategy and portfolio construction decisions.
* Identify emerging structural risks affecting securitisation markets.
* Produce strategic portfolio intelligence, insights and recommendations that support strategic decision making by senior management
* Work collaboratively with 1LOD PM team (Credit & Asset Mgmt. Team) to evaluate strategic portfolio actions.
* Independently assess proposed portfolio optimization, hedging and de-risking initiatives.
* Analyse portfolio construction and diversification across products, asset verticals, geographies, industrial sectors and counterparties.
* Identify/complement 1LOD to detect opportunities to improve portfolio resilience, capital efficiency and risk adjusted returns.
* Portfolio Risk Measurement Architecture – Development & Ownership in collaboration with 1LOD PM team
* Conduct structured portfolio deep-dives by asset class (ABS, RMBS, CLO, SPF etc.).
* Surveillance and reporting of portfolio migration trends (ratings, delinquencies, collateral performance, covenant metrics, leverage trends, RWA utilization, structural and counterparty trends…).
* Assess early warning signals (EWS) and trigger governance escalation where required – transaction level as well as asset vertical, industrial sector, securitization product, country, and regional level.
* Undertake Quarterly Portfolio Review of third-party financing book (deck preparation, analytical inputs in liaison with 1LOD and 2LOD, SCOs, presentation to QPR Committee, minutes preparation).
* Quarterly production of Securitisation Credit Dashboard a
* Involved in advising on risk frameworks and controls, and delivering transformation across the Risk functions of our clients, in support of their Chief Risk Officers (CRO). This includes implementation of regulatory changes (e.g. Basel, IFRS9, BCBS-239, FTRB), delivery of data to support IRB and VaR modelling, and automation of risk controls, control gap assessment and control implementation.

**The Types Of Projects We Cover Are**

* Our clients are predominantly within Financial Services and look for support in delivering solutions to improve risk management practices and control frameworks. This may include Risk Assessments, Target Operating Model design and implementation, Risk Rating Methodologies and Models, Gap Analysis, data and reporting
* Gap analysis and implementation of regulatory changes and remediation of identified issues
* Identification and implementation of technology and data solutions to support credit, market, liquidity, and capital risk management processes.
* As a Risk Management SME at Capco, you may be required to communicate risk policies and processes for an organisation, develop risk models involving market, credit, liquidity, capital and/or operational risk, ensure controls are operating effectively, and provide research and analytical support.
* You will also be encouraged to support Capco in client account planning, business development and relationship building / networking within the FRRF capability and Capco Domains. This may include contributions to Capco’s Risk Management thought leadership and client campaigns.

**Skills And Expertise**
The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience and will be able to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Good knowledge of regulatory requirements around Basel, FRTB, IFRS9, BCBS-239 etc with specific focus on credit, market, liquidity and capital risks.
* Experience analysing, defining solutions and implementing regulatory change, including remediation of gaps
* Ability to evaluate the client’s current risk management processes (e.g. analyse potential impacts of key current and emerging risks, trends, reports, statistics, and relevant documentation)
* Define and implement risk management process improvements and track benefit realisation
* Experience analysing controls and conducting structured control testing – including design of control frameworks for financial risk management
* Facilitate risk conversations between different departments within organisations (e.g. client-facing businesses, credit risk, operational risk, legal, IT, finance, and operations teams)

This will be coupled with strong change management experience and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.
* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Designing solutions, delivering on client assignments and owning delivery of projects.
* Ensuring management information is provided to, and easily understood by, programme leads, senior management and client committees.
* Defining and managing monitoring processes for financial risks.
* Building assurance and control capabilities in line with regulatory expectations and risk appetite.
* Self-starter and strong team player.
* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholders from AVP to senior MDs.

**Other Expectations**

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and sales activities with the capability and client accounts.

**For senior level candidates**

* Mentor and coach other members of the team.
* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.
* People management, building a team of consultants with the right mix of grades, skills and experience to support client opportunities and projected growth.
* Develop, drive and convert a pipeline of opportunities and lead on RFP responses.
* Fulfil a key role in account and proposition development within Market Domains and Key Client Accounts, assisting senior management to increase revenue.
* Formulate propositions and solutions that meet client requirements in addition to managing and directing pursuit activity.
* Strong bid management abilities, with a proven ability to mentor and train Consultants.
* Drive thought leadership and client campaigns
* Build and maintain strong client relationships within the sector, leveraging proven industry content and delivery capability.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**
You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest financial services firms in the world, addressing our clients’ biggest challenges.
  
  
**We Offer**

* A work culture focused on innovation and building lasting value for our clients and employees
* Ongoing learning opportunities to help you acquire new skills or deepen existing expertise
* A flat, non-hierarchical structure that will enable you to work with senior partners and directly with clients
* A diverse, inclusive, meritocratic culture
* Enhanced and competitive family friendly benefits, including maternity / adoption / shared parental leave and paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement

title: Applications Technical Specialist I
description:

you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc

* Drive the design, build and implementation of solutions to solve business requirements for analysis, solutioning, testing, implementation and production support of a reporting solution for Oracle EBS and other systems.

* Act as the liaison between business and technology teams to review reporting requirement, business processes, understand requirements, perform fit/gap analysis, evaluate options and decide direction.

* Technical savvy with the ability to quickly understand different systems and processes
* Ability to provide clear oral and written communication to a variety of business and technical audiences.
* Proven experience in designing and supporting RICEW components.

* Ability to coordinate and support activities beyond regular working hours

* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong people skills
* A self-starter, motivated, forward thinker, and takes ownership

title: AI Architect & Builder
description:

BECO is a revolutionary home care brand dedicated to sustainability and eco-friendliness. As a direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand, we are on a mission to make the world a better place, one home at a time.

We are looking for a high-agency individual who can design, build, and deploy autonomous AI systems that replace manual workflows across the organization.
  
  
This role is not about experimenting with AI tools — it’s about eliminating human dependency in repeatable processes by building production-grade agentic systems.

problem → workflow design → AI system → deployment → optimization

* Inputs / outputs

* ERP (SAP / Tally)

* Create orchestration layers across multiple agents

* Optimization & Scaling
* Continuously improve system accuracy, speed, and cost
* Reduce human intervention over time
* Scale automations across departments
* Measure:
* Time saved
* Cost reduced
* Output improved

**Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like)**

* 50–80% reduction in manual operational work
* Fully automated workflows across key functions
* AI agents independently handling end-to-end tasks
* Minimal human oversight required for routine processes

**Required Skills**
**Technical**

* Strong experience with LLMs and prompt engineering
* Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.)

* High ownership and bias for action
* Ability to ship fast and iterate
* Comfortable working with ambiguity

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with RPA tools
* Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Tally)
* Experience in FMCG / manufacturing / D2C environments
* Understanding of data pipelines / analytics

**What This Role Is NOT**

* Not a prompt engineer who just writes prompts
* Not a data scientist doing offline models
* Not a consultant making slides
* This is a builder role focused on real-world impact.

**Compensation & Structure**

* High ownership role with direct impact on company efficiency
* Performance-driven incentives tied to automation outcomes
* Opportunity to build and lead an internal AI automation function

**Who Should Apply**

* Builders who have already automated parts of their own workflow
* People who hate repetitive work and want to eliminate it permanently
* Individuals obsessed with leveraging AI for real-world execution

title: Associate Director, Market Engagement Lead, India
description:
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
The Market Engagement & Insights Lead is the market-level commercial-digital leader and single point of accountability for driving digital, data and AI-enabled commercial outcomes in-market. The role connects market strategy and priorities with enterprise DHH capabilities (digital, data, analytics and technology), ensuring initiatives are prioritized, funded, delivered, adopted and generate measurable business value.
  
  
This is not a traditional IT operations role. Digital, data and analytics are the enablers; business outcomes and value realization are the measures of success. The role sponsors a ‘one roadmap, one budget, one team’ approach for the market and owns the executive alignment, prioritization trade-offs and benefits accountability across the integrated DHH agenda.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Own the market’s demand-to-value system lead demand intake, prioritization, delivery oversight, adoption and benefits realization so every initiative has a clear line of sight to value.
